BioSüd is an annual trade fair for the organic sector and has been firmly established within Germany’s organic industry since its inception in 2009. The name not only reflects the fair’s core focus on organic products and sustainable innovations but also emphasizes its regional orientation toward southern Germany, particularly Bavaria and the adjoining Alpine regions. Organized by Matthias Deppe und Wolfram Müller OHG , the event draws on many years of experience and in-depth industry knowledge to offer a platform that holds a unique position within the sector. The venue is the Augsburg Exhibition Center, which transforms once a year into a vibrant meeting point for organic retailers, health food stores, organic supermarkets, foodservice providers, bulk purchasers, and other key industry players. At the heart of the event are premium organic foods and natural cosmetics, all certified to strict organic standards. The fair presents a comprehensive cross-section of the organic value chain – from regional specialties produced by beekeepers, cheesemakers, and wineries to innovative new products such as fermented drinks and plant-based formulations. Established brands meet emerging start-ups, fostering a dynamic exchange between tradition and innovation. A varied supporting program featuring lectures, workshops, forums, and panel discussions addresses the most pressing issues in the sector. Topics include certification processes, supply chain challenges, soil health, carbon offsetting, and legal frameworks for organic agriculture, as well as market developments, pricing structures, and the integration of organic policy into broader political decision-making. Direct dialogue between producers, retailers, industry experts, and policymakers creates space for practical solutions and encourages sustainable partnerships. Exhibitors primarily come from the organic and health food retail sectors, as well as the organic foodservice industry. A wide range of regional producers rounds out the offering. The fair is attended exclusively by trade visitors – including independent retailers, restaurateurs, wholesalers, and representatives from associations, media, and government – all united by a shared goal: to further develop an ecologically and socially responsible organic industry. BioSüd is part of a nationwide network of trade fairs, which also includes BioOst (Leipzig), BioWest (Düsseldorf), and BioNord (Hamburg). Together, these events form a strong network for the organic trade in Germany – regionally rooted and nationally connected. With its modern infrastructure, central location, and excellent accessibility via train, highway, and public transport, the Augsburg Exhibition Center provides the ideal setting for a trade fair of this scale. Combined with the cultural appeal and historical significance of the city, attending BioSüd becomes not just a business engagement, but an inspiring experience in its own right.

축제소개: The Agroprodmash is an international exhibition dedicated to showcasing equipment, machinery, and ingredients for the food and processing industry. The name "Agroprodmash" derives from the combination of "Agricultural Production" and "Machinery", which reflects the core themes of the exhibition. This exhibition is held annually at the Crocus Expo International Exhibition Centre in Krasnogorsk, near Moscow , the heart of Russia, and is organized by Expocentre. Its significance extends beyond the capital, spanning the entire country, as it displays the latest innovations and solutions in food production and processing. The main focuses of the Agroprodmash exhibition are diverse. They include technological advancements in food processing and production, advanced industrial automation systems, innovative packaging materials, and environmentally friendly, waste-reducing technologies. Furthermore, cutting-edge software for efficiency enhancement is showcased. Exhibition attendees can explore a wide range of products and services. This encompasses machinery and equipment for the meat, dairy, confectionery, and bakery sectors, as well as cross-industry solutions, including packaging systems, cooling technologies, retail solutions, measuring instruments, cleaning equipment, and production automation solutions. The exhibiting companies represent a myriad of sectors, covering all facets of food production and processing. The primary visitors include industry experts, entrepreneurs, and leaders interested in the latest innovations and technologies in the food sector. The Crocus Expo International Exhibition Centre in Krasnogorsk, near Moscow, a contemporary exhibition ground, is renowned for its excellent facilities and transport connections. It's not just a focal point for business meetings but also symbolizes Moscow's position as a crucial trade and innovation hub. In conclusion, the Agroprodmash exhibition provides a remarkable platform for professionals, experts, and enthusiasts to discover and exchange insights on the latest trends, technologies, and solutions in the food and processing industry.

The " Espacio Food & Service " is a leading trade fair in Chile's food industry and a central meeting point for industry experts from across Latin America. Since its inception in 2011 at the Espacio Riesco Centro de Eventos y Convenciones in Santiago, the fair has become an annual highlight, consistently showcasing the latest trends and innovations in the sector. The organizer and host of the fair is the Espacio Riesco Centro de Eventos y Convenciones. This event attracts not only local but also international exhibitors and visitors, fostering exchange among suppliers, producers, and merchants from the gastronomy, hospitality, and food processing sectors. The offerings include fresh and processed foods, beverages, spirits, as well as specialized equipment and services for gastronomy, including the latest kitchen technology and innovative packaging design. The fair is also known for its dynamic side events, including conferences and seminars with leading experts, interactive cooking shows with renowned chefs, as well as tastings and expert talks that attract visitors worldwide. It provides a platform for networking, learning, and sharing best practices and plays a crucial role in advancing the food industry in the region. The "Espacio Food & Service" is not just a fair but also a significant economic contributor to Santiago and Chile as a whole. It plays a central role in promoting both local and international trade and strengthens Chile's position as an important player in the global food industry. The event takes place at the easily accessible and modernly equipped Espacio Riesco. This venue, located in the vibrant metropolis of Santiago, creates ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors alike, making the fair an indispensable event in the food industry calendar. In conclusion, the Espacio Food & Service is more than just a fair; it is a comprehensive experience that recurs annually, always focusing on innovation and quality.

The Anuga Select India - hosted under the trade name ANUFOOD India in Mumbai until 2023, is a prestigious international trade fair and conference for the food and beverage industry. Since its inception in 2005, the fair has established itself as a key meeting point for the food and beverage industry. Its annual occurrence, usually in August or September, attracts countless professional visitors to the Bombay Exhibition Centre. This state-of-the-art exhibition center in the heart of Mumbai is easily accessible and is one of the most important exhibition centers in India. The fair is organized by Koelnmesse Pvt. Ltd., modeled after the Anuga in Cologne. It offers a wide range of products and services, ranging from agricultural products to meat, poultry, dairy products, hot beverages, and organic and plant-based products. Special topics like Halal, nutrition, bread, baked goods, confectionery, snacks, and gastronomy complement the portfolio. This event highlights the growing relevance of the food and beverage industry in India, especially in Mumbai, a dynamic trading and business center. It serves not only as a platform for presenting new products but also as a networking and contact exchange, as well as a launch pad for exporters looking to conquer the flourishing Indian market. The exhibitors cover a wide spectrum, from agricultural producers to beverage suppliers. The main visitors include industry experts, wholesalers, retailers, restaurateurs, and representatives of associations and institutions. In conclusion, Anuga Select India offers not just an insight into the latest trends and innovations in the industry but also an invaluable opportunity for initiating and deepening business relationships.

"Ingredients, Additives & Materials" is India’s leading trade fair dedicated to innovative ingredients, additives, and functional materials for the food industry. Held annually at the renowned Bombay Exhibition Centre in Mumbai, the event brings together key players from across the entire value chain. Organized by Koelnmesse Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai, the fair offers a comprehensive overview of the latest trends, products, and technologies in food safety, nutrition, sensory quality, and convenience. Ingredients, Additives & Materials stands for a forward-looking and secure food market. The fair demonstrates how modern ingredients and additives contribute to the production of safe, appealing, and consistently high-quality food products that meet consumers’ sensory expectations—from taste and appearance to texture and nutritional value. At "Ingredients, Additives & Materials", numerous innovative exhibitors from the food, beverage, bakery, confectionery, convenience food, dairy, and dietary supplement sectors showcase their latest products, solutions, and services. The exhibition covers everything from functional ingredients and clean-label solutions to natural colors, flavors, and texturizers, as well as technological innovations for safe, sustainable, and efficient food production. As a key industry meeting point, "Ingredients, Additives & Materials" maintains a strong connection to the city of Mumbai and the Indian food sector. The fair addresses the growing demand for safe and diverse food products in the domestic market, while also fostering valuable collaborations between international players and local manufacturers. The main visitors to the fair come from food manufacturing, product development, quality management, research and development, procurement, and the packaging and logistics sectors. Ingredients, Additives & Materials is therefore essential for anyone seeking innovative solutions to the challenges of modern food production. The Bombay Exhibition Centre is conveniently located in the heart of Mumbai, with excellent connections to public transportation, the international airport, and the city center. It offers state-of-the-art infrastructure for both exhibitors and visitors. Ingredients, Additives & Materials is not only a specialized platform for innovations in ingredients and additives, but also the central meeting point for all those who wish to shape the future of the food industry in India and beyond. Mumbai, as a dynamic economic hub, together with the easily accessible exhibition center, provides the ideal setting for this event.

The "Food Safety & Sustainability" trade fair is regarded as the leading platform for innovative solutions and developments in the fields of food safety and sustainable food production in the rapidly growing metropolis of Mumbai. Organized by the renowned Koelnmesse Pvt. Ltd., "Food Safety & Sustainability" takes place annually at the modern Bombay Exhibition Centre, one of India’s most prominent venues with excellent transport connections. Situated in the heart of Mumbai’s vibrant business district, a key hub for trade, the food industry, and start-ups, "Food Safety & Sustainability" showcases the latest technologies, products, and services for safe, healthy, and sustainable nutrition. "Food Safety & Sustainability" addresses central industry trends such as increasing health awareness, demographic change, and rising healthcare costs, demonstrating how companies can achieve sustainable success through preventive measures and adapted production concepts. Exhibitors represent sectors including food production, analytics, packaging, logistics, chemicals, and technology, presenting innovative approaches from clean-label solutions and convenience products to advanced testing methods. The main visitors are decision-makers and professionals from the food and beverage industry, retail, research, quality management, production, procurement, as well as representatives from politics and associations, all seeking new partners, processes, and inspiration for sustainable value creation. The Bombay Exhibition Centre impresses with its modern infrastructure and central location, easily accessible from the international airport, main railway station, and metro. 개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Street Food Business Expo , formerly known as "Street Food Live", is considered the premier European event for the vibrant world of street food. "Street Food" refers to dishes that are sold on the streets - a tradition rooted in many cultures around the world that has, in recent times, evolved into a defining trend in the culinary industry. The event takes place annually in October or November at the prestigious ExCeL London, one of the city's most prominent exhibition centers. Since its inception, the Street Food Business Expo has established itself as the industry's key gathering spot, attracting thousands of enthusiasts each year. The event is organized by Fortem Food and Drink Ltd., a company with extensive expertise in the food and beverage sector. Central themes of the expo include innovations in street food, catering, franchising, and many other current trends of this dynamic industry. Exhibitors from all over Europe showcase their offerings - from food and beverages to equipment and franchising opportunities. Particularly noteworthy are the exclusive seminars conducted by leading innovators of the sector. ExCeL London stands out for its excellent accessibility and state-of-the-art infrastructure. Visitors can look forward to a comprehensive and innovative program that promises deep insights into two of the UK's fastest-growing sectors. London is distinguished by its diverse and buzzing street food landscape. Throughout the city, one can find an impressive array of international delicacies served by street vendors. In addition to well-established spots like the Borough Market , Camden Market , and Flat Iron Square , there are also frequent pop-up events and food trucks that spontaneously appear in various neighborhoods. Many of these mobile vendors utilize social media to update on their current locations and daily specials. Overall, London's diverse street food offerings reflect the city's rich cultural mix, making it a true haven for gourmet enthusiasts and those wishing to explore international delicacies without leaving town. In conclusion, the Street Food Business Expo not only mirrors the dynamism and innovative power of the street food sector but also provides industry professionals with an excellent platform for networking, learning, and discovering new business opportunities.

COSME Week OSAKA is the leading B2B trade fair for the cosmetics and beauty industry in western Japan and ranks among the region's foremost platforms for product development, sourcing and business networking within the Asian cosmetics market. Held annually at INTEX Osaka International Exhibition Center, one of Japan's largest and most modern exhibition venues, the event is organised by RX Japan Ltd., one of Asia's leading trade fair organisers, renowned for staging internationally recognised exhibitions and connecting businesses from around the world. COSME Week OSAKA brings together the specialist exhibitions COSME Tech OSAKA and COSME OSAKA under one roof, showcasing the entire cosmetics industry value chain. From innovative raw materials and active ingredients to research, development, OEM/ODM manufacturing, finished beauty products, packaging solutions and modern marketing strategies, trade visitors gain comprehensive insight into every segment of the industry in a single venue. As a result, the exhibition serves not only as a showcase for the latest product innovations but also as an international sourcing and business platform for manufacturers, brand owners and trading companies. The exhibition highlights the latest developments in skincare, make-up, haircare, body care, natural and organic cosmetics, men's grooming, perfumery, nail care, and professional beauty equipment for both salon and home use. The product range is further complemented by health and beauty supplements, functional foods, beauty drinks, diet products and CBD products. In addition, exhibitors present cosmetic raw materials, innovative ingredients and formulations, manufacturing and filling technologies, sustainable packaging solutions, containers, packaging design, branding and marketing concepts, as well as services for sales, distribution and international business development. Particular emphasis is placed on innovations in sustainable materials, advanced manufacturing processes and next-generation beauty technologies. The exhibition plays a significant role in both the Japanese and wider Asian cosmetics markets, as Japan is internationally recognised as one of the world's leading centres for premium cosmetics, innovative skincare and cutting-edge beauty technologies. Osaka, in particular, has established itself as a major commercial and business hub, providing international companies with an ideal gateway to the Japanese market and the rapidly expanding markets across Asia. COSME Week OSAKA creates the ideal environment for this by bringing together manufacturers, suppliers, brands, distributors and buyers from numerous countries while actively promoting the development of international business partnerships. Among the event's key highlights are the launch of numerous new products and technological innovations, direct access to leading manufacturers and developers, and extensive networking opportunities for international business professionals. Particular emphasis is placed on business matching, the establishment of new OEM and private label partnerships, and the presentation of the latest market trends. Exhibitors represent virtually every sector of the cosmetics and beauty industry. They include cosmetics manufacturers, raw material suppliers, OEM and ODM companies, packaging manufacturers, producers of beauty equipment, providers of laboratory and manufacturing technologies, marketing and branding agencies, as well as trading and logistics companies. Trade visitors primarily comprise representatives of international cosmetics brands, manufacturers, product developers, purchasing departments, importers, distributors, retail and drugstore chains, e-commerce businesses, and operators of beauty salons, spas and aesthetic clinics. COSME Week OSAKA also forms part of the wider COSME Week exhibition series, which is held at several locations across Japan, serving different economic regions of the country. This enables exhibitors and trade visitors to benefit from broader market coverage within Japan's cosmetics industry while expanding their business networks nationwide. With its strong focus on innovation, product development, international sourcing and market expansion, COSME Week OSAKA has established itself as one of the leading meeting places for Asia's beauty industry. INTEX Osaka International Exhibition Center is located on the artificial island of Yumeshima in Osaka Bay and is easily accessible via the Osaka Metro and local bus services, as well as from Kansai International Airport and the city's major railway stations.

The White Label World Expo is a leading international trade show specializing in white label and private label products. It provides a platform for the latest innovations and trends in online retail and e-commerce and is held annually at changing venues within the USA. The trade show attracts professionals, entrepreneurs, online sellers and retailers from all over the world. White label products are generic products or services that are produced by a manufacturer and then sold to various retailers or companies. These companies market and sell the products under their own brand and packaging. The actual producer remains in the background and is not directly associated with the end customer. White label products offer benefits to both the manufacturer and the marketing company: manufacturers benefit from steady sales of their products, while marketing companies enjoy lower development costs and faster time to market. Organized by Fortem International Ltd., White Label World Expo covers a wide range of topics relevant to the e-commerce industry, including product sourcing, online sales, marketing strategies and customer service. The exhibition showcases a variety of products and services in areas such as home and kitchen, apparel, footwear, jewelry, pet supplies, health and household, beauty and personal care, food and beverage, toys and games, tech and electronics, vape and office supplies. A highlight of the exhibition are the diverse seminars, product presentation areas and the e-market research center. The Innovation Awards recognise companies that have made a significant impact in the world of product sourcing and white label retail, while the Industry Awards recognise exhibitors who have excelled in innovative and leading products in the online retail market. The show's exhibitors come from a wide range of industries, underlining the diversity and breadth of the offering. The show's main target audience is primarily online sellers, retailers, entrepreneurs and distributors from the respective industries. The White Label World Expo is part of a series of trade fairs held in different locations around the world, with each fair having its own local character and peculiarities.

360 Food Syria is much more than a traditional trade exhibition – it serves as the key showcase for the entire food industry in Syria. With its holistic concept, the event offers a comprehensive 360-degree perspective on the sector’s full value chain: from agriculture and food processing to packaging, hospitality and logistics. The name reflects not only a symbolic commitment to this all-encompassing view, but a concrete focus on presenting the full spectrum of products, technologies and innovations shaping the industry. The event is organised by EVEX Events , a leading event management company based in Riyadh, renowned for delivering high-calibre international trade fairs. Drawing on its extensive experience, EVEX brings to Damascus – specifically to the Damascus Fairgrounds – a format tailored to meet the specific needs of the Syrian market, both in terms of content and execution. 360 Food Syria provides a highly specialised platform for industry professionals operating in food and beverages, HoReCa, food technology, agriculture and sustainability. Exhibits range from dairy products, oils, snacks and grains to meat and poultry, baked goods and organic foods. These are complemented by the latest technologies in packaging, processing, ingredients, food safety, cold chain management, automation and robotics. A particularly forward-looking feature of the show is the Sustainability & Innovation zone, which addresses key issues such as eco-friendly packaging, waste reduction, recycling, renewable energy and alternative protein sources. This segment not only offers valuable insights into current market developments but also helps drive progress towards a more resilient and future-proof food security landscape in the region. Exhibitors represent a broad cross-section of industries – including food producers, agricultural businesses, machinery manufacturers, packaging specialists, logistics providers and suppliers of kitchen and catering equipment. The visitor profile is equally diverse and includes buyers, traders, producers, restaurateurs, hoteliers, and decision-makers from industry, commerce and public institutions. As a strictly trade-only event, 360 Food Syria ensures high-quality networking and targeted knowledge exchange. The venue – Damascus Fairgrounds – enjoys a strategic location in the Syrian capital and is easily accessible by car and public transport. The spacious exhibition site offers modern infrastructure, expansive display areas and a professional setting designed to foster successful business relationships.

The "GENUSS der SINNE" fair in Reichenau an der Rax is a vibrant showcase for enthusiasts of beauty, fashion, accessories, jewelry, cosmetics, leisure activities, sports, and healthy eating. Since its inception in 2022, it has evolved into a significant event on the trade fair calendar, occurring biannually in spring and autumn. Under the leadership of the dedicated fair team, Karl Christof & Daniela Graf, this event brings together a diverse array of regional, national, and international exhibitors showcasing their products, primarily from organic cultivation, and handmade crafts. The fair spans a wide spectrum and attracts visitors from all over Austria, including Lower Austria, Vienna, Burgenland, Styria, Upper Austria, and Carinthia. It offers a unique opportunity to immerse oneself in a universe of pleasure with all senses - from flavors to Swiss stone pine products. Visitors have the chance to sample and purchase a plethora of products directly at the booths. The range includes baked goods, wine, beer, honey, meats and sausages, cheese, fruit spreads, fruit juices, mustard, vinegar, oils, and even flavors, herbs, and fruits. A special focus is on the range of products and services in the realms of beauty, fashion, accessories, jewelry, and cosmetics, as well as leisure activities, sports, and healthy eating. By presenting predominantly organic and handmade products, the "GENUSS der SINNE" fair emphasizes awareness for sustainable and high-quality goods. In addition to the diverse exhibition offer, visitors can attend informative lectures, ranging from testing the latest orthopedic sleep systems to personalized nutritional advice. These additional offerings add extra value to the fair and provide visitors with a comprehensive experience. The picturesque Reichenau Castle serves as the venue, with its impressive architecture and surrounding greenery providing the perfect backdrop for this event. The castle is easily accessible by public transport and car, with ample parking available. The combination of the historic castle setting and the fair's varied offerings creates a unique atmosphere, making "GENUSS der SINNE" an unforgettable experience.

The Fruit Attraction is one of the most significant international trade fairs for the fruit and vegetable sector, held annually at the Feria de Madrid, Spain's capital. Every October, this prestigious event becomes a hub for professionals across the fruit sector's entire value chain. It gathers producers, marketers, distributors, retailers, and other industry experts to explore the latest trends, innovations, and technologies. Spain ranks amongst the top producers and exporters of fruits and vegetables in both Europe and globally. Staples such as citrus fruits, olives, grapes, tomatoes, and peppers, vital for many nations, are predominantly sourced from Spain. The tradition of cultivating fruits and vegetables is deeply ingrained in Spanish culture. Various regions and communities in Spain have preserved unique varieties and cultivation techniques passed down through generations. Over the past few decades, the sector has made significant investments in research and development. These investments aim to enhance productivity, champion sustainable farming practices, and elevate product quality. Of late, there's been a pronounced emphasis on adopting sustainable farming techniques, with the objective of minimising the ecological footprint and preserving biodiversity. This shift is apparent in the rising number of farms that are both organic and environmentally-conscious. The Fruit Attraction occupies several halls within the Feria de Madrid, enabling exhibitors, both national and international, to present their products and services to a diverse audience. The event's scope isn't limited to the buying and selling of fresh produce. It also includes the introduction of machinery, technologies, packaging solutions, and other services pertinent to the fruit industry. Furthermore, the Fruit Attraction emphasises the exchange of knowledge and networking. A comprehensive program of lectures, seminars, and workshops ensures participants are updated on current market insights, consumer trends, and sustainable farming approaches. In essence, the Fruit Attraction at the Feria de Madrid isn't merely a trade fair. It serves as an expansive platform, consolidating stakeholders from the fruit and vegetable sector, fostering business collaborations, and offering a unique lens through which one can observe the nuances of this vibrant market.

The "Wellness & Preventive Healthcare Expo" , a leading health event in Japan, takes place at the prestigious Makuhari Messe in Chiba near Tokyo and is an integral part of MEDICAL JAPAN Tokyo. In summary, the "Wellness & Preventive Healthcare Expo" is not only a showcase for health technologies and products but also a significant platform for knowledge exchange and the advancement of the health industry.

The "Nature and Health Fair" in Ljubljana is an international trade show specializing in healthy nutrition and lifestyle. In summary, the "Nature and Health Fair" in Ljubljana is more than just a trade show. It's an experience, a source of inspiration, and a gathering place for everyone committed to a healthy and sustainable lifestyle. Anyone keen on exploring the latest trends and developments in this field shouldn't miss out on attending this annual event.

The "Bazaar of Nations" is one of the highlights of "infa" in Hannover - an annual fair held every October, organized by the prestigious German Messe AG. The Hannover Exhibition Grounds, renowned for its impressive halls and excellent infrastructure, serve as the perfect venue for this event. At the Bazaar of Nations, visitors can embark on a journey around the world without ever leaving the exhibition grounds. They immerse themselves in a world filled with colors, fragrances, and flavors from various countries. This presents a rare opportunity to acquire unique products - ranging from clothing, scarves, accessories, and jewelry to handicrafts, tea, spices, ceramics, and decorative items - directly from the hands of their creators. For those craving a sweet break, an Italian café tempts with pastries, coffee, and authentic Italian ice cream. Another standout feature is "The Moccamaker", a charmingly designed oriental café adorned with Bedouin tents and meticulous decoration, evoking a fairy-tale ambiance. Visitors can relax here with a delicious Mocca amidst the vibrant hustle and bustle of the bazaar. However, the "Bazaar of Nations" offers more than just shopping experiences. In collaboration with the UNESCO City of Music in Hannover, a diverse international music and cultural program is showcased on stage, spanning from Capoeira and oriental belly dancing to African music. Every year, the "Bazaar of Nations" at the infa attracts countless visitors to Hannover, eager to dive into this global ambiance. The fair has not only established itself as a gathering point for culture enthusiasts and globetrotters but also as a significant platform for international exhibitors and artists.

HORECA JORDAN is a annual trade fair held at the Jordan International Exhibition Center in Amman, Jordan. The name "Horeca" represents the core areas of the fair: Hotels, Restaurants, and Cafés. This event is organized by Hospitality Services s.a.r.l, a well-known organization in the region. The fair has become a crucial hub for the hotel, gastronomy, and beverage industries in Jordan and beyond. It offers an extensive range of products and services, including food, frozen goods, meat and seafood varieties, beverages, packaging solutions, kitchen technology and equipment, furniture, and decorative items for restaurants and cafés, uniforms, and other hospitality-related services. A distinctive feature of HORECA JORDAN is its connection to the local culture and economy. It serves as a platform for local and international exhibitors to forge connections with professional visitors from various sectors and simultaneously reflects the culinary trends and innovations of the region. Noteworthy are the numerous attractions of the fair, such as live cooking demonstrations by renowned chefs, tastings, and competitions like the Oriental Cuisine Competition, the Jordanian Cuisine Competition, the International Cuisine Competition, Barista Competitions, and the Cocktail Zero Competition. These are complemented by conferences and live talks with industry experts. HORECA JORDAN is part of the Horeca Exhibitions Series, which also takes place in other countries in the Middle East and is among the largest of its kind in the region. Held annually in Amman, the fair primarily attracts visitors from the hotel, restaurant, and café industries. The Jordan International Exhibition Center, as a modern and well-equipped fairground, provides the ideal environment for this important industry event. In summary, HORECA JORDAN is not just an excellent platform for business relationships and knowledge exchange in the hotel, gastronomy, and beverage industries, but also a vibrant showcase of Jordan's rich culture and culinary diversity. It offers a unique opportunity to network with industry leaders, discover the latest trends, and experience the pulsating heart of hospitality in the Middle East.

BioNord is an annual trade fair for organic food, natural cosmetics, and health products. Since its inception in 2004, it has been held at Messe Hamburg. The event is organized by Matthias Deppe und Wolfram Müller OHG , a company known for creating high-quality, topic-specific platforms for the organic trade for over two decades. Each autumn, Hamburg becomes a key meeting point for the organic industry. BioNord is tailored to a professional audience, including natural food retailers, health food stores, organic supermarkets, independent retailers, the foodservice industry, and large-scale consumers. It showcases innovative products, services, and forward-thinking concepts. At its core are organic food and natural cosmetics that meet strict ecological standards and are certified according to the guidelines of the Bundesverband Naturkost Naturwaren (BNN) or the Reformhaus eG. What sets BioNord apart is its depth of content. The fair is more than just a venue for product presentation—it is a platform for dialogue. Expert talks, discussion forums, and educational campaigns address key industry topics such as sustainable packaging, resource-efficient supply chains, zero-waste shopping, and current trends in the organic sector. This creates a space for exchange, strategic inspiration, and the development of new ideas. Alongside well-known national brands, numerous regional producers, dairies, wineries, and beekeepers are represented, adding an authentic, artisanal touch to the event. The exhibition is further enriched by a dedicated area called “ReformWelt,” which features high-quality health products. This allows BioNord to serve not only the organic trade but also the health product sector and organic gastronomy. BioNord is part of a nationwide family of trade fairs, which includes BioSüd in Augsburg, BioWest in Düsseldorf, and BioOst in Leipzig. Together, these events cover the full geographic spectrum of the German organic trade—but BioNord remains distinctive thanks to its strong regional ties to Northern Germany. Messe Hamburg, with its modern infrastructure, provides ideal conditions for trade visitors from across the country. Centrally located and easily accessible by public transport, highway, or air, it offers a convenient and inspiring setting. Attending BioNord means more than visiting a trade fair—it means becoming part of a movement that connects quality, responsibility, and innovation.

개최장소(베뉴): DECC – Doha Exhibition and Convention Center
축제소개: Food Qatar is the premier trade fair for the food and beverage industry in Qatar, with influence reaching far beyond the country's borders. Each year, industry professionals gather at the state-of-the-art Doha Exhibition & Convention Center (DECC) , located in the heart of Doha, to showcase the latest developments, products, technologies, and services across the entire food value chain. As the only specialized B2B trade event of its kind in Qatar, Food Qatar offers a highly focused platform for exchange between manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, franchise partners, and industry professionals from both local and international markets. Organized by IFP Qatar – one of the region’s most experienced trade fair organizers – the event positions itself as a targeted business platform for companies looking to enter or expand within one of the Middle East’s most dynamic markets. The exhibition covers the full spectrum of the industry – from industrial processing and packaging equipment to refrigeration technologies and food packaging, as well as fresh, preserved, frozen, and organic food products. Also featured are bakery and confectionery goods, dairy products, ready-to-eat meals, beverages, fast food, snacks, and healthy nutrition concepts. The offering is further enhanced by food franchises, filling machines, and solutions for retail presentation – providing a comprehensive overview of current market trends and emerging business opportunities. Beyond its extensive product range, Food Qatar also delivers high-value content: live demonstrations, technological innovations, and presentations of new developments make the fair a showcase for cutting-edge ideas and a hub for high-level networking. Exhibitors come from a wide range of sectors, including food production and processing, packaging technology, refrigeration, franchising, logistics, and supply chain management. The primary visitors include professionals from wholesale and retail, distributors, franchisees, decision-makers from the hospitality and public sectors, as well as key players in the food industry – all united in shaping the culinary future of the region. The venue – the Doha Exhibition & Convention Center – is centrally located in West Bay, the city’s business district. In addition to its striking modern architecture, it offers excellent accessibility with direct connections to the metro system, downtown Doha, and Hamad International Airport. Visitors can expect a modern infrastructure and an inspiring environment that ensures an efficient, comfortable, and successful trade fair experience.

Food & Hospitality Queensland is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a key platform for professionals in the food and hospitality industries. Organised by National Media, one of Australia’s leading event organisers, the exhibition is specifically designed for decision-makers, innovators, and entrepreneurs from the fields of hospitality, catering, commercial foodservice, and food production – both within Queensland and beyond. Food & Hospitality Queensland is not only an abbreviation of the event’s official name but also represents the strong connection between food, hospitality, and Queensland – one of Australia’s most economically dynamic states, known for its thriving tourism and culinary sectors. The event takes place at the centrally located Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, situated in the heart of the city. The venue offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and excellent access to public transport. Each year, the fair attracts industry professionals from across the country. At the core of Food & Hospitality Queensland are current developments and forward-looking solutions in areas such as food and beverages, kitchen technology, packaging, and digital innovation in hospitality. Visitors gain practical insights into new products, services, and industry trends – ranging from locally produced specialties and energy-efficient kitchen equipment to sustainable packaging concepts and digital tools for operational efficiency. A particular highlight of the event is its diverse supporting program, which makes Food & Hospitality Queensland a dynamic industry gathering. The prestigious Queensland Chef of the Year competition showcases top culinary talent. The Brisbane Café School offers hands-on workshops for café operators, while the Aged Care Catering Summit addresses key issues in senior nutrition. The Restaurant Profit Workshop rounds out the program with actionable strategies for boosting profitability in hospitality. Exhibitors primarily come from the sectors of foodservice, food retail, hospitality, commercial kitchen equipment, and packaging. The event targets industry professionals such as restaurant owners, hoteliers, café operators, caterers, purchasing managers, head chefs, and F&B executives – those who drive investment and innovation in the sector. Brisbane, a vibrant and modern city with a growing culinary and cultural scene, provides the ideal setting for FHQ. The internationally recognised, accessible venue is easily reached by train, bus, or ferry – a place where innovation and industry networking come together at the highest level.

FoodTech Eurasia ranks among the largest and most prestigious trade fairs for food processing and safety in the Eurasian region, and is an annual highlight at the Tüyap Fair Convention & Congress Center in Istanbul. The event gathers industry leaders to present and explore the latest technologies and solutions in food production, storage, and safety. The name "FoodTech Eurasia" reflects the event's comprehensive and technological focus. Professional visitors will find a wide range of offerings, from state-of-the-art machinery for confectionery production in the "SweetTech" Zone to advanced DairyTech equipment and innovative meat processing systems in the "Meat Pro-Tech" Zone. Key themes also include the latest developments in food safety and hygiene, which attract considerable interest. Additionally, products such as chocolate making machines, homogenization systems, cutting and packaging equipment for meat products, extraction and classification systems for fruits and vegetables, cooling units for cold chains, industrial mixers, weight control systems, pasteurization systems, UHT systems, and hygiene equipment are showcased. Organized by Reed Tüyap Fairs and Exhibition Organization Inc., the fair takes place in Istanbul, a city known as a vibrant crossroads between Europe and Asia, making it an ideal venue. This location attracts not only local but also international exhibitors and visitors, offering a unique platform for networking and exchange among manufacturers, suppliers, and professionals from the food industry. Exhibitors represent various sectors, including machinery and plant engineering, as well as food technology and safety. The main visitor group consists of decision-makers, technicians, and developers from the food processing industry, as well as professionals from research and development. The Tüyap Fair Convention & Congress Center, with its central location and excellent transport links, is easily accessible and features modern infrastructure that meets the demands of international trade fairs.

The Healthplex Expo is one of the leading trade shows in Asia for the health and nutrition industry and is held at the Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center in Shenzhen. This location underscores the importance of the expo with its modern infrastructure and comprehensive capacities, providing ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors. The Healthplex Expo is organized by Sinoexpo Informa Markets in cooperation with the CCCMHPIE (China Chamber of Commerce for Import & Export of Medicines & Health Products) and the Trade Development Bureau of the Chinese Ministry of Commerce. As one of the leading trade show organizers in China, Sinoexpo Informa Markets ensures the high quality of the event in collaboration with various industry and trade chambers. The wide range of topics at the expo includes natural and nutritious products, dietetics, sports nutrition, probiotics, proteins, plant extracts, and traditional Chinese medicine. Additionally, numerous products and services are showcased, including anti-aging beauty products, facial masks, aromatherapy products, nutritional supplements for children, products for healthy pregnancy and baby food, as well as therapeutic and medical products. The offering also encompasses ginseng products, bee products, massage devices, rehabilitation training equipment, and sports and leisure equipment. The Healthplex Expo attracts professionals from the health industry, including manufacturers, retailers, importers, exporters, medical practitioners, researchers, and consultants. The venue in Shenzhen is easily accessible and offers excellent transportation links to local transport hubs and the city center. With an impressive array of products, knowledge, and networking opportunities, the Healthplex Expo is a vital meeting point for all interested in the health industry and those looking to experience the dynamic Chinese market.

Hi & Fi Asia-China is an international trade fair for food additives. The abbreviation "FI" stands for "Food Ingredients". This trade fair takes place in Shenzhen every year.
The event is organized by Sinoexpo Informa Markets International Exhibition Co., Ltd. This company has extensive experience in organizing international trade fairs and exhibitions and has established itself as one of the market leaders in the exhibition industry. The main topics of the trade fair include the latest innovations and developments in the field of food and beverage additives. Exhibitors have the opportunity to present their most innovative products to decision-makers in the industry. The spectrum of products presented at the trade fair ranges from food additives and ingredients to food processing technologies, packaging solutions and much more.
In addition, the trade fair offers a platform for specialist lectures, discussions and networking opportunities. The trade fair is of great importance for both national and international manufacturers as it offers a platform for introducing their brands to the dynamically growing Chinese market. Highlights of the show include new product and innovation launches, networking events, and various competitions and awards ceremonies to recognize outstanding products and companies in the industry.
However, the exact highlights may vary from year to year. Exhibitors at the show come from a variety of industries, including food and beverage manufacturing, food technology and processing, packaging and distribution. Key visitors are usually buyers, distributors and decision makers from the same industries.
Hi & Fi Asia-China is part of a series of FI shows held worldwide, including locations in Europe, the Americas and other parts of Asia.

The Food Long Life Japan (LLj) in Tokyo is an annual event held every October, focusing on the latest technologies and innovations in food preservation. Organized by Informa Markets Japan Co Ltd, one of the country's leading trade show organizers, this exhibition serves as a platform for professionals, manufacturers, researchers, and decision-makers in the food industry to come together and showcase their latest discoveries and products. The expo emphasizes promoting technologies that not only extend the shelf life of food products but also maintain their taste and quality. Given the global challenge of food wastage, the significance of the LLj expo is undeniable. The event provides a platform to reduce losses in the food sector and promote the efficient use of previously untapped resources. Exhibitors have the opportunity to present their latest products, research findings, and business developments in thematic sessions. This includes innovative food additives like longevity enhancers, preservatives, antioxidants, enzymes, and pH regulators. Advanced production equipment such as drying machines, sterilizers, and systems for production control and inventory management are also showcased. Another crucial area covered is packaging technology, including vacuum and gas-replacement packaging, barrier containers, and oxygen scavengers. Moreover, visitors can acquaint themselves with state-of-the-art analytical and measurement instruments, from oxygen transmissometers to pH meters. The event is hosted at the impressive Tokyo Big Sight , one of Japan's largest exhibition and conference centers. Located in the heart of Tokyo, it boasts cutting-edge facilities and an excellent infrastructure for international exhibitors and visitors. Every year, the expo attracts thousands of attendees, ranging from professionals and businesspeople to enthusiasts eager to learn more about the latest trends in food technology. In conclusion, the Food Long Life Japan exhibition in Tokyo is an indispensable event for all those passionate about the future of the food industry and combatting food wastage. It's not just an opportunity to discover the latest innovations, but also a hub for exchange, collaboration, and growth.

FiT Japan is the country’s premier trade fair for food ingredients, additives, and technological advancements in the food industry. Held annually at the renowned Tokyo Big Sight exhibition center, it brings together national and international experts to showcase the latest trends and innovations in flavor, quality, and sustainability within the food sector. The event is organized by Informa Markets Japan Co., Ltd. , a globally recognized leader in trade fairs and business platforms. The unique significance of FiT Japan lies in its focused approach to technologies and solutions that not only enhance taste but also ensure product quality throughout the entire value chain. As the only exhibition in Japan dedicated specifically to the functional impact and technological evolution of food ingredients, FiT Japan serves as a key meeting point for product developers, buyers, R&D departments, and decision-makers in the global food and beverage industry. FiT Japan covers a broad yet clearly defined range of topics, spanning from food additives such as sweeteners, flavorings, natural colorants, gelling and acidifying agents to natural ingredients like grains, legumes, herbs, fermented products, and alternative raw materials. Cutting-edge technologies for the sensory evaluation of taste, texture, aroma, and appearance are also featured – including aroma analyzers, texture measurement devices, colorimeters, and specialized software for taste testing. A particular highlight is the dedicated area for fermented ingredients, where the health benefits and flavor-enhancing potential of fermented raw materials are placed in the spotlight. Complementing this is a forward-looking special exhibition on alternative materials, addressing challenges such as resource scarcity and rising raw material costs. Exhibitors represent the entire food production value chain – from raw material manufacturers and technology providers to service partners in contract manufacturing and OEM. Visitors primarily include professionals from product development, quality assurance, research, and procurement – both from Japan and international markets. The event is aimed at key decision-makers in food processing, beverage production, distribution, and retail. As part of the global "Fi" (Food Ingredients) event portfolio – with sister shows in Europe, China, and Southeast Asia – FiT Japan is not only a leading event in Japan but also an integral part of the international food industry network. It plays a vital role in advancing the global food sector, with a particular emphasis on the Asian market and Japan’s strong innovation capabilities. Tokyo Big Sight, Japan’s largest and most modern exhibition complex, is conveniently accessible from both Haneda International Airport and central Tokyo. Situated in the heart of this dynamic metropolis and global innovation hub, FiT Japan provides the ideal platform for dialogue on the future of food.

The Safety and Technology (S-tec) Japan in Tokyo, which takes place annually in October, has established itself as Japan's leading and sole trade fair for food safety and quality control. It is organized by Informa Markets Japan Co Ltd and is held at the prestigious Tokyo Big Sight, one of the country's most renowned exhibition centers. In recent years, there has been a growing awareness of food safety in Japan. The S-tec Japan covers a wide range of areas: from analysis and inspection to safety and hygiene, technologies for powdered and liquid foods, and even environmental technologies and packaging techniques. A particular focus of the exhibition is on the latest technological developments and solutions required by the food industry. Exhibitors have the opportunity to showcase their latest products, research findings, and business developments. One of the event's highlights is the special exhibitor presentations, where leading companies offer insights into the latest trends, such as AI technology or rapid hygiene inspection techniques. S-tec Japan attracts a multitude of professionals from the food industry, from producers and researchers to quality assurance teams. It's not just a platform for networking and forging business relationships; it also offers informative special conferences with renowned speakers discussing advancements in food safety, quality control, marketing trends, and much more. The venue, Tokyo Big Sight, boasts impressive infrastructure with state-of-the-art facilities and is easily accessible, which adds to the appeal of the event and attracts visitors from all over Japan and beyond. In conclusion, S-tec Japan in Tokyo is a must-attend for all professionals in the food industry. It's not just a showcase for the latest innovations and trends but also a place where knowledge is shared, networks are established, and future business opportunities are shaped.

The Hi Japan in Tokyo is an annual exhibition held every October, dedicated to showcasing innovative technologies and solutions in the realms of flavor, texture, and color of food products. Organized by Informa Markets Japan Co Ltd, it stands as a flagship event and has established itself as the leading exhibition in Japan, focusing on the perpetual pursuit of culinary excellence in the food industry. Hi Japan brings together an impressive array of vendors, presenting both traditional and futuristic ingredients and technologies aimed at enhancing the flavor and texture of foods. From savory to sweet flavor profiles, extending to methods of flavor preservation, the expo serves as a true melting pot of culinary innovations. Central to the expo are themes such as food additives, which include seasonings, sweeteners, gelling agents, natural pigments, and much more. Natural ingredients ranging from fruits and vegetables to grains, beans, herbs, spices, and fermented goods are showcased. Moreover, assessment technologies are introduced, including devices like flavor and odor sensors, aroma analyzers, and texture measurement tools, along with advanced manufacturing methods such as vacuum distillation, freeze-drying, and high-pressure processing. In addition to exhibitor presentations, where new products and research findings are unveiled, Hi Japan hosts special conferences featuring eminent speakers. Here, the latest advancements in ingredient technology, marketing trends, and progress in food safety and quality control are discussed. Hi Japan is hosted at the prestigious Tokyo Big Sight, an imposing exhibition and conference center located in the heart of Tokyo. The venue offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and is home to some of Japan's most significant trade fairs and events. Over recent years, the significance of Hi Japan has been on a continuous rise. With every iteration, it attracts a growing number of attendees, including development professionals, food service providers, and traders from both domestic and international circles. Hi Japan not only represents the future of food technology and innovation in Japan but also sets standards for the global food industry. It's a must-attend for anyone passionate about culinary innovations and future trends in the food and beverage sector.

The China Xiamen International Tea Fair is one of the world’s leading trade fairs for the tea industry, serving as a key platform for innovation, commerce and cultural exchange centred on tea. The event takes place at the Xiamen International Conference & Exhibition Center, one of the largest and most technologically advanced exhibition venues in Southeast China. It is hosted in the coastal city of Xiamen, an ideal location thanks to its historical significance in the global tea trade and its position within the renowned tea-growing region of Fujian. Since its inception in 2010, the fair has been organised by Xiamen Jinhongxin Exhibition Co., Ltd., an experienced organiser specialising in international trade exhibitions. Held twice a year, typically in spring and autumn, the China Xiamen International Tea Fair consistently reflects the latest industry trends, innovations and market developments. It covers the full spectrum of the tea sector—from traditional and contemporary tea products to machinery, packaging solutions, tea culture, design and tourism. Particularly notable is the breadth of products on display, ranging from premium green, black, white and oolong teas to rare specialities such as Tie Guan Yin and Da Hong Pao. The offering is complemented by tea ware made from ceramics, glass and bamboo, innovative accessories, and advanced machinery for processing, packaging and quality control. A key strength of the fair lies in its clear structure and thematic organisation. Distinct exhibition zones provide focused orientation while creating space for innovation, including new tea beverages, sustainable packaging concepts and holistic design solutions related to tea. At the same time, the fair serves as a cultural platform where traditional Chinese tea artistry meets contemporary interpretations. Exhibitors represent the entire tea value chain, including tea producers, machinery manufacturers, packaging companies, designers, and providers in tea tourism and lifestyle sectors. The visitor profile is equally diverse: buyers, importers, wholesalers, hospitality professionals, brand developers and investors all attend with a view to business development, market intelligence and networking. The fair’s close ties to the Fujian region lend it a strong sense of authenticity, as tea has been produced, traded and culturally embedded here for centuries. This heritage, combined with modern infrastructure and an international outlook, makes the event truly distinctive. With excellent transport links—including an international airport, high-speed rail connections and well-developed urban infrastructure—the venue is easily accessible for international visitors while offering an attractive setting on China’s southeast coast.

The FARMER Expo in Chișinău is a prestigious annual event held every October at the MoldExpo International Exhibition Center. It is organized and supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Regional Development, and Environment of the Republic of Moldova. This trade fair serves as a central platform where leading national and international players in the agricultural sector converge. As the cornerstone of agro-industrial developments in Moldova, FARMER showcases the latest advancements in agricultural products, equipment, and technologies. The event goes beyond merely presenting products, but also celebrates the achievements and successes of the most efficient agricultural enterprises from all regions of the country. Furthermore, the expo provides a platform to discuss current issues, share positive experiences, and devise future strategies for the industry. The MoldExpo International Exhibition Center, the venue for the fair, is not just a striking location for such a significant event but also offers an ideal environment for business activities. Within the scope of the expo, pertinent topics are addressed against the backdrop of current challenges in agriculture and global trends. Accompanying international conferences, seminars, and round tables provide attendees with additional opportunities to learn about the latest products and market trends. A distinctive feature of the expo is the participation of numerous international companies introducing their innovative products and services. This promotes interaction between local and international stakeholders and contributes to the expansion of business partnerships as well as networking with financial institutions, industrial companies, and academic institutions from the Republic of Moldova and beyond. In conclusion, the FARMER Expo in Chișinău is a hub for innovation, collaboration, and progress in Moldova's agricultural sector, making an indispensable contribution to the development and strengthening of agriculture in the region.

The "GENUSSWELTEN"in Vienna is more than just a fair – it is an annual celebration for everyone who appreciates fine food and quality beverages. Twice a year, "Genusswelten" presents a unique combination of trade fair and public exhibition, making this culinary event appealing to gourmets and industry professionals as well as interested food lovers who want to discover, experience, and taste exquisite specialties. With carefully selected exhibitors, the fair provides an exclusive opportunity to explore both regional and international delights. From fine cheeses, freshly baked bread, and artisan pastries to rare teas, select spices, refined condiments, and exquisite wines, beers, and spirits – connoisseurs will find a feast for the senses. Direct encounters between producers and visitors foster trust and offer authentic insights into the origins, quality, and craftsmanship behind the products. A varied supporting program enhances the experience: live cooking shows reveal the art of culinary craftsmanship, interactive workshops deepen knowledge about preparation and taste, and exclusive tastings invite visitors to discover and indulge. Seasonal theme worlds add variety and give each edition its own distinctive character. GENUSSWELTEN is the meeting place for all who wish to experience food and drink with all their senses – informative, delightful, and authentic.

The Dairy Industry Expo, initiated by Benison Media in 2016, is an annual trade fair that delves deeply into the entire value chain of the dairy industry and its processing sector. Often simply abbreviated as "DIE", the event's name represents a specialized platform facilitating the exchange of expert knowledge, showcasing new innovations and technologies, and fostering business connections within the industry. At the Dairy Industry Expo, a multitude of topics spanning the entire dairy sector are addressed: from animal genetics and dairy farming technology to milk processing, food processing techniques, and other specialized technologies. A plethora of products and services are showcased, including infrastructure, genetics, milking machinery, animal health, feed technology, packaging, quality assurance, refrigeration technology, automation, energy production, and waste management. The exhibitors represent a diverse range of sectors: from breeders and dairy farmers to producers of value-added products, dairy cooperatives, consultants, feed technology specialists, packaging companies, and research institutions. The audience primarily consists of dairy industry professionals, decision-makers, retailers, and veterinarians. Moreover, the expo serves as a platform for both national and international brands to introduce their latest innovations. A particular highlight of the event is the portrayal of the current market scenario in India's dairy sector and discussions about future trends and developments.

The SIAL Paris, a biennial trade fair first held in 1964, is recognized as the world's leading food exhibition. Exclusively for professionals in the food industry, it takes place in even-numbered years each October at the prestigious Paris-Nord Villepinte Exhibition Center. Organized by Comexposium, one of the world's leading event organizers, the fair underscores the significance and global influence of the SIAL. As a global platform, SIAL Paris offers a unique opportunity to explore the latest innovations and trends in the food industry. Exhibitors from around the world showcase a wide range of products—ranging from frozen foods and ready-made meals to organic goods and specialty products for specific dietary needs, such as gluten-free or dietetic foods. Special emphasis is placed on sustainability and sustainable development, which are becoming increasingly important. Companies focusing on these aspects receive particular attention, making the fair a crucial platform for forward-looking business practices. Among the highlights of the exhibition is the In-Food Centre, where semi-finished products, ingredients, and equipment for food processing are showcased. Another key attraction is the "La Cuisine" area, which draws visitors with live culinary demonstrations, a VIP restaurant, and a culinary photo exhibition. Located near Paris, the Paris-Nord Villepinte Exhibition Center provides excellent infrastructure and is easily accessible, making it an ideal venue for international visitors. With a comprehensive range of topics and products, SIAL Paris sets the standard in the food industry, offering an unparalleled opportunity for professionals to network, learn, and be inspired.

VeggieWorld in MesseHalle Hamburg-Schnelsen is the leading and largest trade and public fair focused on the vegan lifestyle, held annually in Hamburg. Since its founding in 2016, the event, organized by Wellfairs GmbH , has established itself as an essential platform for those interested in vegan nutrition, sustainability, and conscious living. It brings together industry professionals from the food and cosmetics sectors and private visitors who are looking to be inspired by the diversity of vegan products. The MesseHalle Hamburg-Schnelsen , a modern venue with excellent infrastructure and accessibility, provides the perfect setting to showcase the global spectrum of vegan innovations. In addition to cutting-edge products such as dairy and meat alternatives , superfoods , vegan sweets , cosmetics , and sustainable fashion and lifestyle items , the fair emphasizes direct engagement with manufacturers. Visitors can have personal conversations at the stands, gaining deeper insights into the production processes , ingredients , and health benefits of the featured products. VeggieWorld is more than just a trade fair. It offers an extensive supporting program with free lectures , interactive workshops , and exciting cooking shows , inviting participants to join in and discover new ideas for a sustainable vegan lifestyle. These interactive events turn the fair into a vibrant experience for all the senses, allowing visitors to explore veganism as a life philosophy that promotes joy, awareness, and sustainability . The unique combination of diverse product worlds , personal exchanges with manufacturers, and an inspiring event program makes VeggieWorld Hamburg an unparalleled experience—whether you're a newcomer, curious explorer, or long-time advocate of the vegan lifestyle.

개최장소(베뉴): RICEC Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center

It provides a platform on which exhibitors can present their latest products, technologies, and services in the field of food production, processing, and packaging to a wide audience. The name of the exhibition, "Saudi Agrofood," combines the terms "Agriculture" and "Food," thereby elucidating the thematic focuses of the event: the entire production cycle of foodstuffs, from agriculture to consumption. The exhibition firmly resides in the capital city of Riyadh and takes place in the renowned RICEC (Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center), known as the vibrant heart for business events in the region. The Saudi Agrofood is organized annually by REC (Riyadh Exhibitions Company Ltd.), which has made a name for itself by organizing a variety of successful events. The main topics of the exhibition cover a broad spectrum, ranging from raw materials and ingredients, through processing and packaging technologies, to final products like confectioneries, baked goods, and beverages, all of which hit the pulse of the industry and meet consumer tastes. Exhibitors from various sectors, including production, processing, packaging, and food distribution, convene to showcase their innovations, services, and products. The range of products displayed spans from food technologies, various foods, and beverages, to specialized solutions for food processing and packaging. The exhibition primarily attracts trade visitors from various sectors, such as food manufacturing, catering, hotel and restaurant industry, as well as retail and wholesale traders. It thus forms an interactive network that promotes business relationships and stimulates technological advancement. In the context of the country and, especially, the city of Riyadh, Saudi Agrofood reflects the rapid development and modernization of the Saudi food industry by underpinning national and international business relationships and promoting the exchange of new technologies and ideas. Riyadh, as an exhibition location, not only offers a strategically advantageous location, easily accessible from various international locales but also an impressive cultural and economic backdrop in which tradition and progress enter into a unique symbiosis. The RICEC as a venue, central yet imposing, provides state-of-the-art facilities and technologies and ensures an efficient, comfortable, and inspiring exhibition experience for both exhibitors and visitors. Overall, Saudi Agrofood represents an indispensable event that significantly contributes to illuminating, discussing, and advancing developments, challenges, and opportunities in the food industry in Saudi Arabia and beyond.

Held annually in October, the "Seafood Show Latin America" is a prestigious industry gathering with a focus on the Latin American seafood trade. Since its inception in 2022, it has quickly established itself as a central platform for the fish market in Brazil and is the first event to highlight the commercial fish exchange across the entire continent. It's organized by Francal Feiras, the leading trade fair organizer in Brazil, in collaboration with "Seafood Brasil," a crucial communication platform aimed at increasing fish consumption. The fair's objective is to create business opportunities throughout the entire production chain. This includes producers, suppliers, slaughterhouses, retailers, wholesalers, gastronomic establishments, importers, exporters, and machinery manufacturers. The event covers a broad spectrum of topics spanning the entire food sector: from fresh and frozen fish to processed products and canned goods, specialized tools, and by-products such as skin, scales, flour, and oil. Additionally, in the technology sector, comprehensive solutions ranging from storage and packaging, gastronomic equipment, logistics to automation and traceability are showcased. A particular highlight of the "Seafood Show Latin America" is its venue: The Pro Magno Centro de Eventos in São Paulo, a modern and spacious exhibition center boasting state-of-the-art facilities and excellent infrastructure. Each year, the fair attracts a remarkable number of visitors, including professionals, decision-makers, and enthusiasts from the fish and seafood sector. In summary, the "Seafood Show Latin America" is not just an opportunity to conduct business and network but also an outstanding showcase for innovations and advancements in the entire Latin American seafood trade. It's undoubtedly an essential event for anyone involved in or interested in the fish industry.

The "Bakery and Confectionery Industry" trade fair, an international highlight in the confectionery and bakery industry, is held annually at the International Exhibition Center (IEC) in Kyiv. Organized by the Kyiv International Contract Fair, it serves as a central meeting point for experts and enthusiasts from the bakery and confectionery sectors. It reflects significant trends in both the global and Ukrainian markets and plays a crucial role in advancing the national bakery industry. The event's focal point is the presentation of the latest achievements and technologies. It showcases state-of-the-art manufacturing machinery and exquisite ingredients that captivate every professional visitor. The fair acts as a showcase for products and services and promotes the exchange of ideas and innovations. Additionally, seminars and conferences provide deeper insights into the industry. The main themes of the fair include the latest developments and innovations in the bakery and confectionery fields. These encompass new technologies and equipment for production, innovative ingredients and raw materials, advanced packaging and labeling solutions, as well as systems for quality assurance and hygiene. The fair attracts numerous exhibitors from various segments of the bakery and confectionery industries and is primarily visited by professionals and specialists. It supports the development of the national industry and introduces the latest Ukrainian trends. As part of the International Forum for Food Industry and Packaging (IFFIP), the fair takes place concurrently with the Pack Fair, Foodtechmash, and Food Expo Ukraine, offering a comprehensive overview of the entire production cycle. In summary, the "Bakery and Confectionery Industry" fair is an integral part of the industry, combining local and international perspectives. The easily accessible and well-equipped IEC in Kyiv provides the ideal setting for this significant industry event.

The "Food Expo", an annual international trade fair for food and beverages, takes place at the International Exhibition Center in Kyiv, Ukraine. As an integral part of the International Forum for Food Industry and Packaging (IFFIP), it has evolved into the leading platform for the food sector in Ukraine. Organized by the Kyiv International Contract Fair, it regularly brings together a multitude of manufacturers, producers, suppliers, and traders from the relevant industry. At the "Food Expo", national, international, and regional exhibitors offer a comprehensive range of products and services.
