The range of topics and the depth of the presentations provide tremendous synergies, making both events a must-attend for industry professionals. The target audience of the fair includes a wide spectrum of professionals, including representatives from sales, food processing, hospitality, gastronomy, catering, as well as agents and marketing specialists who are directly or indirectly involved in the sales and marketing process. By bringing together these diverse groups, Vietfood & Beverage promotes networking, knowledge exchange, and the latest trends and innovations in the industry, making it an indispensable event for all stakeholders in the food and beverage industry in Southeast Asia and beyond.

The " Food Tech Dhaka Exhibition & Conference ", also known as the " Food Tech Dhaka Expo ", has established itself as a central hub for food technology and related industrial products in Bangladesh. This annual trade fair is held at the International Convention City Bashundhara (ICCB) in Dhaka and is organized by LIMRA Trade Fairs and Exhibitions Pvt. Ltd. The event serves as a comprehensive platform where national and international manufacturers and producers showcase their latest products and technologies in food production, processing, and milling. The range of offerings includes fresh and frozen foods, processed foods, beverages, as well as agricultural products and equipment. Furthermore, Food Tech Dhaka is renowned for its extensive program, which includes conferences, seminars, expert panel discussions, live product demonstrations, and networking events. A particular highlight is the Innovation Awards, which honor outstanding achievements in food technology. The expo attracts representatives from various sectors, including processed food manufacturers, progressive farmers, distributors, and professionals from the hospitality industry. It provides an excellent platform for forming new business relationships and strengthening existing ones. Food Tech Dhaka plays a vital role in promoting the local food industry and supports networking between local and international players. The ICCB venue, known for its modern facilities and accessibility, makes Dhaka, the vibrant capital of Bangladesh, the ideal location for a fair focused on innovations in food technology.

The Food Ingredients Expo is a trade fair in Bangladesh for food ingredients, flavors, and packaging solutions. Held annually at the International Convention City Bashundhara (ICCB) in Dhaka, it serves as a key platform for businesses and professionals in the food and beverage industry to explore the latest developments, innovations, and trends. Organized by Limra Trade Fairs & Exhibitions Pvt Ltd., the event is recognized as a major gathering point for manufacturers, suppliers, and industry experts. The expo focuses on key topics such as food ingredients, functional components, natural alternatives, innovative packaging solutions, and food processing machinery. Visitors can expect a diverse range of products, including food additives, natural and synthetic flavors, colorants and preservatives, as well as organic and biological ingredients. In addition, technological innovations for food production are showcased. The event primarily targets companies in the food manufacturing, health, and bakery industries, as well as packaging and machinery providers. It offers suppliers of ingredients and flavoring solutions a valuable opportunity to present their latest products and collaborate with leading manufacturers. Bangladesh is emerging as a crucial hub for the food industry in South Asia. The Food Ingredients Expo reflects this growth by providing businesses with a platform to showcase innovative products and establish valuable business connections. Alongside international market leaders, regional companies are also present, catering to the rising demand for sustainable, organic, and functional ingredients. A particular highlight of the expo includes live demonstrations, expert seminars, and conferences where the latest industry developments are presented. Visitors can gain insights into cutting-edge technologies and trends while participating in networking events to expand their business opportunities. The exhibition is primarily aimed at industry professionals, including food technologists, product developers, buyers, manufacturers, and suppliers from the food, health, and packaging sectors. It not only offers a unique chance to stay informed about the latest innovations but also facilitates the establishment of valuable business relationships with international and regional partners. The venue, International Convention City Bashundhara (ICCB) in Dhaka, is one of Bangladesh's most modern exhibition and convention centers. Thanks to its central location and easy accessibility via Shahjalal International Airport and various transportation links, both domestic and international visitors benefit from a convenient travel experience. Additionally, Dhaka, as the country's economic hub, offers a wide range of accommodation and leisure options, enhancing the overall trade fair experience.

Founded in 2001, BabyExpo is far more than a traditional consumer fair. It offers expectant parents and young families a comprehensive experience that combines information, expert advice, and entertainment at a high level. Organized by bco GmbH, the name "BabyExpo" has come to stand not only for a trade fair focused on babies, but for Austria’s largest and most established platform on pregnancy, birth, and family life. The event takes place annually at the Arena Nova in Wiener Neustadt and complements its counterpart held in Vienna. Visitors gain a current and comprehensive overview of industry trends and offerings, with targeted insights into relevant products and services. At the heart of the event are high-quality, practical, and innovative solutions for pregnancy, childbirth, and the early years of parenting. The fair also addresses the evolving realities of modern family life. Alongside essential baby products—such as strollers, car seats, or care items—BabyExpo provides access to expert knowledge in areas like health, nutrition, parenting, safety, and sustainable family living. What sets BabyExpo apart is its holistic concept. A wide range of exhibitors from retail, industry, education, public advisory services, and healthcare are joined by a varied supporting program. Expert talks, workshops, and discussion panels in the "Speakers Corner" offer valuable insights, while interactive activities, competitions, children’s experience zones, and live readings create an engaging and enjoyable atmosphere for the whole family. With its clear focus on expectant and young families, BabyExpo reaches a precisely defined and highly relevant target group. It encourages direct exchange between parents, professionals, manufacturers, retailers, and institutions. Each year, the fair attracts thousands of visitors from across Austria and neighboring regions, reinforcing Wiener Neustadt’s position as a key location for family and healthcare services. The Arena Nova provides the ideal setting for the event. As a modern, barrier-free venue, it is easily accessible by car or public transport, and features ample parking as well as family-friendly amenities including nursing and changing rooms, lounges, and dining areas. Whether you're preparing for the arrival of your child or looking for inspiration in everyday family life – BabyExpo is the perfect meeting point for everyone who lives and shapes family life.

FISCH&FEINES is a trade fair in Bremen dedicated to sustainable enjoyment and takes place every year in November. Since its founding in 2008, it has developed into the most important event for lovers of high-quality, handcrafted and natural products in the northwest. The trade fair is organized by M3B GmbH, which is committed to providing a platform for over 200 producers and retailers who present their selected foods to an enthusiastic audience. Only products that meet the strict quality criteria of FISCH&FEINES and do not contain any artificial flavors, chemical additives or flavor enhancers are admitted to the trade fair. A wide variety of products and services are offered at FISCH&FEINES. The range of products on offer ranges from fresh fish and seafood to a variety of delicatessen products such as cheese, meat, sausage, jams, chutneys, herbs, spices, salts and dairy products to fruit and vegetables. Drinks lovers will also get their money's worth with a selection of coffee, tea, wine, sparkling wine, beer and spirits. The exhibition offering is rounded off by a selection of cooking accessories, kitchen equipment and various services and informative offers. The focus is on the presentation of regional specialties, traditional manufacturing processes and high-quality products that are free of artificial additives. This trade fair is not only a feast for the senses, but also promotes awareness of sustainable consumption and supports smaller producers in making their passion and craft accessible to a wider audience. Overall, FISCH&FEINES is an indispensable event for connoisseurs and anyone interested in a sustainable lifestyle. It offers a unique opportunity to discover new taste experiences, be inspired by culinary innovations and talk directly to the producers. The CRAFT BEER EVENT has been taking place as part of FISCH&FEINES since 2014. Craft breweries from all over Germany and the Netherlands show that beer can have a lot of flavor. The ReiseLust holiday fair and caravan bremen also take place parallel to FISCH&FEINES, offering visitors an even more comprehensive experience.

he "Christmas Ostpro" in Erfurt, an annual event taking place in November, represents a unique fusion of commerce, culture, and local history, forming the cornerstone of East German identity and economy. Initiated in 2002, this fair is under the dedicated direction of its organizer, 'Scot Messen & Marketing GmbH.' It embodies a success story that bridges the past and present by celebrating and promoting products from the East. It was originally founded in Berlin in 1991 to provide a new platform for presenting and marketing products from the former GDR that had fallen into oblivion. Located in the picturesque ega-Park Erfurt, known for its rich botanical diversity and as a cultural landmark of the city, the "Christmas Ostpro" offers an atmospheric backdrop for exhibitors and visitors alike. The park complements the fair's theme with its natural beauty, creating an environment that contributes to the contemplative mood of the Christmas season. The fair itself is a tribute to the products of the former GDR, bringing their charm and nostalgia to a wider stage. It was established to enable a renaissance for these unique items that had once been forgotten. With an impressive range of products, from traditional foodstuffs to crafts, clothing, and technical devices, the "Christmas Ostpro" highlights the cultural and commercial significance of these items. A special focus of the fair is on the Christmas theme. Exhibitors offer everything the heart desires to enrich the holiday season: handmade decorations, regional culinary delights, toys, and much more that traditionally characterizes the Christmas period in the new federal states. This thematic focus not only creates a festive atmosphere but also promotes awareness and appreciation for regional specialties. Over the years, the "Christmas Ostpro" has established itself as a mecca for lovers of Eastern products. By reviving iconic brands and emphasizing authenticity and tradition, the fair has succeeded in becoming a phenomenon of cultural renaissance. It has not only brought many products back to store shelves but also fostered a strong regional consciousness that is invaluable in today's globalized world. Visitors to the fair have the exclusive opportunity to immerse themselves in a vibrant historical narrative conveyed through the exhibited products and the passionate stories of the exhibitors. As a consumer fair, the "Christmas Ostpro" is accessible to everyone, offering an interactive, enriching experience that goes beyond mere purchasing. It is a place of learning, celebration, and recognition of the cultural treasures that East Germany has to offer.

Babini is an annual public fair dedicated entirely to the beginning of family life. It is primarily aimed at expectant parents and families with babies and toddlers. The event takes place at the centrally located Hamburg Messe, which is easily accessible by both public transport and car. As part of a nationwide series of fairs – held in cities such as Dortmund, Munich, Düsseldorf, and Stuttgart – Babini Hamburg has become a well-established event for young families and industry professionals across northern Germany. The fair is organized by Babini GmbH, a company that brings together expert event planning with a deep understanding of the needs of today’s families under the “Babini” brand. Babini Hamburg offers a unique experience that combines expert information, hands-on product showcases, and a vibrant family event. The focus lies on topics that matter to families in everyday life – from pregnancy and childbirth to baby essentials, safety, nutrition, parenting, leisure, and health. Visitors can explore the latest trends in the baby and children’s sectors, compare products, and test them on-site – for example, in the popular stroller test track. Exhibitors from various industries, including child safety, baby clothing, toys, baby carriers, personal care, and family-friendly nutrition, present proven solutions and new products designed to support everyday family life. A highlight of the fair is its diverse stage and lecture program featuring experts on topics such as baby sleep, breastfeeding, parental benefits, first aid, and babywearing. Live talks and workshops offer valuable insights and practical tips – all in a relaxed atmosphere with plenty of space for exchange and interaction. Children are also well catered for: hands-on activities, play areas, and creative experiences make the fair an enjoyable outing for the whole family. Babini is more than just a trade fair – it is a meeting point for families, professionals, midwives, advisors, and providers from across the baby and children’s sector. Firmly rooted in Hamburg, it serves as a regional platform while also offering insights into nationwide trends and developments. With its successful blend of expert knowledge, product experiences, and a family-friendly atmosphere, Babini Hamburg attracts thousands of visitors each year. The Hamburg Messe, with its central location, excellent infrastructure, and family-oriented facilities, provides the ideal setting for the event.

The Pasar Malam is a unique exhibition that brings the vibrant spirit of Asia to the Netherlands in its own distinct way. The term "Pasar Malam" originates from Indonesian and translates to "Night Market", even though the event doesn't exclusively take place in the evening. This exhibition, a tribute to Asian culture and specifically to the Indian and Moluccan communities, is held at the Expo Rijswijk De Broodfabriek in Rijswijk, a dynamic venue known for hosting diverse events. With a biannual frequency, typically in the fall and spring, Pasar Malam opens its doors to visitors not only from the Netherlands but from all over the world. Behind the organization is Expo Rijswijk, an institution that has made a name for itself by hosting numerous events, always ensuring a rich and immersive experience for attendees. The main theme of the exhibition is the comprehensive representation of Asian cultures. This encompasses a wide range of products and services, from traditional Asian handicrafts, clothing, and jewelry to culinary delights. A special emphasis is placed on alternative therapies such as massages, spiritual readings, and healing, with clairvoyants and mediums also offering their services. Rijswijk itself plays a crucial role as the host city, bridging the gap between the Netherlands and the diverse Asian cultures. This is reflected in the selection of exhibitors, stemming from various sectors, with both local and international backgrounds. The exhibition is not just a gathering place for the general public but also attracts professionals from the fields of gastronomy, commerce, arts, and alternative therapy. Highlights of the exhibition include vibrant cultural performances, music, and dance acts, as well as occasional competitions celebrating cultural diversity. In conclusion, the Pasar Malam in Rijswijk is more than just an exhibition. It offers visitors a deep dive into the warmth and colorful splendor of Asia. The venue, Expo Rijswijk De Broodfabriek, impresses not just with its historical significance but also with its accessibility and modern amenities. Easily reachable by public transport or by car, it welcomes visitors to a world of discovery and cultural exchange.

The Marjolaine Fair in Paris, an annual event held in November, is an exhibition that, since its inception in 1976, has served as a platform for organic farming, sustainable development, natural well-being, and social enterprises. Organized by the SPAS Organisation de salons, this fair gathers a multitude of experts, producers, and craftsmen who advocate for ecological and sustainable practices. The fair takes place in the picturesque Parc Floral in Paris, a green oasis that acts as the perfect backdrop for an event dedicated to environmental protection and the promotion of a sustainable lifestyle. The Parc Floral is more than just a place of beauty and tranquility; it's also a hub for cultural and ecological events, making this fair a truly special occasion. Marjolaine takes pride in being the largest organic event in France, spotlighting various sectors and themes. The core areas of the show include crafts and fashion, with a particular focus on eco-friendly materials and practices. The food sector, a vital facet of the fair, has expanded to accommodate new players in the organic food industry. Another highlight is the organic wellness sector, which, with its range of ecological products and services, adds a new allure to the home living area. The fair also features a hall exclusively reserved for associations, serving as a forum and lecture space where knowledge, ideas, and innovations are shared. The central themes of the fair encompass food, wine, health, beauty, fashion, decor, well-being, gardening, tourism, ecology, and home. The Marjolaine Fair is furthermore a place of learning and inspiration. It offers workshops, lectures, and demonstrations that assist visitors in making informed decisions about their lifestyle. Each year, the fair presents new highlights and special features, keeping it fresh and relevant for both returning and new visitors. From the quality of the products displayed to the information and awareness it promotes, the Marjolaine Fair is at the forefront of the ecological and sustainable movement in France.

The VeggieWorld in Munich is an annual trade fair aimed at everyone interested in a vegan and sustainable lifestyle. As part of the international VeggieWorld trade fair chain, this event in Europe also offers a platform for end consumers and trade visitors to meet and exchange inspiration. It is organized by Wellfairs GmbH and takes place in the mtc world of fashion in Munich. The mtc world of fashion is known for its diverse event options and, with its pleasant atmosphere, offers an ideal location for such events. Here, visitors can discover the diverse aspects of a plant-based lifestyle, from milk and meat alternatives to superfoods and vegan sweets to fashionable clothing and accessories. Vegan cosmetic products and innovative projects are also part of the extensive range. A central point of the VeggieWorld in Munich is the direct interaction with the manufacturers. Visitors have the opportunity to have personal discussions and find out in detail about the ingredients and health benefits of the products. This interaction is particularly valuable for making conscious decisions about one's own lifestyle. A highlight of the fair is the supporting program, which consists of lectures, cooking shows and interactive workshops. These events are free for all fair visitors and offer an excellent opportunity to learn more about the vegan lifestyle and experience it in practice. The VeggieWorld Munich is therefore not only a meeting place for like-minded people, but also a source of information that opens the doors to a more sustainable lifestyle for visitors.

The SÜFFA in Stuttgart, also known as the "Süddeutsche Fachmesse für das Fleischerhandwerk", was founded in 1984 and has established itself as the leading trade fair for the national meat industry. Organized by the Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, it attracts not only experts from Germany but also from neighboring countries. This annual industry gathering held in the fall is only omitted in the year of the IFFA in Frankfurt am Main, positioning itself as a central hub for the butchery sector and the medium-sized industry. The focus of the fair lies on the latest developments and innovations in the meat business, ranging from slaughtering techniques to production, logistics, packaging, and retail sales. Here, it's not just meat and sausage specialties that are showcased, but also commercial goods, marketing solutions, and waste disposal technologies. A particular emphasis of the SÜFFA is on current societal topics such as food safety, hygiene, and quality management. This reflects the growing awareness in society about the origin, quality, and processing of foodstuffs. A unique highlight and distinctive feature of the SÜFFA is the awarding of the SÜFFA Innovation Prize, which honors outstanding new developments in the industry. Additionally, the "SÜFFA-Dorf" offers a diverse accompanying program. Here, competitions take place, a "Marketplace of Ideas" invites for exchange, and trends and innovations are presented on a stage. The location of the fair, the Stuttgart Fairgrounds, provides both exhibitors and visitors with modern infrastructures and excellent accessibility. Year after year, the SÜFFA attracts a multitude of visitors who appreciate the balanced combination of production and sales. In conclusion, it can be said that the SÜFFA plays an indispensable role in the meat industry as a meeting point for the sector and serves as a bridge between tradition and innovation within the industry.

HORECA LEBANON is an annual trade fair held at the Seaside Arena in Beirut. The name "Horeca" stands for Hotel, Restaurant, and Café, reflecting the core themes of the exhibition. The event is organized by Hospitality Services s.a.r.l, a renowned organization in the region. The exhibition has become a central meeting point for the hospitality, gastronomy, and beverage industries in Lebanon and beyond. It showcases a wide range of products and services, including food and frozen goods, meat, poultry, seafood, beverages, packaging, kitchen technology and equipment, furniture and decoration for restaurants and cafés, uniforms, and hospitality-related services. A distinctive feature of HORECA LEBANON is its strong connection to the local culture and economy. It provides a platform for local and international exhibitors to connect with industry professionals from various sectors. Additionally, it reflects the latest culinary trends and innovations in the region. The fair features numerous highlights, including live cooking sessions with renowned chefs, tastings, and competitions such as the Lebanese Bartenders Competition, the Lebanese Barista Competition, the National Extra Virgin Olive Oil Contest, the Junior Chef Competition, and the Lebanese Pastry Competition. These events are complemented by industry conferences and live talks with experts. HORECA LEBANON is part of the Horeca Exhibitions series, which also takes place in other Middle Eastern countries. This exhibition series is among the largest of its kind in the region. The exhibition is held annually in Beirut and primarily attracts visitors from the hotel, restaurant, and café industries. The Seaside Arena, a modern and well-equipped exhibition venue, provides an ideal setting for this major industry event. In conclusion, HORECA LEBANON is not only an outstanding platform for business networking and knowledge exchange in the hospitality, gastronomy, and beverage industries but also a vibrant showcase of Lebanon’s rich culture and culinary diversity. It offers a unique opportunity to connect with industry leaders, explore the latest trends, and experience the dynamic heart of hospitality in the Middle East.

개최장소(베뉴): Shanghai New International Expo Center - SNIEC
축제소개: The FHC China - Food & Hospitality China is an international trade fair for food and beverages, held annually in November in Shanghai, one of the world's most dynamic culinary capitals. Since its inception, it has evolved into an indispensable event for the food and hospitality industry in Asia and beyond. This prestigious event is jointly organized by the Shanghai Sinoexpo Informa Markets International Exhibition Co., Ltd. and the Shanghai Cuisine Association, both of which are stakeholders with significant influence and expertise in the industry. Each year, FHC China showcases an impressive array of products and services that cover the entire supply chain of the food industry. Core topics of the fair include meat and dairy products, confectionery and chocolate, spices and oils, coffee and tea, as well as areas for bakeries and light meals. In addition, the fair provides a comprehensive overview of food processing and packaging and presents innovations in the field of prefabricated tableware and central kitchens. A distinctive feature of FHC China is its commitment to education and advancement within the industry. The fair offers a comprehensive series of seminars and workshops on current trends and developments in various segments, including food production, the wine industry, and marketing. The fair takes place at the Shanghai New International Expo Centre (SNIEC), one of China's leading exhibition centers, which, with its modern facilities and extensive infrastructure, is ideal for an event of this magnitude. SNIEC is known for its easily accessible location and the ability to host a variety of events, from international exhibitions to private corporate events. Visiting FHC China offers not just the opportunity to discover new products and place orders, but also an environment for networking and building business relationships, crucial for future success in the fast-paced world of gastronomy and hospitality. With its wide range of exhibitors, access to industry-leading information, and its position as a gateway to Asia's emerging markets, FHC China is an indispensable date in the food and beverage industry's calendar.

The FoodExpo Kazakhstan, formerly also known as Worldfood Kazakhstan, is a prominent trade fair in the Asian region, contributing since its inception in 1998 to the presentation of trends, products, and technologies in food production and marketing on an international platform. The expo, taking place annually at the Atakent International Exhibition Centre in Almaty, has established itself as an effective platform for introducing new products and networking with industry experts from the global food industry. The fair is organized by Iteca Almaty, an experienced organizer, which has shaped the FoodExpo into a crucial platform for companies from all over the world to present their products and services to a wide audience. With main themes extending across food and beverages, ingredients, food technology, baked goods, packaging, and agriculture, the expo offers a comprehensive range that spans from food to production and packaging equipment, through to agricultural topics and discussions. The AgriFood Forum is a special highlight of the FoodExpo, addressing issues such as animal husbandry, feed production, and efficient gardening. Here, professionals from various sectors have the opportunity to exchange ideas, expand networks, and discuss current challenges and innovations in the industry. In addition to the forum, the FoodExpo also hosts the competition and award "The Best Product of FoodExpo Qazaqstan," which serves as a prestigious event within the fair and honors innovative products. Exhibitors from various industries such as food production, retail and wholesale, catering, and packaging present their products and services at the fair. Visitors, primarily from manufacturing, trade, catering, and distribution sectors, can discover a variety of products and technologies, which include food, beverages, equipment, additives, packaging, transport solutions, and numerous other subject areas. The fair not only strengthens the relationship between national and international players in the food industry but also offers an excellent opportunity to showcase the diversity and quality of the Kazakh food sector. Almaty, being one of the largest cities in Kazakhstan and a significant economic center, provides an optimally accessible location for national and international guests with the Atakent International Exhibition Centre. This exhibition center is not only a hub for international business activities but also symbolizes Kazakhstan's openness towards global markets and trends. It is easily accessible by both public transport and car and offers comprehensive facilities and services for exhibitors and visitors alike. Thus, the FoodExpo Kazakhstan forms a comprehensive, culturally, and economically significant event, promoting the exchange and presentation of innovations in the food industry and acting as a bridge between local and international market participants.

The Ingredients Kazakhstan is a leading trade fair in the field of food additives and spices, held annually at the Atakent International Exhibition Centre in Almaty. It represents an event of international stature where companies from all over the world gather to showcase the latest trends, products, and technologies of their industry. Organized by Iteca Almaty, the fair provides a powerful platform for the introduction and promotion of new products. It also offers insights into the local market and promotes networking with industry experts. Exhibitors include manufacturers, dealers, wholesalers, and retailers from areas such as acidulants, additives, dyes, emulsifiers, ferments, fats, and oils. The broad product range attests to the innovative strength of the food industry. A special highlight of the fair is the AgriFood Forum. It encompasses thematic sessions, round tables, and master classes. The forum focuses on addressing current and future challenges of the agro-industrial sector in line with global trends and encourages dialogue between industry associations, trade unions, and industry ministries. The fair plays a significant role in positioning Almaty and Kazakhstan as a hub for food innovations and developments. The main visitors are industry experts, including manufacturers, dealers, wholesalers, retailers, and restaurateurs, always on the lookout for the latest innovations and insights in the food industry. Ingredients Kazakhstan is also an integral part of the Food Expo Kazakhstan, making it a member of a series of fairs representing the entire food and beverage sector. In conclusion, the Atakent International Exhibition Centre in Almaty stands out not just for its modernity. It's also easily accessible and situated in a city known for its hospitality and cultural diversity—an ideal venue for both exhibitors and visitors alike to do business, build relationships, and explore new horizons.

전시회명: JFEX JAPAN INT’L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO
축제소개: The "JFEX Summer JAPAN INT'L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO", an international fair in Tokyo, is dedicated to showcasing food and beverages from around the world. "JFEX", short for "Japan Food Expo", reflects the event's focus on the food industry. This trade fair takes place twice a year at Tokyo Big Sight, one of Japan's leading exhibition centers. It is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a company known for its extensive experience and expertise in organizing international exhibitions. JFEX is divided into four main areas: JFEX FOOD, focusing on frozen foods, ready-to-eat meals, agricultural and seafood products, confectionery, and spices; JFEX WINE and SPIRITS, presenting alcoholic beverages such as wine, beer, whisky, liqueurs, sake, and shochu; JFEX MEAT and DAIRY, specializing in meat and dairy products; and JFEX PREMIUM, showcasing luxury food items, confectionery, agricultural products, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. The fair offers an excellent platform for exploring the diversity and innovations of the global food and beverage industry, particularly from Japan. It provides insights into current trends and serves as a meeting point for business contacts and networking. Exhibitors range from food and beverage manufacturers to agricultural companies and providers of packaging and processing technologies. The main visitors include professionals from the food industry, retailers and wholesalers, importers, exporters, and restaurateurs. JFEX is not only a central meeting point for professionals but also reflects the local culture and gastronomy. Tokyo, the venue, is known for its culinary diversity and its role as a trade and industrial center. As part of a global series of fairs representing the food and beverage industry, JFEX plays a significant role in the sector. Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo stands out for its strategically advantageous location and excellent accessibility. It is an ideal place for international exhibitions and boasts an excellent infrastructure that is easily accessible by both public transport and car, facilitating participation for international visitors and exhibitors.

The INTERFOOD & DRINK is an annual trade fair held in Sofia during the fall, focusing on the food and beverage industry. Since its inception, it has established itself as a pivotal event for professionals in the field and the general public alike. Organized by the IEC (Inter Expo Center), a leading trade fair organizer in Bulgaria, this platform showcases a wide range of products and services. These include food and beverages, packaging machinery, materials and systems, as well as advanced technologies employed in these sectors. The Inter Expo Center, which hosts this fair, is renowned for its modern infrastructure and its ability to organize an array of events, conferences, and seminars. Strategically located in Sofia, Bulgaria's capital, it attracts participants and visitors from all over the region and beyond. One of the primary objectives of INTERFOOD & DRINK is to connect buyers and decision-makers from the food and beverage industry. It offers a comprehensive platform for networking, sharing experiences, and exploring innovative approaches in production. Moreover, the latest trends and technologies crucial to the industry are presented. A distinctive feature of the fair is the concurrent offerings from related sectors. This concept creates synergies for visitors, allowing them to gain insights into adjacent industries, making the fair a more holistic experience. Visitors can look forward to a range of highlights, including innovative product demonstrations, competitions, presentations, and expert-led workshops. The growing participation of companies, economic delegations, and trade missions, both from Bulgaria and abroad, attests to the significance and success of INTERFOOD & DRINK. Through its role as a leading business platform in the region, the fair promotes international collaborations and enhances the global presence of the participating sectors. It remains an indispensable event for everyone involved in the dynamic world of food, beverages, and related technologies.

The " JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR" (JFEF) is an annual trade fair for importers, wholesalers and buyers of Japanese food and beverages and held at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, near Tokyo. It serves as a central hub for the export of Japanese food and beverages. The event is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a leader in the organization of international large-scale events. The fair's goal is to bridge Japanese exporters and global markets. The fair's offerings include a wide range of products: fresh agricultural produce, seafood, meat products, processed foods, and Japanese tea varieties such as green tea, Matcha, Sencha, and Genmaicha. Additionally, Japanese beverages like sake and beer, non-alcoholic options, confectioneries, snacks, health-oriented foods, sustainable and allergen-free products, as well as traditional spices and sauces are highlighted. The fair also showcases the latest trends in kitchen appliances and tableware. In addition to product presentations, the JFEF provides comprehensive services in logistics and transportation, facilitating international trade. It attracts numerous visitors, including foreign importers, traders, international trade associations, government institutions, and media representatives. Primary visitors also include buyers from retail, department stores, hotels, restaurants, and the food processing industry. A distinctive feature of the fair is its highlights, such as tastings, sushi-making workshops, and business matchmaking activities. These offerings enrich the fair with a vibrant experience that not only promotes business exchange but also provides deep cultural insights and strengthens the relationship between Japanese culture and global markets. The JFEF is part of a series of fairs and is held in one of Japan's leading exhibition halls. Its modern infrastructure and accessibility, combined with its proximity to Tokyo, provide an attractive incentive for international visitors who seek not only business opportunities but also cultural enrichment. In summary, the JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR is an essential platform for stakeholders in the international food trade to explore the diversity and quality of Japanese products and to establish direct contacts with leading manufacturers and exporters.

The "JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR" (JFEF) is an annual trade fair for importers, wholesalers and buyers of Japanese food and beverages, held at the Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo. It has established itself as a central hub for exporting Japanese food and beverages. The "natural health show" also serves as a platform for startups and new market developments, turning it into a hub for the latest trends and strategies in the health industry. Highlights of the fair include interactive elements such as live pitches and product presentations, which facilitate direct exchanges between industry experts and make the event dynamic. Visitors to the fair include professionals from the health, wellness, and beauty industries, entrepreneurs, as well as retailers and distributors seeking innovative solutions. In summary, the "natural health show" is more than just a fair; it is a cultural event that celebrates the significance of health and sustainability in the modern world. The Malmömässan provides an ideal base for a pleasant and inspiring fair experience, making every visit a highlight.

Since its inception in 2024, the “ Food und Feines ” trade fair has stood for culinary discovery and a refined culture of enjoyment – authentic, regionally rooted, and globally open-minded. Each year, Messe Stuttgart welcomes a discerning audience passionate about new taste experiences, creative cuisine, and sustainable nutrition. Organized by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, the event offers a carefully curated platform for producers, culinary professionals, and conscious consumers alike, shaped by a strong sense for quality and innovation. The Food und Feines presents itself as a showcase of culinary diversity. While the spotlight is on regional specialties from Baden-Württemberg – including beloved classics like Maultaschen, cheese, and artisan sausages – the fair also opens the door to international delicacies. Visitors can explore the culinary riches of the Levant, the Mediterranean, Asia, and South America, bringing global food traditions to life. Complementing this selection are fine coffee and confectionery specialties rarely found outside gourmet roasteries or international markets – from frozen yogurt to premium chocolate from Dubai. Beverages are given equal attention. A thoughtfully selected range of wines, beers, spirits, and non-alcoholic creations invites exploration. The focus is on craft and authenticity, with offerings such as small-batch beers, naturally brewed lemonades, regional brandies, and international whiskies. A stylishly designed area is dedicated to tobacco and cigar culture, featuring curated accessories and expert advice. The overall experience is further enhanced by high-quality lifestyle products for the modern home, including elegant tableware, kitchen tools, and culinary literature that inspire stylish enjoyment at home. The fair places a strong emphasis on sustainability, slow food, and mindful consumption. Expert panels and discussion formats highlight pressing topics such as regional value creation, fair production, and resource-conscious nutrition. A particular highlight are the live cooking shows with renowned chefs who share insights into global food trends – from Asian street food and African spice culture to traditional bread baking and BBQ. These sessions offer not only culinary inspiration, but also fresh perspectives on food and enjoyment. Exhibitors represent sectors such as artisanal food production, gastronomy, beverage manufacturing, fine food retail, kitchen equipment, and lifestyle. The event is tailored to gourmets, food lovers, industry professionals from retail, hospitality, and gastronomy, as well as trend-conscious home cooks. In this way, “Food und Feines” builds a unique bridge between craftsmanship, culinary culture, and responsible food practices – true to the spirit of the Stuttgart region, known for its rich and forward-thinking culinary landscape. Modern Messe Stuttgart, located directly at the airport and perfectly connected to the transport network, provides the ideal setting. Bright, spacious halls, well-designed lounge areas, and short walking distances ensure a pleasant visitor experience. For those who value enjoyment grounded in quality, diversity, and integrity, “Food und Feines” is a true culinary highlight in the southern German trade fair calendar.

Since its inception in 2010, Grain Tech India has evolved into the leading technology trade fair for grain processing and storage in India. Every year, Grain Tech India serves as a key event for trade visitors and exhibitors from around the world who wish to learn about the latest industry developments, technologies, and services. The event is organized by the Media Today Group , one of India’s foremost trade fair organizers. With its extensive experience and a broad network, Media Today successfully brings together experts, companies, innovators, and decision-makers from all areas of the grain and food industries. The focus of the exhibition lies on cutting-edge processes and machinery for processing agricultural products such as flour, rice, pulses, spices, corn, semolina, pasta, baked goods, and animal feed. The showcased technologies range from cleaning, sorting, and milling systems to solutions for packaging, storage, and transport, as well as color sorting machines, extraction units, and digital temperature control systems. What sets Grain Tech India apart is its consistent industry focus and comprehensive scope. Exhibitors include companies from grain processing, mechanical engineering, packaging and storage technology, and food production. The exhibition is further enriched by suppliers, financial institutions, consulting firms, government support agencies, certification bodies, and non-governmental organizations, together representing the full ecosystem of the grain industry. The visitor profile is equally diverse: professionals from milling operations, food manufacturers, agriculture, technology providers, trade, and investment sectors use the platform for knowledge exchange, collaboration, and forward-looking business opportunities. For anyone involved in the grain industry, Grain Tech India is far more than just a calendar event—it is a vital platform for growth, networking, and technological advancement.

Launched in 2013, Foodex Saudi is a prestigious international trade fair for the food and beverage industry. The name "Foodex" symbolizes an in-depth exploration of the food industry - from product development to delivery to the consumer. The fair is held once a year in Riyadh and Jeddah. The fair is organized by Reed Sunaidi Exhibitions, a leading company in the events sector that always strives to provide a smooth and enriching experience for all participants. The range of topics covered at Foodex Saudi is wide and includes beverages, food technology and machinery, canned goods, meat and dairy products, confectionery, poultry and game, chilled and fresh frozen products, among others. Particular emphasis is placed on niche products, diet products, gourmet items, organic products and health foods. With this diverse offering, the fair attracts a wide range of exhibitors, from major industry leaders to specialty manufacturers. The main visitor group is made up of professionals from the food and beverage industry, who can look forward to a number of highlights, including film screenings, seminars and the opportunity to meet celebrity chefs. The fair also offers platforms such as the Salon Culinaire, a professional cooking competition, the Chocolate Art Salon, dedicated to art and sculpture made of chocolate, the Mocktail Bar mixology competition, where bartenders can showcase their creativity in non-alcoholic cocktails, as well as a live kitchen and a business match program.

Agro-Pack Iraq is the most important trade fair for food processing, packaging, and printing technology in Iraq. Since its inception in 2017, it has been held annually in autumn at the Erbil International Fair Ground – a state-of-the-art exhibition venue located in Erbil, the country’s most economically vibrant city and an emerging trade fair hub in the Middle East. The event attracts industry professionals and exhibitors from around the world. It is organized by So Fuar Ltd. Sti., an experienced event organizer that not only facilitates participation but also offers comprehensive services such as booth construction, shipping, and accommodation. This all-inclusive support makes Agro-Pack Iraq particularly attractive for international participants who wish to focus entirely on professional exchange and new business opportunities. What sets Agro-Pack Iraq apart is its clear focus and in-depth content: The exhibition covers the entire value chain of the food and beverage industry – from innovative processing technologies for meat, fish, dairy products, baked goods, and snacks to advanced packaging and printing solutions, as well as refrigeration and climate control systems. The range is further enhanced by key topics such as food safety, waste and wastewater management, and digital POS and IT systems for the hospitality sector. Even highly specialized segments like ice cream technology, pasta production, and flavoring and additive systems are given their own stage. A special emphasis is placed on packaging and printing, where the latest machines, materials, and labeling technologies take center stage. Companies from the food processing, packaging, and agricultural technology sectors present practical innovations, while decision-makers, engineers, and developers specifically seek out efficient, ready-to-implement solutions. Agro-Pack Iraq is far more than just an industry gathering – it is a platform for concrete business deals, knowledge exchange, and strategic partnerships. With its modern exhibition halls, solid infrastructure, and convenient location – accessible both regionally and internationally by land and air – the Erbil International Fair Ground provides the ideal environment for successful trade show participation. Anyone looking to offer or discover innovative solutions in the food and packaging sectors will find the perfect place here for networking, showcasing, and negotiating.

FRUIT POLAND is an international trade fair that has focused on fruit cultivation and related industries since its inception in 2023. It is held annually at the Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn , a suburb of Warsaw, and has established itself as a central meeting point for professionals in the fruit cultivation and food industries. The name of the fair underscores its focus on fruit products and its roots in Poland. The renowned company Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o.o. serves as the organizer, known for its expertise in organizing trade fairs. FRUIT POLAND addresses topics such as the cultivation and processing of fruit, technologies in fruit cultivation, plant protection, fertilizers, storage methods, and trading strategies. The fair showcases a wide range of products and services. These include seedlings for fruit trees and bushes, fruit cultivation machinery and tools, accessories for fruit cultivation, plant protection products, fertilizers, and modern cultivation technologies. It plays an important role for the city and the country by bringing together Polish and international companies and positioning Poland as a significant player in the fruit industry. Highlights of FRUIT POLAND include competitions, award ceremonies, and educational discussions led by recognized experts. Exhibitors come from various sectors, including fruit cultivation, agriculture, plant protection, and fruit processing. The main visitors to the fair are fruit growers, producers, farmers, representatives of processing and packaging companies, and scientists. The Ptak Warsaw Expo impresses with its modern facilities and good accessibility. It is located near Warsaw's international airport and is easily accessible by both public transport and car. Overall, FRUIT POLAND offers a significant platform for knowledge exchange, networking, and business development for all stakeholders in the fruit sector.

The FOOD & LIFE event in Munich is a prestigious consumer and sales fair dedicated entirely to the themes of food, drink, and enjoyment. Established in 2004, the fair has been organized by GHM Gesellschaft für Handwerksmessen mbH and, since the spring of 2023, takes place twice a year. It has established itself as Germany's largest meeting point for culinary excellence, attracting visitors interested in high-quality, artisanal delicacies. The fair offers an impressive variety of products and services. Ranging from small manufacturers with regional specialties to producers of sustainable organic products, the selection is diverse. It includes spreads, baked and confectionery goods, fine and health foods, fish, meat and sausages, beverages and spirits, spices, herbs, vinegar, oil, coffee, tea, dairy products, eggs, fruits, and vegetables. This culinary abundance makes the fair a paradise for gourmets and lovers of good taste. A distinctive feature of FOOD & LIFE is the presentation by passionate distillers, brewers, coffee roasters, chocolatiers, and butchers, who showcase their products and their production processes. Celebrity chefs demonstrate their skills on live stages, making the fair an interactive and educational experience. The venue, Messe München, provides an ideal platform for this event. With its modern infrastructure and accessibility, it is a suitable setting for showcasing the diverse culinary world.

Interpoma , the unique trade fair for the apple industry, is held every two years at the Fiera di Bolzano in picturesque Bolzano. It provides a specialized platform for the production, storage, and marketing of apples. The name "Interpoma" is derived from the Latin words "inter" (between) and "pomum" (apple), symbolizing international exchange within the industry. In late autumn, the Fiera di Bolzano transforms into a hub for technology and sustainability as Messe Bozen AG gathers experts, producers, and enthusiasts from around the world. Bolzano's significance as a historic apple-growing region in South Tyrol underscores the fair's relevance to the area and provides an ideal setting for the event. Interpoma focuses on topics such as technological advancements in apple cultivation, sustainable farming methods, digital innovations, and genetic developments in apple breeding. These specific areas of focus make the fair an indispensable meeting point for professionals in the apple industry. At the fair, the latest machinery, advanced cultivation techniques, and innovative products are showcased, with "The Orchard of the Future" as a special exhibition presenting future trends and technologies in apple cultivation. The Interpoma Congress, production tours, and the prestigious Interpoma Award for outstanding technologies and sustainability initiatives are other highlights that attract numerous professionals and interested parties. The fair serves as a magnet for a wide range of industry representatives, from agricultural engineers and farmers to researchers and marketing specialists. It offers professionals in the apple industry the opportunity to learn about the latest developments and expand their networks. Due to its excellent transport connections both nationally and internationally, Bolzano is easily accessible and serves as an attractive meeting point in the heart of Europe. In summary, Interpoma is more than just a fair; it is a pivotal event that significantly shapes the future of the apple industry. Visitors and exhibitors can look forward to a unique opportunity that will benefit them both commercially and technologically.

The Sasbachwalden Bischenberg Gluten-Free Christmas Market is an annual event that takes place during the pre-Christmas season. This unique market, focusing on the needs of people with allergies and celiac disease, highlights the motto "gluten-free – lactose-free" and offers a comprehensive range of options for visitors with food intolerances. Sasbachwalden, known for its spa park and charming landscape, provides the perfect setting for this special market. Located in the heart of the spa park, surrounded by impressive buildings, the market creates a festive and welcoming atmosphere. This backdrop gives the market a distinctive charm, making it an appealing destination during the Advent season. The market stalls are carefully selected to offer a wide range of gluten- and lactose-free products. From traditional delicacies to innovative creations, visitors can enjoy a variety of food and drinks that are rarely found at other Christmas markets. Special attention is paid to the quality and diversity of the products, ensuring that every visitor finds something to suit their taste. A visit to the market is recommended not only for its unique culinary offerings but also for the warm and inviting atmosphere it exudes. The market provides a rare opportunity to celebrate in an environment that is consciously tailored to the needs of people with specific dietary restrictions. In conclusion, the Sasbachwalden Bischenberg Gluten-Free Christmas Market is not just a feast for the senses, but also a symbol of inclusion and consideration for people with food intolerances. It offers a unique experience that is unparalleled in the Christmas market landscape.

The "STŘÍBRNÉ VÁNOČNÍ DNY" is an annual fair held at the PVA Expo Praha in Prague, capturing the spirit of the Christmas season. This fair, whose name translates to "Silver Christmas Days," serves as a central meeting point for exhibitors from various industries to present their products and services for the holiday season. It is organized by PVA EXPO PRAHA, a renowned organizer of trade fairs. The fair is distinguished by its thematic diversity. Visitors can discover a wide range of products, including home and Christmas decorations, jewelry, crafts, toys, fashion, lingerie, experience gifts, sports equipment, household goods, and much more. The unique creations by authors and design pieces by artists and designers are also part of the offering, providing visitors with an exclusive selection of quality products and original gift ideas. A standout feature of the fair is the traditional gluten-free Christmas market, the largest in the Czech Republic. The gluten-free Christmas treats and pastries offered there make the fair attractive to visitors with special dietary needs. The fair's extensive accompanying program includes creative workshops, demonstrations of artisanal product techniques, and competitions. A special highlight is the "Tree of Wishes," an initiative that provides Christmas gifts to children without families. The STŘÍBRNÉ VÁNOČNÍ DNY reflects the cultural richness and creative diversity of Prague and primarily attracts visitors from various sectors, including retailers, families, and Christmas enthusiasts. In conclusion, it's noteworthy that the PVA Expo Praha venue is easily accessible and presents itself as an ideal location for such a large-scale event. Its central location in Prague provides a perfect backdrop for such a festive and inspiring event.

The "Food and Healthy Living Fair" in Zagreb is an annual consumer exhibition dedicated entirely to healthy eating and lifestyle. As one of the largest events of its kind in Croatia, it provides extensive information and a wide range of products related to nutrition and health. Visitors to the fair can look forward to a variety of tastings, product demonstrations, and exhibitions presented by providers in the fields of healthy eating, natural products, and ecological goods. The fair serves as an ideal platform for professionals in the food and health industries, as well as for consumers who want to learn about healthy eating. It also offers new business opportunities for entrepreneurs in these growing sectors. Highlights of the fair include various award ceremonies and competitions, giving visitors insights into new recipes and culinary ideas. This makes the fair not just a place for exchange and information, but also a showcase for innovation and creativity in nutrition and health. The fair takes place at the Zagreb Fairgrounds, a renowned venue in Croatia known for its modern facilities and capacity to host large international events. Its location in Zagreb, the capital of Croatia, makes the fair easily accessible and attracts an international audience eager to discover the latest trends and developments in healthy living.

Fresh Africa is the leading trade fair for fresh produce in North Africa and a highly specialized industry platform held annually at the Egypt International Exhibition Center (EIEC) in Cairo. It represents the combined quality and diversity of African agricultural and fresh products – with a clear focus on export, trade, and innovation. The event is organized by IFP Egypt, an experienced organizer of international trade fairs. With Fresh Africa, the company has created a targeted platform that is practical, unique, and highly relevant to the industry. The fair is aimed at professional visitors from the retail and wholesale food sectors, import and export businesses, as well as decision-makers in gastronomy, hospitality, and food processing. Fresh Africa takes place once a year. As a regionally anchored event, it plays a key role in driving Egypt's agricultural sector and serves as a gateway to the markets of Africa and the Middle East. At the heart of the fair are fresh agricultural products such as fruits, vegetables, herbs, spices, legumes, and grains. The product range includes citrus fruits, grapes, strawberries, dates, and pomegranates, as well as potatoes, peppers, tomatoes, green beans, spring onions, and sweet potatoes. Aromatic herbs such as mint, coriander, basil, and rosemary are also featured. The offering is rounded out by dried beans, sesame, fava beans, and other oilseeds. Special emphasis is placed on convenience and organic products that meet growing international demands for sustainability and healthy nutrition. A particular highlight of the fair includes expert forums, product presentations, and innovation awards that recognize new varieties, cultivation methods, and packaging solutions. Exhibitors primarily come from the fields of agriculture, food processing, packaging, logistics, and trade – both from Egypt and abroad. The fair attracts professional visitors from over 20 countries, providing a unique platform for transcontinental networking and market entry into Africa and the Arab world. The venue – the Egypt International Exhibition Center in New Cairo – impresses with its modern infrastructure, strong international connectivity, and central location. The exhibition grounds are less than 30 minutes from Cairo International Airport and offer a professional setting for exhibitors and visitors to establish successful business relationships in a fast-growing economic region.

Food Africa is the premier trade exhibition for the food and beverage industry across the African continent and the Middle East. Held annually at the Egypt International Exhibition Center (EIEC) in Cairo, the event has established itself over the past decade as an essential platform for international trade. It offers manufacturers, exporters, buyers, and decision-makers from around the globe direct access to the region’s fast-growing markets. Organized by IFP Egypt – an experienced trade fair organizer specializing in the Middle East and Africa – Food Africa serves not only as a marketplace but also as a strategic hub for partnerships, product innovation, and market insights. The exhibition focuses on the entire value chain of the food industry. Its product range is extensive, covering everything from fresh produce such as fruits, vegetables, meat, and poultry to dairy products, frozen foods, and baked goods. It also showcases specialties like dates, halal products, gluten-free items, ready-to-eat meals, and international delicacies. Beverages such as juices, water, coffee, tea, and energy drinks are also well represented, along with sweets, spices, oils, and canned goods. In addition, the event features technological services, transport and logistics solutions, as well as organic, dietary, and ethically certified food products. Choosing Cairo as the host city provides a distinct strategic advantage: Egypt is considered a central trade hub in Africa and, due to its geographic location at the crossroads of three continents, offers access to a wide range of markets. The EIEC impresses with its modern infrastructure and excellent connectivity to Cairo International Airport and the city’s transportation network. A standout feature of Food Africa is its international B2B programs, live cooking shows, guided buyer tours, and industry-specific forums that enrich the event every year with a dynamic supporting program. Exhibitors come from diverse sectors, including agriculture, food processing, packaging, retail and wholesale, gastronomy, and franchising. Key visitors include importers, retailers, supermarket chains, distributors, wholesalers, and HoReCa professionals actively seeking new business opportunities. Thanks to its unique blend of regional focus, global reach, and deep market knowledge, Food Africa offers an ideal platform to position brands, set trends, and tap into new markets—right in the heart of one of Africa’s most vital economic zones. The modern EIEC venue provides the perfect setting for effective networking, impactful presentations, and high-level business deals.

The 'New Year Gift' is an annual international gift exhibition first held in 2004, quickly evolving into a significant platform for the festive business. The name of the fair symbolizes the wide array of gift ideas offered during the New Year season. It takes place in the esteemed ExpoForum Convention & Exhibition Centre in Saint Petersburg, a venue of great significance, known for its excellent facilities and accessibility. Organized by FarExpo Ltd., an experienced team, the 'New Year Gift' has become a central meeting point for exhibitors and visitors from various industries. The fair in Saint Petersburg is characterized by an impressive diversity of products and services tailored specifically for the New Year and Christmas season. The range covers a wide spectrum to cater to the diverse needs and interests of the visitors. The main categories of exhibited products and services include clothing and fashion, jewelry and costume jewelry, leather goods and accessories, beauty and health products, designer items, crafts and artisan products, gastronomic goods, Christmas decorations and utensils, toys and children's products, ecological and organic products, as well as home and furnishing items. This extensive range of products makes the 'New Year Gift' a comprehensive marketplace and a source of inspiration for individual and creative gift ideas for the New Year and Christmas season. However, the 'New Year Gift' is more than just a sales platform; it is also a cultural event closely intertwined with the city of Saint Petersburg and Russian culture. The fair attracts a wide range of visitors, including professionals from the retail and wholesale sectors, design, and handicrafts, as well as numerous private individuals in search of unique gifts. In summary, the 'New Year Gift' fair is a vibrant and colorful place where tradition and modern trends come together. It offers a unique opportunity to experience the diversity and creativity of the exhibitors and is a must-visit for anyone interested in the latest trends in gifts and lifestyle. The ExpoForum in Saint Petersburg, easily accessible and equipped with excellent facilities, provides the perfect setting for this impressive event.

WorldFood Istanbul is much more than a traditional food trade fair. It is regarded as a central, annual platform for the international food industry, dedicated to innovation, sustainability, and global exchange. The name "WorldFood" underscores the event's global scope: In Istanbul, producers, decision-makers, retailers, marketing experts, and technology providers from every continent come together to explore current developments, innovative products, and the latest technologies in food and beverages. The event is held at the renowned Tüyap Fair Convention & Congress Center, which offers an ideal setting for the trade fair thanks to its modern infrastructure and convenient location. The event is organized by ICA Events. Over the course of four days, WorldFood Istanbul addresses key industry topics. The opening day focuses on market potential, export opportunities, economic forecasts, and trends. The second day highlights climate protection, sustainability, and innovative production methods. This is followed by new quality standards, clean label concepts, and functional foods that promote healthy nutrition. The final day covers artificial intelligence, experience design, and the digital transformation of the sector. A special feature is the "Food Tech Garage", which brings together start-ups and established companies to jointly develop solutions for greater efficiency, sustainability, and climate protection. The trade fair not only presents foods from a wide range of segments—from raw materials to finished products for retail—but also showcases advanced technologies, packaging solutions, and services along the entire value chain. Exhibitors represent all areas of the food industry, including producers, suppliers, machine manufacturers, and distributors. The professional audience primarily consists of decision-makers, buyers, manufacturers, retailers, and marketing professionals. As a bridge between Europe and Asia, Istanbul offers ideal conditions for WorldFood Istanbul. The fair reinforces the city’s role as a global hub for the food trade and opens doors to the dynamic Turkish market as well as new international sales opportunities. The Tüyap Fair Center is easily accessible by public transportation and car, offers ample parking, and impresses with its modern facilities. Each year, WorldFood Istanbul becomes the central meeting point for everyone who wants to actively shape the future of the food industry.

The International Consumer Product Fair (ICPF) is one of the most prominent platforms for showcasing and marketing consumer goods in South Asia. Held annually at the state-of-the-art Karachi Expo Center – the renowned exhibition venue in Pakistan’s economic hub, Karachi – the fair benefits from a strategic location that ideally connects innovation, commerce, and consumers. Organized by Ecommerce Gateway Pakistan PVT Ltd., a seasoned organizer of international trade exhibitions with extensive industry expertise, the ICPF goes far beyond a traditional sales platform. It serves as a specialized industry gathering that fosters cross-border exchange of trends, innovations, and business models. The fair covers a broad spectrum of consumer goods – ranging from beauty & fitness, household items, fashion and jewelry to bags, footwear, gifts, stationery, and food products. The diversity and depth of the exhibits provide clear added value: from cutting-edge anti-aging solutions, fragrance and aromatherapy products, professional salon equipment, cosmetics, and hair care, to electrical appliances, kitchen and bathroom fittings, home textiles, accessories, stationery, and school supplies – all the way to food items such as confectionery, dry goods, oils, and beverages. Even niche areas like e-learning, educational technology, and sustainable products are prominently featured, highlighting the fair’s exceptional thematic breadth. The ICPF is not merely a product exhibition – it also reflects Pakistan’s economic potential. With its international orientation, the event places Karachi in the spotlight as a vibrant business location with global reach. Numerous national and international exhibitors from industries such as beauty, household goods, fashion, technology, food, and education take the opportunity to present their latest developments to a diverse professional audience. On the visitor side, the fair attracts a high-caliber audience: decision-makers from advertising agencies, purchasing departments of department stores and government agencies, distributors, trade agents, and retailers, as well as professionals from the lifestyle, gift, and hospitality sectors. They come together to discover new products, establish business partnerships, and build long-term connections. A particular highlight of the ICPF is the international diversity of its exhibitors and visitors, which further enriches cultural and economic exchange. In essence, the ICPF is much more than a trade fair – it is a global showcase for consumer goods trends and innovations, a catalyst for new business relationships, and an impulse generator for Pakistan’s economic development. The Karachi Expo Center, centrally located and easily accessible by both public transport and private vehicle, provides the ideal venue for connecting international markets with local dynamics.

The "Marca" is an annual fair held in Bologna, Italy, at the renowned BolognaFiere exhibition center. It is the only Italian event that specifically targets the wholesale and private label sectors. The name "Marca" is central to the fair and symbolizes the importance of private labels. Organized by BolognaFiere S.p.A., one of the leading trade fair organizers, Marca serves as a key platform for manufacturers from various sectors to showcase their products and services to a wide audience and strengthen their presence in both the Italian and international markets. The fair focuses on main themes such as food, non-food items, packaging, and services, with a special emphasis on quality, sustainability, and innovation. The exhibition spectrum encompasses a variety of products: fresh and preserved foods, organic products, beverages, health and hygiene products, household and leisure items, pet food, and much more. Special attention is paid to "Made in Italy" products, renowned for their outstanding quality and authenticity. Moreover, the fair acts as a showcase for the latest trends and developments in the food and beverage industry. A highlight of the fair is the "International Private Label Selection (IPLS) Award", which recognizes outstanding new products, innovative ideas, and projects in the private label sector. Also significant is the "Marca Tech" special area, dedicated to the latest innovations in packaging, logistics, and services. Exhibitors come from various sectors, including food production, the packaging industry, logistics, and the service sector. The main visitors are retailers, importers, and national and international buyers interested in the latest developments and products in the private label area. With its strategically advantageous location and excellent accessibility via various modes of transportation, the Bologna fair site is an ideal meeting point for professionals from around the world. The Marca fair not only reflects the growth of the private label market but also highlights the significant role of Bologna and Italy in the international trade and industrial landscape.

The International Green Week (IGW) in Berlin, a prestigious and unique fair specializing in food, agriculture, and horticulture, is traditionally held in January at the Messe Berlin exhibition halls. Since its inception in 1926, IGW has evolved into a significant platform for food and luxury food producers from around the world. They use the fair as a marketplace, testing ground, and to enhance their image. A central aspect of the fair is the diverse product presentations. From fruits and vegetables to fish, meat, and dairy products, IGW offers a comprehensive insight into the current offerings and trends in the food industry. This is complemented by a rich assortment of wines, beers, and spirits, as well as international specialties, fulfilling the culinary desires of the visitors. In addition to traditional agricultural products, the fair also focuses on modern services like countryside holiday offers and information on renewable energy and sustainable raw materials. Thus, the fair reflects the ongoing transformation and increasing diversification in agriculture. IGW is not only attractive to the general public from Germany and neighboring countries but also draws professionals and representatives from agriculture, forestry, horticulture, and fisheries from around the world. This makes it an important platform for international exchange and networking. Highlights of the fair include stage cooking shows where top chefs demonstrate their skills and present new trends. The Regional-Star Award recognizes outstanding achievements in regional food production, while the Startup-Days provide a stage for young, innovative companies. Organized by Messe Berlin GmbH, the International Green Week ensures that each year the fair becomes an unforgettable experience for exhibitors and visitors. Messe Berlin, as the venue, with its modern infrastructure and central location, provides the ideal platform for this globally recognized event.

The Winter FancyFaire is more than a traditional trade show. It serves as a vibrant meeting point for the North American specialty food scene, bringing together thought leaders, producers, retailers, and trendsetters from across the industry. Organized by the renowned Specialty Food Association, Inc. (SFA), the event takes place annually in winter, rotating between various cities across the United States. The APIS Slovenia trade fair in Celje is an event for everyone passionate about bees and beekeeping. Since its founding in 1978, it has become an annual highlight and traditionally takes place in March. It is organized by Celje Beekeeping Society. The roots of beekeeping reach back into human history. Bees were kept for honey production in ancient Egypt over 4,500 years ago. The Egyptians were among the first to systematically breed bees by constructing hives from unfired clay. Beekeeping was also an integral part of life in other ancient cultures, such as the Greeks, Romans, and the Middle East. In the Middle Ages, beekeeping spread throughout Europe, with honey being used as a sweetener and beeswax for candle making. Modern beekeeping began in the 18th and 19th centuries with the development of new techniques and tools. Lorenzo Langstroth's introduction of the movable honeycomb frame in the 1850s revolutionized honey harvesting and improved hive management. This innovation facilitated efficient inspection and management of hives without undue disturbance to the bees. To address current challenges, researchers, beekeepers, and conservationists worldwide are working on developing more resistant bee breeds, improving beekeeping practices, using environmentally friendly pesticides, and restoring habitats. Furthermore, awareness of the essential role of bees in our ecosystem is gaining increasing importance. APIS Slovenia has established itself as the largest beekeeping trade fair in Slovenia and enjoys an excellent reputation throughout Europe. The fair offers a wide range of exhibitions and expert lectures. Visitors can discover a diverse range of bee products and beekeeping equipment, from honey and wax to the latest tools and technologies. Expert lectures by renowned lecturers provide in-depth insights into various aspects of beekeeping and offer an excellent opportunity to expand your knowledge. A highlight of the fair is the opportunity to equip yourself for the upcoming season. APIS Slovenia attracts a wide range of visitors, from hobbyists to professional beekeepers. It not only provides a platform for exchanging products and services but also promotes the exchange of experiences and networking within the beekeeping community. The event takes place on the grounds of Celje Fair, a renowned and well-equipped venue that offers ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors. Celje Fair is known for its hospitality and efficient organization, making APIS Slovenia a pleasant and enriching experience. Overall, APIS Slovenia in Celje is a must-attend event for anyone involved in beekeeping or interested in bees and their products. With its long tradition, comprehensive offerings, and the opportunity to deepen knowledge and equip oneself, it represents an important platform for the beekeeping community in Slovenia and throughout Europe.
