The Parizza fair takes place at the Paris Expo Porte de Versailles exhibition center and usually lasts for two days. The Parizza fair takes place jointly with the Sandwich & Snack Show. The Sandwich & Snack Show is a leading European event for fast-food restaurants and out-of-home consumption. By combining the two events, visitors and exhibitors benefit from an expanded range of products, services, and innovations that are relevant to both the pizza and sandwich and snack industries.

The Snack Show ranks among Europe’s leading trade fairs for contemporary snacking concepts, quick-service dining and the out-of-home food market. Held annually at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, it brings together the industry’s key players and provides a highly specialised marketplace for product innovation, technology and forward-looking foodservice concepts. Organised by RX France, one of the country’s foremost exhibition organisers and part of a global network of B2B event brands, the show extends well beyond a national platform. As part of an international portfolio, it attracts senior decision-makers from across Europe and further afield. Paris as the host city reinforces this global positioning. France is widely regarded as one of Europe’s most dynamic markets for bakery, snacking and chain catering, combining strong culinary heritage with a high level of innovation in foodservice. The Snack Show positions itself both as a trend barometer and as a business hub. The focus is on current developments in snacking, from plant-based and vegan concepts to gluten-free ranges, functional snacks and emerging flavour profiles. Exhibits include aperitifs, sweet snacks, ice cream and desserts, bread and baked goods, pasta, salads, sandwiches, sauces, meat and charcuterie products, dairy, frozen foods and international specialities. The offer is complemented by a comprehensive drinks segment covering tea, matcha, energy drinks, juices, natural soft drinks, syrups and lemonades. Non-food categories are equally prominent, with packaging solutions, labelling, disposable and reusable tableware, and tabletop accessories reflecting the growing importance of sustainable and functional presentation formats in the out-of-home sector. A particular draw for trade visitors is the technology and equipment segment, notably the “Smart Lab”, which showcases foodtech solutions, professional kitchen equipment, digital ordering and EPOS systems, and efficiency tools for foodservice operators, caterers and on-the-go concepts. In addition, “Parizza” provides a dedicated, closely integrated area for Italian-inspired snack and catering concepts, with a strong emphasis on pizza and pasta solutions. In this way, the show brings together several specialised segments under one roof. Exhibitors represent the food and beverage industry, packaging, catering equipment, foodtech, logistics and digital services. The event is primarily targeted at operators of quick-service restaurants, bakeries, coffee shops and chain catering businesses, as well as catering companies, hoteliers, retailers, petrol station and travel retail operators, investors and franchisors. As such, the Snack Show covers the entire out-of-home value chain. As an annual industry event, the show benefits from the modern infrastructure of the Porte de Versailles exhibition centre. The venue is directly connected to the Paris Metro and tram network and is easily accessible both from the city centre and from the international airports Charles de Gaulle and Orly. The combination of a global city, state-of-the-art exhibition facilities and a fast-growing foodservice market makes the Snack Show a key date in the calendar for anyone looking to shape the future of Europe’s snacking and quick-service sectors.

Established in 2022, it is an annual event organized by City Events, a renowned organizer of major events. SIMEC aims to highlight the importance of the fishing sector and bring together various sectors and activities in this field. The fair is the first of its kind in Saudi Arabia, explicitly focusing on these topics. A primary focus is on exchanging experiences and promoting knowledge and awareness of the importance and marketing of seafood, particularly aiming to boost seafood consumption. The area of aquaculture, which has been the fastest-growing food production system worldwide over the past five decades, is especially noteworthy. The fair acknowledges the significant achievements made by the sector, thanks to substantial investments by many countries globally. SIMEC provides a platform to showcase and discuss these successes and developments. A highlight of the fair is the large exhibition, which brings together various sectors and activities in one place. This emphasizes the numerous benefits of Saudi Arabia's strategic location. SIMEC aims to gather the best international experiences and global expertise. The Better Home & Living Show is an annual event held at the impressive Pettigrew Green Arena at the Eastern Institute of Technology, Hawke's Bay Campus, Napier. The Pettigrew Green Arena is a versatile event center with top-notch facilities, making it ideal for a wide range of events. The fair is organized by Jade Promotions & Events, a leading New Zealand trade show and event management company specializing in organizing high-quality consumer shows and industry events. Jade Promotions & Events organizes the Home & Garden Shows as well as the Better Home & Living Shows in various New Zealand cities, including Hawke's Bay. However, these locations and dates can change from year to year. The Better Home & Living Show covers a wide range of industries, including interior design, gardening and landscaping, renewable energy, kitchen and bathroom design, smart home technologies, and wellness and lifestyle products. A key focus of the event is on eco-friendly and sustainable solutions for modern living spaces. Highlights include the presentation of new products and services, innovative DIY ideas, expert workshops, and lectures. The Better Home & Living Show is known for its excellent selection of high-quality exhibitors and diverse offerings that leave no wishes unfulfilled. In summary, the Better Home & Living Show at the Pettigrew Green Arena on the Hawke's Bay Campus is a significant event for anyone looking to enhance their home and lifestyle, with a particular emphasis on sustainability and innovations in the living space.

The Foodservice & Hospitality Expo, inaugurated in 2018, has established itself as a premier event in Romania's thriving hotel and hospitality industry. Hosted by Marketing Zone SRL, this trade fair is held in Bucharest, specifically in Hala Laminor, a venue renowned for its extensive facilities and exceptional suitability for events and exhibitions. This specialized expo serves as a central platform for professionals in the hospitality sector to explore the latest products, services, and trends in the industry. It stands out for its comprehensive showcase of various hospitality segments, including a wide array of exhibitors presenting a range of products from food and beverages to innovative non-food items, furniture, and technological solutions. The event places a special emphasis on interactivity and firsthand experiences, featuring culinary demonstrations, innovative cooking shows — with a focus on vegan cuisine — and competitions such as the Sushi Cup and thrilling pastry chef challenges. A highlight of the fair is the opportunity for attendees not only to get acquainted with products and services but also to participate in workshops. These sessions address current and significant topics such as food waste, sustainability in catering, functional design in the hotel industry, as well as tax obligations and relevant legislation. Furthermore, the Foodservice & Hospitality Expo acts as a stage for innovation, with the 'Innovation Showcase' inspiring participants through demonstrations of new and pioneering products and services. Beyond the opportunity to deepen business relationships, the Expo offers a unique chance for owners of bars and cafes, chefs, purchasing managers, sommeliers, bartenders, baristas, and consultants to network, learn, and enhance their knowledge and skills through direct interaction and feedback from industry peers. The Foodservice & Hospitality Expo transcends a traditional trade fair; it emphasizes experience, continuing education, and community development, making it an indispensable event in the annual calendar of every professional in Romania's hotel and hospitality industry. It represents not only the diversity and creativity of the sector but also underscores Bucharest's role as an emerging hub for hospitality and tourism in Eastern Europe.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Speciality & Fine Food Fair (SFFF) is one of the leading trade fairs for premium food and drink specialties in the United Kingdom. Held annually in September at the prestigious ExCeL London in the heart of London, the event is organised by Montgomery International Ltd., a globally active and experienced trade show organiser. The fair is considered a must-attend event for professionals in the fine food trade, gastronomy, and high-end retail sectors. The fair serves as a platform for discovering and tasting innovative products from both the UK and abroad. It fosters meaningful dialogue among producers, buyers, retailers, importers, exporters, and hospitality professionals. The focus lies firmly on quality, authenticity, and taste – from award-winning cheeses and craft spirits to internationally recognised delicatessen products. With a clear emphasis on the evolving needs of a dynamic industry—where provenance, craftsmanship and sustainability play an increasingly vital role—the Speciality & Fine Food Fair provides targeted inspiration. Signature features such as “Pitch Live”, where emerging brands present their products to leading retailers, and the “Start-Up Village”, which showcases innovative newcomers, help bring the latest trends to light. A particular highlight is the curated education programme on the “Food for Thought” stage. Industry experts offer valuable insights into current developments, including trend forecasting, artificial intelligence in retail, ethical sustainability, gender diversity in the drinks sector, and cyber resilience. This knowledge-sharing format adds significant value beyond the product showcases. The newly designed Village Square serves as the central networking hub, offering space for regional tastings, moderated discussions, and business matchmaking. The fair experience is further enriched by immersive zones such as the Drinks Quarter, Wine Cellar and Great Taste Deli, where visitors can explore the latest flavour and consumer trends. Firmly rooted in London and the UK, the Speciality & Fine Food Fair highlights regional British specialties while simultaneously positioning the country as an international hub for fine food innovation. The historic ExCeL London, with its central location and excellent public transport links, offers ideal conditions for national and international trade visitors. For those seeking new impulses, a strong focus on quality, and opportunities to connect with thought leaders across the sector, the Speciality & Fine Food Fair remains an essential event on the industry calendar.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The International Food & Drink Event (IFE) is one of the UK’s leading trade shows for the food and drink industry. Held annually at the prestigious ExCeL London, the event transforms the modern exhibition venue in East London into a key meeting point for decision-makers, buyers and brands from around the world. It is organised by Montgomery International Ltd., an experienced British exhibition organiser with a strong international outlook and extensive industry connections. IFE spans the full breadth of the food and drink sector, structured into clearly defined product areas. These include vegan and plant-based products, speciality and artisan foods, chilled and frozen lines, ambient grocery, and wholesale ranges. Health-focused, organic and naturally positioned products also feature prominently. International pavilions showcase culinary concepts from around the globe, creating tangible import and distribution opportunities within the UK market. The show is further enhanced by a dedicated start-up area for emerging brands, a specialist cheese pavilion for premium dairy products, a “free-from” zone for allergen-free and specialist formulations, and a business support hub offering guidance on growth strategies and market entry. In addition, technological innovation, packaging solutions and specialist services for manufacturing, logistics and retail form an integral part of the exhibition. Exhibitors represent virtually every segment of the food and drink industry: producers of ready meals, meat and seafood, bakery products, snacks, confectionery and spices, alongside drinks manufacturers ranging from spirits and soft drinks to low- and no-alcohol propositions. The line-up also includes organic producers, innovative food tech companies and international brands seeking to expand into the UK market. IFE is strictly a trade-only event. Buyers from major retail chains, wholesalers, distributors and importers, as well as foodservice operators, hospitality professionals, product developers and category managers, attend to source products, monitor market developments and build strategic partnerships. A comprehensive programme of seminars, trend briefings and panel discussions provides in-depth insights into consumer behaviour, sustainability requirements and current market trends in the UK and beyond. ExCeL London offers a modern infrastructure, expansive exhibition halls and excellent transport links. Located in the revitalised Royal Docks area, it is directly connected to the public transport network, including the Elizabeth Line and the Docklands Light Railway, and is just minutes from London City Airport. As such, IFE provides not only a commercially relevant marketplace but also a logistically convenient platform for companies looking to succeed in the global food and drink sector.

ANUGA Select Brazil is an international trade fair for food and beverages and ranks among the leading business platforms for the food and drink industry in South America. Held annually in April at the Centro de Convenções – Distrito Anhembi in São Paulo, the event brings together producers, importers, distributors, service providers and senior decision-makers with a clear commercial focus. Its purpose is to generate tangible business opportunities, assess market potential and build long-term partnerships. Rather than serving as a straightforward product showcase, the fair positions itself as a strategic hub for innovation, knowledge exchange and international networking. The event is organised by Koelnmesse Organização de Feiras Ltda., the Brazilian subsidiary of Koelnmesse, one of the world’s leading trade fair organisers in the food sector. In addition to its Cologne base, Koelnmesse delivers further ANUGA formats in high-growth markets such as Asia and the Middle East, creating a global network that gives exhibitors direct access to international sales markets. The exhibition presents a broad yet clearly structured product range, including bakery and confectionery, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, dairy products, frozen foods, fine foods, fresh fruit and vegetables, canned and ambient goods, as well as organic and health products. The offering is complemented by retail and point-of-sale solutions, along with services for the grocery retail and foodservice sectors. In doing so, the event covers the entire value chain — from production and processing through to distribution and in-store presentation. A strong emphasis is placed on trends, innovation and market intelligence. ANUGA Select Brazil addresses key issues such as sustainable production, transparent supply chains, new product development, clean-label strategies and shifting consumer preferences. It provides in-depth insights into consumer behaviour across Latin America, set within a broader international context. Specialist forums, conference sessions and networking formats equip industry leaders with strategic input for business development. Exhibitors represent sectors including dairy, organic food production, beverages, foodservice, import and export, as well as related service industries. Trade visitors include professionals from grocery retail and wholesale, hospitality, catering, distribution and food processing. The fair is therefore firmly targeted at a qualified B2B audience with defined purchasing and investment intentions. São Paulo’s role as host city underscores the event’s economic significance. As Brazil’s largest city and principal commercial and financial centre, it serves as a gateway to the Latin American food market. Brazil itself is one of the world’s leading agricultural and food producers. The Centro de Convenções – Distrito Anhembi is among the country’s most established exhibition and convention venues. Modern infrastructure, extensive exhibition space and convenient access to international airports and major transport links ensure straightforward travel for trade visitors from Brazil and abroad. ANUGA Select Brazil combines global exhibition expertise with in-depth regional market knowledge. As part of an international trade fair portfolio, it fosters cross-market synergies and provides companies with a focused platform to showcase innovation, strengthen business relationships and actively shape the future of the food system.

HORECA Kuwait is a highly specialized annual trade fair dedicated entirely to the hospitality sector. The name "HORECA" stands for HOtel, REstaurant, and CAfé, reflecting the close interconnection between these industries and their associated supply and service markets. The event takes place at the Kuwait International Fairground in Mishref, Kuwait City—one of the leading exhibition venues in the Gulf region, known for its modern infrastructure, convenient accessibility, and regular hosting of major international industry events. The fair is organized by Hospitality Services s.a.r.l. , a well-established Lebanese company with decades of experience in staging high-quality trade shows for the hotel, restaurant, and gastronomy sectors. In addition to Kuwait, Hospitality Services also organizes HORECA events in Lebanon (Beirut), Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Jordan—creating a valuable network of platforms that serve the hospitality industry throughout the Middle East. HORECA Kuwait is more than just a product showcase—it serves as an interactive industry platform that brings together emerging trends, technological innovations, and hospitality professionals. Key focus areas include sustainability, digital transformation, and culinary innovation in the hospitality sector. Leading suppliers present state-of-the-art kitchen technology, refrigeration and storage solutions, as well as interior design concepts tailored to hotels, restaurants, and catering businesses. The exhibition spans a wide range of offerings, from professional kitchen equipment and furnishings to specialized IT solutions for operational processes in foodservice. A standout feature of the event is its interactive competitions. The Hospitality Salon Culinaire gives chefs from across the region an opportunity to showcase their skills. The program is further enriched by popular contests such as the Barista Competition, the Creative Mocktail Competition, and the Bed Making Competition. These events not only promote networking among industry professionals but also provide a platform for young talent and stimulate quality advancement across the sector. Additionally, the HORECA Talks segment offers a stage for expert lectures and panel discussions on the industry's most pressing challenges—from workforce management and sustainability strategies to innovative business models. Exhibitors primarily represent sectors such as hotel and restaurant equipment, food production, kitchen and appliance technologies, and hospitality services. The trade show targets a professional audience that includes hoteliers, restaurateurs, catering companies, food retailers, investors, and key decision-makers from related industries such as event management and tourism. HORECA Kuwait is thus much more than a conventional trade fair—it is a vital meeting point for the hospitality industry with strong regional relevance and international appeal. It plays a pivotal role in positioning Kuwait as an emerging hub for modern hospitality and culinary excellence. The venue—the Kuwait International Fairground—offers a prime location between the city center, airport, and major hotel clusters, making HORECA Kuwait a must-attend event for anyone looking to shape or be inspired by the future of hospitality.

Djazagro , a leading trade fair for agriculture and food production, was established in 2003 and has been held annually at the SAFEX Exhibition Park in Algiers ever since. The name "Djazagro" is a blend of "Djazaïr", the Algerian-Arabic name for Algeria, and "Agro", which reflects the fair's focus on the agricultural and food sectors. It is organized by Comexposium, one of the world's leading trade fair organizers, and is considered an essential event for professionals in the food and beverage industry and related fields. At the fair, international exhibitors showcase their latest products and services in various segments, including food processing, bakery, confectionery, food products, beverages, hospitality, and catering. The offerings include packaging machines, bottling lines, ovens, confectionery equipment, flavorings, food additives, cleaning and hygiene equipment, refrigeration technology, and equipment for the hospitality industry. A highlight of the fair is the Djaz'Innov competition, where exhibitors have the opportunity to present their innovations in products, services, or technologies. In addition, numerous conferences and seminars by experts enrich the program, providing insights into current trends and valuable industry information. Djazagro primarily attracts professionals from the food production and processing, hospitality, and catering industries and serves as an important platform for exchange between local and international players. As a permanent fixture in the annual event calendar, it reflects the dynamic development of the food industry both in Algeria and internationally. The SAFEX Exhibition Park in Algiers, as the venue, offers ideal conditions for international exhibitors and visitors due to its central location and accessibility. Thus, Djazagro highlights Algeria's significance as a key gateway to the African and Mediterranean economic regions.

The "NutraFood Poland" has established itself as an international trade fair and leading platform in Poland for nutraceuticals and functional foods. The name "NutraFood," a combination of "Nutraceuticals" and "Functional Foods," reflects the fair's focus on dietary supplements and functional foods. As an annual event, it takes place in the prestigious Warszawskie Centrum EXPO XXI in Warsaw. This location is not only easily accessible but also serves as a central hub for international exhibitors and visitors. The fair is organized by Lentewenc Sp. z o.o. Ltd., a company known for its commitment to promoting health and wellness. The main themes of the fair encompass a diverse range of products and services. These include dietary supplements, functional foods and beverages, natural ingredients, raw materials and additives, as well as innovative technologies and services for the food industry, including private labeling and contract manufacturing. The fair strengthens its connection to Poland by serving as a platform for local and international companies to present and discuss the latest trends and innovations in this sector. A highlight is the "Golden Medal NutraFood Poland Competition," a contest that recognizes the best products and innovations in the industry. Additionally, the fair offers an extensive program of conferences, panel discussions, and presentations by industry experts. Topics covered include nutrition trends, scientific research, technological innovations, and legal regulations. The range of exhibitors is impressive, extending from manufacturers to technology startups. The visitors also come from a wide range of fields, including buyers from retail chains, pharmacies, specialty stores, and the wellness industry, as well as industry experts and specialists. Finally, it is important to highlight that the Warszawskie Centrum EXPO XXI, with its modern infrastructure and central location in Warsaw, is an ideal venue for an international fair of this kind. Its easy accessibility via various means of transport makes it attractive for both exhibitors and visitors.

Held annually, the Health Food Ingredients & OEM Exhibition is the premier industry event for professionals who are not only observing the transformation of the nutrition landscape but actively shaping it. Located in the heart of Tokyo at the prestigious Tokyo International Forum, the exhibition brings together innovation, science, and business under one roof. Organized by Health Business Media Co., Ltd., the exhibition targets a highly specialized audience from sectors such as food technology, product development, OEM manufacturing, packaging solutions, and quality management. At its core, the event focuses on health-promoting food ingredients that offer added value to consumers through targeted functionality – including vitamins, probiotic cultures, and plant extracts. OEM and contract manufacturing also play a central role: from raw materials to production, packaging, and analytics, visitors can explore the entire value chain. A particularly dynamic theme is the megatrend of plant-based nutrition – featuring innovative protein sources such as legumes, plant-based milk alternatives, and meat substitutes. This is complemented by emerging food resources like microorganisms, insects, algae, and cultured meat – all of which represent innovations with significant global sustainability potential. Modern fermentation technologies are another focal point, especially in connection with functional ingredients for healthy diets. Additional key areas include food safety, quality assurance, and smart processing and packaging technologies – from AI-powered foreign object detection to intelligent packaging solutions that extend shelf life. Moreover, the exhibition positions itself as a platform for solutions to reduce food waste – whether through upcycling, sustainable packaging, or innovative preservation techniques. In doing so, it makes a meaningful contribution to the sustainable transformation of the food industry and highlights Japan’s role as a pioneer in technological innovation. Exhibitors represent a broad spectrum of industries, including food production, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, analytics, packaging, mechanical engineering, and trade. The main target groups are product developers, R&D managers, buyers, brand owners, start-ups, and OEM service providers seeking new ingredients, technologies, or production partners. The Tokyo International Forum, with its central location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, proximity to international hotels, and excellent access to public and long-distance transportation, offers ideal conditions for visitors and exhibitors from around the globe. Whether arriving by Shinkansen, plane, or subway, the Health Food Ingredients & OEM Exhibition is easy to reach – making a visit to the Tokyo trade fair an efficient and inspiring experience.

WorldFood Poland is an international fair dedicated to the fields of food and beverages, food processing, and packaging. As the largest food fair in Poland, it connects traders, retailers, manufacturers, and industry associations. The annual event takes place at the Warszawskie Centrum EXPO XXI in Warsaw, known for its excellent accessibility and modern facilities. Organized by Lentewenc Sp. z o.o. Ltd., a company experienced in the organization of trade fairs, "WorldFood Poland" offers a wide range of products and services. This includes raw materials, additives, food products, and beverages, as well as packaging and logistics solutions. Special attention is given to segments such as organic foods, functional foods, dietary supplements, and plant-based meat and dairy alternatives. The fair reflects the dynamism and diversity of the food industry, both in Poland and internationally, serving as a showcase for innovations and current trends. Highlights of the program include the "WorldFood Gold Medal" competition for outstanding products and various conferences and workshops with industry experts, addressing important topics like sustainable meat production and alternative protein sources. With a broad spectrum of exhibitors from the fields of food production, beverage manufacturing, technology, as well as packaging and logistics, the fair appeals to a diverse audience. This includes producers, suppliers, retailers, and wholesalers, as well as industry specialists, emphasizing the fair's significance for trade and networking. Finally, the Warszawskie Centrum EXPO XXI in Warsaw, with its modern infrastructure and central location, provides an ideal venue. The vibrant culture and history of Warsaw further enrich the experience for fair visitors. The good transport connections and proximity to accommodations and dining facilities make the fair center an attractive meeting point for professionals from around the world.

The " Food & Drink OEM Matching Expo ", commonly referred to as the OEM Expo , is an annual trade fair held at Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo. Hosted by Japan Food Journal Co., Ltd., it has established itself as an essential platform for professionals in the food and beverage industry who specialize in the development and production of private labels and OEM products. OEM stands for "Original Equipment Manufacturer", which in this context refers to the production of products under a brand name that does not belong to the manufacturer. Therefore, the fair provides an excellent opportunity to gain deep insights into private label production and establish direct business relationships. The expo covers topics such as processed foods, fresh produce, confections and desserts, spices and sauces, dietary supplements, and beverages, including alcoholic drinks. Additionally, consulting services and analytical devices and systems are presented, enabling participants to explore all aspects from product development to quality control. Exhibitors come from various sectors of food production and related services, ranging from large international corporations to specialized small businesses. The main audience for the fair includes decision-makers in the industry, such as purchasers, product developers, and marketing professionals, making the event a key meeting place for networking and industry insights. Access to the venue, Tokyo Big Sight, is facilitated by its central location and excellent transportation links, including train and bus connections. The modern facilities and impressive architecture of the convention center attract thousands of visitors each year and create an inspiring environment for exhibitions and networking.

The Future Rice Fair is a pioneering trade fair dedicated to the future of rice cultivation and the development of innovative rice-based products. Since its inception in 2022, it has established itself as a key platform for exchanging insights on current developments and trends in the rice industry. Held annually at the prestigious Tokyo Big Sight, Japan’s largest exhibition and convention center, the fair welcomes industry professionals from around the world. Organized by Japan Food Journal Co., Ltd., a leading media group in the food industry, the Future Rice Fair brings together producers, traders, and experts to discuss the future of rice and showcase innovative solutions. A core objective of the fair is to drive transformation in the rice industry and unlock new market potential. The focus is on pioneering cultivation methods, sustainable and technological solutions for rice production, and innovative processing and marketing strategies. Companies and start-ups present cutting-edge technologies, optimized rice varieties, sustainable packaging concepts, and creative rice-based products for the foodservice and retail sectors. The Future Rice Fair attracts exhibitors from various fields within the food industry, including rice producers, food technology providers, packaging companies, and manufacturers of specialized rice processing equipment. For professionals in gastronomy, trade, and food production, the fair serves as a valuable hub for discovering new business opportunities and networking with industry peers. A particular highlight of the fair is the expert seminar, where industry leaders share practical insights and strategies for overcoming current challenges and tapping into new markets. Complementing this, networking events and expert panels provide in-depth analyses of industry trends and best practices. The Future Rice Fair is part of FABEX, a leading trade fair platform for the foodservice and gastronomy industries. This close integration offers visitors an extended range of opportunities and additional synergies with other events in the food sector. The choice of Tokyo as the venue highlights the deep cultural and dietary significance of rice in Japan. Tokyo Big Sight is not only a state-of-the-art exhibition center with first-class infrastructure but also highly accessible via public transport. Visitors can conveniently reach the venue via the Yurikamome and Rinkai Lines, which connect the exhibition grounds directly to the city center. Moreover, the vibrant metropolis of Tokyo offers a rich culinary and cultural experience, making a visit to the fair an immersive and holistic event.

UzFood is an international trade fair for food and beverages in Uzbekistan. Held annually in spring at the UEC Uzexpocentre in Tashkent, it serves as a key platform for industry professionals, companies, and experts. As the most important event of its kind in Central Asia, UzFood brings together exhibitors and visitors from various sectors, including producers, importers, exporters, retailers, restaurateurs, and food technologists. The fair is organized by Iteca Exhibitions, a company specializing in the organization of high-profile trade fairs. UzFood covers a wide spectrum of the food industry, showcasing the latest trends, products, and technologies. Key themes include food and beverages, such as meat and fish products, dairy products, baked goods, confectionery, frozen foods, and beverages. Additionally, ingredients and additives, including spices, flavors, organic products, and sweeteners, are a major focus. Another core area is food processing and packaging, featuring machinery for food production, innovative packaging solutions, and systems for labeling and quality assurance. The HoReCa sector (Hotels, Restaurants, Catering) also plays a significant role at UzFood. The fair presents professional kitchen equipment, bakery appliances, as well as coffee and tea accessories. Moreover, it highlights advancements in agricultural and agritech solutions, including modern greenhouse technologies, agricultural machinery, and innovations in seed and crop protection. A special highlight of UzFood is its live demonstrations, expert lectures, and conferences, which provide visitors with the opportunity to experience new technologies firsthand and engage with industry specialists on the latest developments. The fair plays a crucial role in advancing Uzbekistan’s food industry by fostering innovation, strengthening international business relations, and offering companies a platform to present themselves to a growing market. UzFood attracts companies from numerous sectors, including food production, gastronomy, retail, agriculture, and packaging technology. Its primary audience consists of decision-makers and professionals looking for new products, business partners, and innovative solutions. As Uzbekistan’s economic hub, Tashkent provides a modern infrastructure for trade fairs and congresses at the UEC Uzexpocentre. Conveniently located, the venue offers easy access from both the airport and the city center. This makes UzFood the ideal meeting point for businesses and experts to actively shape the future of the food and beverage industry in Uzbekistan and beyond.

The "Market of Good Taste" (Markt des guten Geschmacks) in Stuttgart, a standout fair of the Slow Food movement, takes place annually in the spring. It is dedicated to showcasing and promoting regional specialties that are free from additives. Since its inception, the fair has evolved into a significant meeting point for gourmets and consumers who value quality, taste, and sustainable production. Organized by Messe Stuttgart GmbH, the fair presents an impressive selection of food and beverages from regional producers, with a focus on the quality and taste experience of the products. The event serves not only as a platform for exchange between visitors and exhibitors but also as a place for education and active participation. Visitors have the opportunity to engage directly with the producers, sample their products, and become actively involved in the fair's own cooking workshop. Under guidance, they can prepare their own dishes and then enjoy them in a convivial round. In addition to food and beverages, the fair's offerings also include handmade kitchen furniture and utensils, as well as specialist books on topics related to food and drink. An extensive program of discussion forums and lectures provides deeper insights into the Slow Food movement and sustainable food production. The fair is held at the easily accessible Stuttgart Exhibition Center, located near the A8 motorway. Thanks to its proximity to Stuttgart Airport and the numerous parking options available both at the exhibition grounds and in the airport parking garage, arrival by car and on foot is convenient. The connection to public transport also ensures a hassle-free arrival for visitors from different regions. With its spring timing, the "Market of Good Taste" has established itself as an important event that embodies the values of the Slow Food movement and provides a platform for exchange and discovery of regional, sustainable food and products.

The Biohacking Days are far more than a conventional trade fair. They serve as an annual summit for those who want to take charge of their physical and mental well-being using evidence-based and practical methods. The name “Biohacking Days "stands for an immersive experience platform dedicated to the creative and holistic optimization of human biology. Each spring, Messe Stuttgart opens its doors to this forward-thinking event, organized by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, in the heart of Baden-Württemberg. At the core of the Biohacking Days is the fusion of scientific expertise, cutting-edge technology, and experience-driven formats in an inspiring setting. The thematic focus spans holistic health, mental resilience, recovery, stress management, and the digital tracking of bodily functions. Traditional knowledge meets modern science – through breathwork, cold therapy, nutritional supplements, and tracking technologies. The program features expert-led talks from renowned speakers, hands-on workshops covering topics such as ice bathing, yoga, and cycle-based well-being, as well as interactive experiences with wearables, functional mushrooms, and meditation techniques. The event encourages active participation, fosters exchange, and opens up new perspectives on personal health awareness. The Biohacking Days appeal to a broad and diverse audience – from health-conscious individuals to coaches, therapists, and professionals in the fields of nutrition, fitness, wellness, and medicine. At the same time, the event serves as a platform for exhibitors to showcase the latest innovations in health, lifestyle, and technology – from functional nutrition and training concepts to digital tools and bioenergetic applications. A distinctive feature of the Biohacking Days is their integration into the Stuttgart Spring Fairs, creating valuable synergies with parallel events such as YogaWorld, Slow Food, and VeganWorld. The Biohacking Days combine inspiration with practical applicability and offer a platform that is unique in its format and depth. The venue – a modern, easily accessible exhibition center located directly at the airport and connected to public transport – ensures a convenient and seamless visit. Anyone looking to explore their full potential in body and mind will find the perfect space here.

The PharmExpo Central Asia is a leading trade fair for the pharmaceutical industry in Central Asia, held annually at CAEx Uzbekistan in Tashkent. As an integral part of the renowned Tashkent International Healthcare Exhibition (TIHE), it brings together experts, companies, and decision-makers from the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors to showcase the latest technologies, innovations, and market trends. The event is organized by Iteca Exhibitions, one of the most prominent organizers of international trade fairs in the region. It serves as a key platform for exchange between local and international players in the pharmaceutical industry. PharmExpo Central Asia focuses on advancements in pharmaceuticals, dietary supplements, traditional medical products, and pharmaceutical production technologies. Professional visitors gain insights into state-of-the-art drug manufacturing facilities, quality control equipment, packaging and labeling machines, as well as turnkey planning services. Special attention is also given to cleanroom technologies, laboratory equipment, and contract manufacturing, which are crucial to the pharmaceutical sector. Another central theme is the presentation of raw materials and ingredients required for the production of medicines and dietary supplements. Companies specializing in pharmaceuticals, medical devices, nutraceuticals, dietetics, and drug manufacturing use the exhibition as a prime platform to introduce their latest products and services. PharmExpo Central Asia attracts numerous visitors each year from the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare sector, research institutions, and government organizations. These include pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, research institutions, pharmacy chains, and distributors seeking new business opportunities and partnerships. Tashkent, as the host city, plays a pivotal role in the region's economic development. The dynamic capital of Uzbekistan is rapidly evolving into a significant trade and innovation hub for the pharmaceutical industry in Central Asia. Thanks to its strategic location and well-developed infrastructure, the city is easily accessible via Tashkent International Airport and an extensive transport network. As a modern venue, CAEx Uzbekistan provides optimal conditions for a successful exhibition that annually attracts a distinguished professional audience from around the world. PharmExpo Central Asia is more than just a trade fair—it is a central meeting point for innovation, knowledge exchange, and business development in the pharmaceutical industry of Central Asia. Anyone looking to succeed in this sector should not miss this event.

The BeoPlantFair in Belgrade is an annual exhibition dedicated to the fields of horticulture, medicinal herbs, and honey products. Since its inception in 1996, it has evolved into a significant meeting point for professionals, enthusiasts, and consumers alike. It is organized by the Belgrade Fair, an experienced host of renowned events. Each April, the fair provides a platform for discovering the latest innovations and services in its sector. In the horticulture area, visitors can learn about innovative products and services, ranging from seeds to modern irrigation systems. This segment promotes efficiency and sustainability in gardening and facilitates the exchange of expertise. The "Gifts of Nature" section deals with medicinal herbs, herbal cosmetics, botanical medicines, and honey products. Here, visitors can explore the diversity of natural products and learn about their applications and benefits. This exhibition emphasizes the importance of natural resources for health and well-being. The Belgrade Fair venue, with its excellent infrastructure and central location in Belgrade, offers ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors. It is renowned for its capacity to successfully host large international events. In summary, the BeoPlantFair is an annual event for anyone interested in horticulture, natural remedies, and honey products. With a comprehensive range of products and services, thematic special exhibitions, and excellent organization by the Belgrade Fair, the fair presents a unique opportunity to learn about current trends and innovations, exchange expertise, and establish business contacts.

InterFood Krasnodar is a specialized annual trade fair dedicated to food, beverages, and packaging technology. It has established itself as a key industry platform in southern Russia. Organized by MVK – International Exhibition Company, one of the country's leading trade fair organizers with extensive experience in hosting international exhibitions and conferences, InterFood provides industry professionals with an opportunity to explore the latest developments in the food and beverage sectors and connect with experts, manufacturers, suppliers, and decision-makers. The event takes place at Expograd Yug in Krasnodar, a modern exhibition and congress center known for its innovative infrastructure. The venue offers ideal conditions for showcasing new products, technologies, and services, making it one of the most important locations for trade events in southern Russia—further underscoring the fair’s significance. Access to InterFood is restricted to trade professionals only. This focused approach encourages practical, in-depth exchanges between exhibitors and buyers. A standout feature is the integrated negotiation center, where manufacturers and suppliers present their products directly to senior buyers and category managers from major retail chains and distributors—a unique format that enables efficient, high-level networking. The exhibition covers a broad yet clearly defined range of topics, including meat and poultry products, dairy and cheese, staple foods, grain-based goods, baked and confectionery items, non-alcoholic and low-alcohol beverages, beer, snacks, and catering supplies. This is complemented by displays of cutting-edge production and processing technologies, innovative packaging solutions, and efficient storage and logistics systems—particularly attractive to technology-focused professionals. Another highlight of the fair is its hands-on program of expert lectures and seminars on current topics such as the use of artificial intelligence in food production, brand strategies in consumer goods, lab data analysis, and risk management in manufacturing. Running alongside InterFood is the "Vinorus.Vinotech" exhibition, where Russian wineries showcase their products through professional tastings—adding further value for visitors with an interest in wine and spirits. With its thematic depth, clear focus, and recurring annual format, InterFood Krasnodar is an essential platform for professionals looking to stay ahead of industry trends, discover innovative products, and build valuable business connections—at one of Russia’s most dynamic hubs for the food and beverage industry.

FoodTech Krasnodar is a professional trade fair held annually in April and has established itself as the key industry meeting point for the food sector in southern Russia. Organized by MVK International Exhibition Company—an experienced event organizer with extensive expertise in staging specialized trade fairs across Russia—the event is exclusively aimed at industry professionals. It provides a dedicated platform for the exchange of innovations, technologies, and business opportunities throughout the entire value chain of food and beverage production. The venue is the modern Expograd Yug exhibition and congress center in Krasnodar, a major economic hub in southern Russia. Its spacious and well-equipped infrastructure offers ideal conditions for both international exhibitors and professional visitors. The fair focuses on cutting-edge technologies and solutions for food processing, packaging, refrigeration, storage, and quality control. Special emphasis is placed on practical advancements in production, logistics, and food safety. Attendees gain insights into state-of-the-art processing machinery, automated systems, hygiene technologies, vending solutions, as well as new ingredients and additives that are central to contemporary food production. A defining feature of FoodTech Krasnodar is its comprehensive perspective on the industry's challenges and potential. The fair bridges technological innovation with concrete strategies for enhancing efficiency, improving quality, and complying with regulatory standards. As such, it serves not only as a showcase for the latest developments but also as a driver of progress for companies seeking to remain competitive in a dynamic market. More than just a trade fair, FoodTech Krasnodar is an important forum for knowledge exchange and business development. Each year, it brings together professionals, decision-makers, and technology providers who come to explore future trends, build networks, and discover solutions for optimizing production and processes.

FOOD TAIPEI is an annual international food expo held at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center in Taipei, Taiwan. Organized by the Taiwan External Trade Development Council (TAITRA), it is recognized as a significant event in the food sector that attracts exhibitors and visitors from around the world. The expo showcases a comprehensive range of products: from fresh and preserved fruits and vegetables to poultry, seafood, various meats, processed meat products, and cooking oils, as well as dairy products. The selection also includes organic and vegetarian foods, frozen ready meals, canned goods, baked goods, cookies, and a variety of beverages such as wine, spirits, coffee, tea, juices, and soft drinks. Spices, confections, and ice cream further complement the offerings. In addition to serving as a trading platform, the expo also functions as a venue for exchange and education. It features cooking demonstrations by renowned chefs and hosts conferences, forums, and seminars with experts who discuss current trends and innovations in the food sector. A particular highlight is the Green Vision Award, which honors exhibitors for their exceptional commitment to environmental protection, social responsibility, and corporate governance. FOOD TAIPEI significantly contributes to the promotion of the local food industry and brings international attention to Taiwan's culinary diversity. The expo attracts professionals from the hospitality, wholesale, retail, and related industries. The Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, a modern and accessible venue, ranks among Asia's leading exhibition sites. With its excellent public transport connections, it offers ideal conditions for an international expo like FOOD TAIPEI, serving as a central hub for innovation and business development in the global food industry.

전시회명: CIHIE - China International Health Industry Expo
축제소개: CIHIE – China International Health Industry Expo has been an established trade fair since 2003 and has positioned itself as a leading platform for the international health industry. The name "CIHIE" reflects both its global outlook and its dedicated focus on the health sector. Held every year, the event alternates between the major cities of Shanghai and Beijing and is specifically tailored to professionals from the wellness, beauty, sports, preventive healthcare, and nutrition sectors. It is organized by Shibowei International Exhibition Co. Ltd., an experienced event organizer with a strong emphasis on the health and wellness industry. What sets CIHIE apart is its holistic approach: it brings together cutting-edge technologies—such as digital health solutions, biotechnology, and smart medical systems—with traditional Chinese medicine, particularly the dietary principles of the Tonic Diet. The exhibition also highlights forward-thinking themes like hydrogen-based medicine, innovative nutritional supplements, and sustainable, eco-friendly food ingredients. More than 900 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions showcase their latest products, technologies, and services—ranging from personal health management solutions and wellness products to materials for occupational health and safety. Attendees include buyers, traders, distributors, sales representatives, and professionals from the health, fitness, and wellness sectors who are actively seeking innovations and new business partnerships. A key feature of the event is the International Conference on the World Health Industry, which is complemented by expert forums, seminars, and competitions. These provide excellent networking opportunities and offer valuable insights into current market trends. CIHIE thus serves not only as a commercial platform but also as a driving force for future developments in the global health economy. Through its close connection with the Chinese healthcare market, CIHIE highlights China’s growing role as a hub of innovation and consumption in the international health landscape. Officially recognized by the Chinese Ministry of Commerce, it ranks among the country’s most significant health-related trade fairs and maintains a dynamic and diverse character through its rotation between two of China's major exhibition venues. Both locations—Shanghai and Beijing—feature state-of-the-art infrastructure, excellent transport connections, and easy access via domestic and international airports. Whether held at the Shanghai New International Expo Center or the China National Convention Center in Beijing, CIHIE provides a professional environment for forging business relationships, gaining inspiration, and experiencing the latest trends in the health industry firsthand.

The RHEMA is a significant regional trade fair in Altstätten, focusing on commerce, crafts, industry, agriculture, tourism, and gastronomy. The abbreviation RHEMA stands for "Rheintaler Messe Altstätten," with "Rheintal" referring to the valley of the Rhine, where the city of Altstätten is located. The fair takes place in Altstätten, a city in eastern Switzerland, on the exhibition grounds in Altstätten, which offers excellent transport connections and infrastructure. The Allmendplatz in Oberrieterstraße is located outside the town center towards Oberriet and is signposted from the Oberriet/Kriessern motorway exit. Since its founding, the fair has become an integral part of the region's event culture. The organizer of the RHEMA is Rhema Altstätten AG, an experienced company specializing in organizing trade fairs and events in the region. The RHEMA Rheintal Fair takes place every year and is divided into two weekends , attracting thousands of visitors from eastern Switzerland and neighboring countries. The fair offers a wide range of topics and products from various industries, including commerce, crafts, industry, agriculture, tourism, and gastronomy. The focus is on regional and national products, services, and innovations. Highlights of the fair include a diverse supporting program with live music, culinary tastings, expert lectures, and interactive activities for the whole family. RHEMA is known for its unique atmosphere, created by the combination of entertainment, information, and shopping opportunities. Overall, RHEMA in Altstätten provides an attractive event that offers a special experience for both locals and visitors from the surrounding area.

" Hi Korea " is an annual trade fair held at the COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in Seoul, which has established itself as a global hub for the health ingredients industry. The name of the fair, "H,," stands for "Health ingredients", representing the focus of the event: the presentation and exchange of health-promoting ingredients and technologies. It is organized by Informa Markets, a trading division of Informa PLC, and attracts professionals, manufacturers, traders, and service providers from around the world. The main themes of "Hi Korea" include health, natural and functional ingredients, functional food additives, food technology and equipment, nutraceuticals, and contract manufacturing. The range of products is diverse, encompassing functional foods, plant extracts, probiotics, antioxidants, as well as solutions for bone and joint health and weight management. A key focus of the fair is on fostering innovation and knowledge transfer. Highlights include numerous conferences and seminars with industry experts, as well as business matchmaking activities that offer excellent networking opportunities. The venue in Seoul emphasizes the international significance of the fair, as South Korea plays a leading role in the development of health and wellness products. The fair attracts representatives from various industries, including food engineering, biotechnology, and the pharmaceutical industry. Most visitors are involved in production, research and development, and sales, making "Hi Korea" an ideal venue for B2B business and partnerships. Hi Korea is part of a global series of fairs organized by Informa Markets that includes similar events worldwide. This allows participants and exhibitors to benefit from an expanded network and a better understanding of the market. The COEX Convention and Exhibition Center is excellently accessible by public transport, making it easy for both domestic and international participants and visitors to attend the fair. Located in the heart of one of Asia's most dynamic cities, the venue not only offers insights into the latest industry trends but also the chance to experience the vibrant culture and business world of Seoul.

SALÓN GOURMETS is Europe’s leading trade fair for high-quality food and beverages, making it an essential industry event for professionals in fine foods, gastronomy, hospitality, and retail. Since its inception in 1987, it has become a central platform for exclusive delicacies, innovative products, and emerging culinary trends. Held annually at the IFEMA exhibition center in Madrid, the event benefits from modern infrastructure, excellent transport connections, and ample parking, providing ideal conditions for an international gathering of this scale. Organized by Grupo Gourmets, a renowned company dedicated to promoting fine gastronomy and premium food products for decades, SALÓN GOURMETS brings together producers, suppliers, buyers, and decision-makers from around the world. The fair fosters new business relationships and showcases the latest innovations in the industry. The extensive offering includes gourmet foods, wines, spirits, organic products, and exclusive delicacies. In addition to the traditional exhibition, the event features an extensive supporting program with tastings, live cooking demonstrations, competitions, and expert lectures that provide valuable insights into current market trends and developments. Key highlights include themed experience areas such as the Wine Tunnel, olive oil and cheese exhibitions, and the innovation space, where groundbreaking products are unveiled. A dedicated business center and a tailored matchmaking service facilitate targeted networking between exhibitors and international buyers, helping businesses expand into new markets. With its unique combination of exquisite products, high-profile industry professionals, and a world-class venue, SALÓN GOURMETS stands among the most important platforms in the fine food sector—an unmissable event for those looking to experience and market premium food and beverages at the highest level.

SIAL Canada is one of Canada’s leading trade shows for the food, beverage, and hospitality sectors, serving as a central meeting point for professionals across this dynamic industry. The name SIAL – Salon International de l’Alimentation – highlights the event’s international focus and its specialization in food-related innovation. Since its inception in 2001, the trade show has become a major driver of innovation, commerce, and exchange within the North American agri-food sector. Held alternately in Montreal and Toronto each year, SIAL Canada brings together all key players under one roof. It is organized by the renowned Comexposium Group, one of the world’s largest trade show organizers with an extensive portfolio of international events. The Canadian edition is part of a global network that includes flagship shows in Paris, Jakarta, and Abu Dhabi. A defining feature of SIAL Canada is its clear thematic structure, divided into three focus areas: SIAL Food, SIAL Grocerant, and SIAL Packaging. SIAL Food covers the entire food production spectrum – from fresh products and beverages to niche categories such as baby food, frozen goods, and functional ingredients. SIAL Grocerant explores the growing intersection between foodservice and retail, emphasizing cutting-edge kitchen equipment, payment technologies, and service solutions. SIAL Packaging focuses on innovative and sustainable packaging concepts, logistics, and technological advancements across the supply chain. In addition to a broad product offering – ranging from cheese and olive oil to high-tech packaging – the trade show provides space for knowledge exchange, industry dialogue, and inspiration. It serves as a platform for Canadian producers, international brands, start-ups, retailers, foodservice professionals, and importers to identify trends, build business relationships, and strengthen their market presence. Deeply rooted in the Canadian market, SIAL Canada reflects the country’s cultural diversity, spirit of innovation, and commitment to sustainability. At the same time, it offers international companies a gateway to enter the North American market. One of SIAL Canada’s standout features is its range of competitions that spotlight the industry’s innovative spirit. The SIAL Innovation Award honors forward-thinking product ideas, the Olive d'Or recognizes the world’s finest olive oils, and the International Cheese Competition showcases the best in global cheesemaking. Additional highlights include a pitch contest for start-ups and the “SIAL To Go” format, which offers practical insights into current market developments. The event attracts a wide professional audience – from manufacturers and distributors to institutional foodservice experts – creating a highly specialized network designed for business success. Alongside the extensive exhibition, a conference program provides in-depth analysis and discussion of key industry topics. Whether at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal or the Enercare Centre in Toronto, both venues offer modern infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and are situated in vibrant urban environments. With international airports, convenient public transit links, and thriving culinary scenes, they provide the ideal setting for a trade fair that is more than just an exhibition: SIAL Canada is an experience, a marketplace of ideas, and a bridge between local markets and global opportunities.

InterFood Astana is an international trade fair held annually, with a clear focus on the food and beverage industry. Since its inception in 1999, it has grown into one of the most important industry gatherings in Central Asia, offering a platform for the exchange of innovations, technologies, and business connections across the entire food production value chain. The event takes place at the IEC EXPO International Exhibition Center in Astana, the vibrant capital of Kazakhstan. This modern venue stands out for its excellent infrastructure and convenient transport links—ideal conditions for bringing together professionals and exhibitors from various countries. Exclusively targeting industry professionals, the fair brings together companies, decision-makers, and experts from the fields of food, beverages, packaging, processing technologies, and hospitality. The exhibition showcases a wide range of products, from fresh and processed foods to alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, ingredients and additives, as well as machinery and technologies for processing, packaging, refrigeration, and storage. A particular emphasis is placed on sustainable solutions—such as eco-friendly packaging, energy-efficient production methods, and innovative recycling concepts. Organic products, healthy food alternatives, and new developments in food safety and logistics are also in focus. The exhibition is complemented by a high-quality supporting program, including expert presentations, workshops, and networking events where current trends and challenges are discussed. InterFood Astana is more than just an exhibition—it serves as a strategic springboard for international cooperation and new market opportunities. It provides direct access to Kazakh and Central Asian markets and enables manufacturers to establish targeted contacts with retailers and distributors. With its clear focus on industry professionals, comprehensive thematic offering, and both regional and international relevance, InterFood Astana has become a key meeting point for anyone active in the food and beverage sector or looking to enter new markets—a firmly established date in the industry's annual trade fair calendar.

The Food & Drink Processing Expo (FDP Expo) is India’s leading trade fair dedicated to the innovative food and beverage processing industry. Organized by Synergy Exposures & Events India Pvt. Ltd., it reflects the sector’s strong commitment to innovation, sustainability, and technological excellence. The fair takes place twice a year, with the venue rotating between two major cities in South India: the CODISSIA Trade Fair Complex on Avinashi Road in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, and the Palace Ground in Bengaluru, Karnataka. This strategic rotation ensures exhibitors and visitors have optimal access to the key industrial hubs of South India’s food and beverage sector. The FDP Expo showcases a broad spectrum of themes, from advanced food processing and automation technologies to beverage production and innovative packaging solutions. Exhibits include comprehensive systems for brewing, bottling, and the processing of dairy products, juices, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Additionally, the event highlights the latest developments in refrigeration and cold chain logistics, featuring technologies that support the efficient storage and transport of perishable goods. A core focus of the expo is on safety and quality control, covering testing equipment, laboratory technologies, and international standards such as HACCP and ISO. Sustainability and waste management are also central themes, with an emphasis on energy-efficient production methods and solutions for reducing and recycling food waste. Ingredients and additives—including functional components, clean-label products, organic ingredients, and preservatives—are also key areas of interest. Digitalization and Industry 4.0 are prominently featured, with presentations on innovative IoT solutions, data analytics, and artificial intelligence applications designed to optimize food production. Beyond the technical exhibits, the expo also hosts expert-led seminars and tailored B2B meetings. These formats offer valuable opportunities for professionals to network, exchange knowledge, forge strategic partnerships, and explore forward-looking business opportunities. The FDP Expo is open exclusively to trade visitors aged 18 and above, attracting key decision-makers, technology specialists, and procurement professionals from sectors such as dairy, fruit and vegetable processing, spices, poultry, and grain and millet industries. Both venues are well-connected and offer a professional, comfortable, and inspiring environment for attendees. In short, the Food & Drink Processing Expo (FDP Expo) is India’s premier platform for tailored solutions and cutting-edge innovations in the food and beverage industry, playing a vital role in driving the sector’s continued growth and transformation.

The Berne Exhibition, known as BEA, is Switzerland’s largest public fair and takes place every spring at the modern BERNEXPO exhibition grounds in Bern. Since its founding in 1951, BEA has become a fixture in Switzerland’s event calendar, attracting hundreds of thousands of visitors each year from both the German-speaking region and Romandy. The event is organized by BERNEXPO AG, a well-established Swiss company specializing in large-scale events, trade fairs, and public exhibitions. BEA is much more than a traditional exhibition. It combines information, entertainment, and shopping opportunities in a vibrant atmosphere. As a multi-sector public fair, it covers a broad range of topics – from home living, construction, kitchens, gardening, and heating, to fashion, health, mobility, leisure, and services. The focus is on regional and national innovations. At the heart of the event is direct interaction between exhibitors and visitors. This is particularly evident in areas like BEActive, where guests can try out the latest sports trends, and Vinspiration, which offers wine tastings from both Switzerland and abroad. The section dedicated to regional products highlights Swiss roots through culinary specialties and traditional craftsmanship from all parts of the country. Another key element of BEA is its animal exhibition. Displays featuring livestock and pets provide insight into Swiss agricultural culture and foster a sense of connection between urban and rural communities. The Green Center complements this with themes such as sustainable agriculture, horticulture, and nutrition. Entertainment is also a major component. The family-friendly funfair on the exhibition grounds and the interactive “BEA spielt” zone with classic and modern games invite visitors to take part and enjoy themselves. For those seeking relaxation and well-being, the “BE Häppy” section offers a wide array of experiences focused on mindfulness, lifestyle, and personal growth. The BERNEXPO venue – one of Switzerland’s leading event locations – provides the perfect setting. Its modern infrastructure, flexible layout, and excellent public transport links ensure a convenient and enjoyable visit. Bus and tram stops are located right next to the venue, making for an easy and environmentally friendly journey. With its thematic diversity, strong regional connection, and focus on immersive experiences, BEA is a prime example of a modern, audience-centered fair that uniquely blends tradition and innovation.

More than just a comprehensive industry event, it is considered a key driver of the Australian foodservice sector. The Fair has long been established as a symbol of innovation, quality, and professional exchange within the industry. The event is organized by National Media, one of Australia’s leading trade show organizers with extensive experience in delivering high-quality industry events. With a strong focus on innovation, education, and networking, Restaurant & Foodservice Show attracts a highly qualified professional audience – including key decision-makers from hospitality, hotels, bakeries, patisseries, catering, and food retail. The exhibition is exclusively tailored to industry professionals, bringing together the leading players in Australia’s food and hospitality scene. At the heart of the event are new products and solutions across food and beverage, kitchen technology, hospitality equipment, patisserie, specialty coffee, and digital tools for process optimization. A particular highlight is the showcase of innovations in restaurant technology: cloud-based solutions, AI-driven ordering systems, and smart automation tools offer a compelling glimpse into how digital transformation is reshaping the hospitality sector. Restaurant & Foodservice Show also serves as a platform for knowledge sharing and professional development. Across several stages – including the Main Stage, Business Stage, and Explore Patisserie Stage – top chefs, industry leaders, and consultants provide practical insights into topics such as kitchen design, workforce management, and emerging food trends. Whether it’s discovering new products, exploring trends, or building professional networks, Restaurant & Foodservice Show is a vital platform for industry professionals from across Australia and the Asia-Pacific region to take their business to the next level.

The CIBUS International Food Exhibition is an annual trade fair dedicated to the diverse world of food. The CMPL Expo – Contract Manufacturing & Private Label – is India’s leading trade fair dedicated exclusively to professionals in the FMCG sector, focusing on private label and contract manufacturing. In short, the BabyExpo at the Wiener Stadthalle is the ideal event for expectant parents and young families to discover the latest industry trends and products, gain valuable expert insights, and enjoy an engaging experience for all the family.

The trade fair Iran food ingredients is a highly specialised industry platform for food additives, raw materials and functional ingredients. The HFE JAPAN – Health Food Exposition & Conference – is one of Japan’s leading trade fairs for health-promoting foods, dietary supplements, and functional ingredients. The "Fi Food Ingredients Africa", abbreviated as Fi Africa, is a renowned international trade fair specializing in food additives. Informa Markets is known for its expertise in creating interactive and innovative platforms for various industries, with Fi Africa being a highlight in the food and beverage industry. A key focus of the trade fair is the presentation of the latest and most innovative products in the field of food additives.
