The "Food and Beverage (FAB) West Africa" is a leading trade fair for food and beverages in West Africa, held annually at the Landmark Centre in Lagos. It not only offers a wide range of products and services from sectors such as FMCG, confectionery, beverages, kitchen and retail equipment, ingredients, machinery, packaging, dairy, rice, legumes, cereals, and frozen food, but also serves as a platform for interaction between international and local companies and a professional audience, including importers, distributors, retailers, and representatives from the hospitality industry. The organizer, BtoB Events Ltd., aims to bridge the gap between international brands and the local market. This makes the fair a key player in strengthening the regional food and beverage industry. Due to its location in Lagos, a major economic hub of West Africa, the fair has a strong local relevance and contributes to the economic development of the city and the country. The visitors mainly include traders, distribution partners, providers of commercial kitchen and food services, and gastronomes. The fair is distinguished by a variety of highlights, including the introduction of new products and trends, competitions, and the awarding of prizes that emphasize the innovation and quality of the exhibited products. The Landmark Centre, as the venue, offers excellent infrastructure and is easily accessible, making it an ideal location for this significant event. Overall, FAB West Africa provides a unique opportunity to gain insights into the food and beverage industry in West Africa and to establish important business relationships.

Drink Tech Expo Poland in Nadarzyn is the country’s leading trade fair for beverage and liquid food production technologies. It serves as a key platform for innovation, investment and industrial advancement. As a trade-only event, it is specifically geared towards decision-makers, production managers, process technologists and product developers pursuing concrete investment or modernisation projects. The event is organised by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o. o., one of Central and Eastern Europe’s leading exhibition organisers. It takes place at the modern PTAK Warsaw Expo exhibition centre in Nadarzyn, near Warsaw. Its location in the economically strong Warsaw metropolitan area underlines the event’s national and international significance: Poland is one of Europe’s most dynamic production hubs for beverages and food, acting as a vital link between Western and Eastern European markets. The exhibition covers the entire value chain for liquid food production – from raw material processing and mixing technologies through filling and pasteurisation systems to packaging, capping and dosing solutions. Exhibits include technologies for soft drinks such as water, juices and functional beverages, as well as equipment for beer, wine, spirits and ready-to-drink products. The scope is further extended to solutions for soups, broths, sauces, edible oils, liquid fats, infant and medical liquid nutrition, protein shakes, sports drinks, coffee and tea specialities, and energy and isotonic beverages. A particular focus is placed on functional ingredients, additives and innovative formulation components for liquid applications, alongside water treatment and process water management systems – critical to product quality, sustainability and cost efficiency. A central feature of the event is the co-located Liquid Food & Beverage Congress. As a high-level industry forum, it addresses technological innovation, automation, digitalisation, energy efficiency and sustainable production concepts. Manufacturers, suppliers, research institutions and industry experts come together for targeted knowledge transfer and professional exchange. The combination of exhibition and specialist congress positions Drink Tech Expo Poland as a practice-oriented information and investment platform. Exhibitors represent the machinery and plant engineering sector, packaging technology, process and automation engineering, water and environmental technology, ingredients and raw materials, as well as quality control, laboratory and hygiene technology. Visitors include beverage producers, dairies, liquid food manufacturers, breweries, distilleries, private label manufacturers, contract packers, investors and senior procurement professionals from across the food industry. The result is a clearly structured B2B environment with a strong focus on business outcomes. PTAK Warsaw Expo is one of the largest exhibition and congress centres in Central Europe, offering modern halls, extensive exhibition space and robust infrastructure. Nadarzyn benefits from excellent road connections around Warsaw, with Warsaw Chopin International Airport and the city centre within easy reach. Drink Tech Expo Poland combines technological innovation with a professional exhibition setting, making it a key meeting point for shaping the future of beverage and liquid food production.

The Warsaw FOOD Expo is a significant international food fair and one of the most important industry events in Poland. It is held annually at the renowned Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn , known for its modern infrastructure and accessibility. Serving as a platform for exchange among food manufacturers, traders, restaurateurs, café owners, hotel representatives, catering company owners, and many other professionals from the food industry, the fair promotes business and networking. In addition to functioning as a trading platform, the fair offers a rich program of conferences, seminars, and workshops. These provide opportunities to discuss current issues such as food safety, the popularity of plant-based products, the export of Polish food, and new trends in food packaging. The Warsaw FOOD Expo emphasizes its close connection to the city and the country by showcasing the Polish food industry and promoting the export of Polish products. In conclusion, the venue Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn stands out for its modern facilities and good accessibility, making it an ideal location for an international fair of this magnitude.

Awareness of healthy and organic food is driving the structured food trade in Latin America, which represents the world's third-largest region for organic products. The main event at the Anhembi Exhibition Center focuses on presenting and promoting organic products. The range includes organic grains, herbs, spices, rice, honey, sugar, syrup, and exclusive organic coffee, tea, juices, and cocoa. The selection is further enhanced by organic fresh and dried foods, fruits and vegetables, cotton products, as well as essential and Ayurvedic oils. Natural cosmetics and other organic items are also part of the offering, accompanied by a variety of services and consulting options in the organic sector. Highlights of the fair include product presentations, a diverse conference program, and B2B meetings between buyers and sellers. Exhibitors from various sectors of the organic, natural, and agricultural industries attract trade visitors from purchasing, retail, import, and gastronomy. Notably, BioFach America Latina is part of a global series of BioFach fairs held in countries like Germany, the USA, China, Japan, Thailand, Brazil, and Saudi Arabia. The BioFach in Germany is considered the annual main event of the series. A special highlight is the Biofach America Latina Award, presented in categories such as food, beverages, and innovations. These awards underscore the diversity and innovative strength of the organic sector and provide a platform for presenting and recognizing the latest achievements. In conclusion, the Anhembi Exhibition Center in Sao Paulo stands out for its significance as a trade fair center and its excellent accessibility. It offers outstanding facilities for exhibitors and visitors, symbolizing Latin America's commitment to the burgeoning organic industry. Thus, this fair is the ideal place for networking, education, and business dealings in the organic food and product sector.

축제소개: Food Matters Live London is an international B2B trade event dedicated to innovation across the food, beverage, nutrition and nutraceutical industries. It showcases the latest developments, emerging technologies and innovative solutions shaping the future of food, nutrition and health. Aimed primarily at industry professionals, the event provides a platform for knowledge exchange, product development and building new business relationships. Food Matters Live London takes place at Olympia London, one of the capital’s long-established exhibition and event venues. Organised by Food Matters Live Ltd., the event is held annually, typically over two days in June. In addition to London, Food Matters Live also takes place in Rotterdam. The event focuses on the intersection of food innovation, health, nutrition, consumer trends and product development. Key areas include Food & Consumer Trends, Positive Nutrition and Functional Food, innovative ingredients and New Product Development (NPD), taste, colour and sensory science, as well as emerging technologies for research and development. Particular attention is given to metabolic health, gut health and the microbiome, dietary fibre, personalised nutrition, women’s health, sustainable ingredients and the use of artificial intelligence in new food product development. A central theme is how companies can create products that successfully balance health, sustainability, taste, convenience and competitive pricing. Exhibitors showcase innovative ingredients, functional foods and beverages, flavours, natural and functional colours, and solutions for texture and formulation. Other areas include prebiotics and probiotics, dietary fibre, botanical ingredients, algae, functional dairy products and a range of bioactive compounds. The exhibition also features technologies and services supporting product development, research, quality assurance, manufacturing and commercialisation. It is therefore particularly relevant to companies looking to develop new formulations, optimise existing products or translate emerging consumer and nutrition trends into commercially viable products. A key feature of the event is “Tastes of Better”, where international ingredient suppliers present new ingredients, applications and product concepts. Tastings and practical demonstrations give industry visitors the opportunity to experience new flavours, textures, colours and formulations first-hand and discuss them directly with the development teams behind them. Roundtables and masterclasses complement the programme, providing further opportunities for industry exchange and knowledge sharing. “NutraConnect” adds a dedicated area focused on nutraceuticals and health ingredients. Key topics include prebiotics, probiotics, dietary fibre, botanical ingredients, functional dairy, algae and novel bioactive compounds. Masterclasses and “Meet the Buyer” sessions are designed to connect suppliers directly with product developers and buyers. The Private Label Pavilion provides an additional focus on private-label products, new product concepts, formulations, manufacturing capabilities and market-ready solutions addressing current health, consumer and market trends. Exhibitors are drawn primarily from the food and beverage industry, the ingredients and raw materials sector, nutraceuticals and supplements, food technology, research and development, private-label manufacturing and specialist service providers. Food Matters Live is aimed particularly at product developers and NPD teams, R&D specialists, nutrition and innovation professionals, buyers, quality professionals and decision-makers from food, beverage and nutraceutical companies. Its strong B2B focus clearly distinguishes the event from consumer-facing exhibitions. Olympia London further reinforces the international character of Food Matters Live. The historic exhibition venue in West Kensington is one of London’s best-known event locations and is easily accessible by public transport, particularly via Kensington (Olympia) station. Food Matters Live therefore combines an international platform for food innovation with the advantages of London as one of Europe’s leading business and exhibition centres.

The venue is easily accessible by car, public transport, or shuttle services, ensuring smooth access for all participants. The Kazakhstan International Bakery Show is thus an exclusive, regionally anchored trade fair held every two years in Astana – the Central Asian hotspot for innovation, networking, and business development in the bakery world.

축제소개: Food & Drinks Malaysia by SIAL, an annual food and beverage trade fair held in Kuala Lumpur since 2023, is organized by the world-leading exhibition company, Comexposium. This event serves as a specialized platform to promote the food and beverage industry in Malaysia and the ASEAN countries. The fair particularly focuses on spices & condiments as well as alternative proteins. This focus supports the goal of developing innovative and sustainable food solutions, contributing to the strengthening of food security in the region. As such, the event makes a significant contribution to the advancement and diversification of the food sector. Importers, manufacturers, and commercial buyers from retail companies will find a wide range of products and services at Food & Drinks Malaysia. The offerings span from traditional spices and innovative foods to sustainable packaging solutions and cutting-edge cooling technology. Exhibitors showcase their latest products that meet current market trends and demands. The event takes place at the Malaysia International Trade & Exhibition Centre (MITEC), the largest exhibition center in Malaysia, featuring over 45,000 m² of exhibition space and the country’s largest column-free hall. Food & Drinks Malaysia by SIAL not only provides a platform for exhibitions but also opens new business opportunities in the food and beverage industry of Malaysia and the ASEAN region. With a strong emphasis on innovation, sustainability, and business development, the fair sets new standards and promotes economic cooperation in the region. Take advantage of the opportunity to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking event.

전시회명: Malaysian International Food & Beverage Trade Fair (MIFB)
축제소개: The Malaysian International Food & Beverage Trade Fair (MIFB) , established in 1990, is the premier event of its kind in Malaysia. It provides a platform for professionals from the global food and beverage industry to exchange ideas and network. This annual event, held at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre (KLCC) , attracts exhibitors and visitors from around the world. The MIFB is organized by Constellar Exhibitions Malaysia Sdn Bhd, a subsidiary of Constellar Holdings Pte Ltd., known for its innovative and comprehensive trade fair experiences. The fair showcases a wide array of products and services, including convenience foods, frozen foods, food processing technologies, and sustainable packaging solutions. Special emphasis is placed on areas such as future foods, halal products, and natural and health products. In addition to serving as a trading platform, the MIFB also acts as a cultural meeting point that reflects the rich culinary diversity of Malaysia. Program highlights include conferences with international experts, seminars, a special program for startups, and live cooking demonstrations. Visitors to the fair come from various sectors, including retail, gastronomy, distribution, and hospitality, ranging from supermarket managers to restaurant owners and food importers. Located centrally and easily accessible, the KLCC, with its modern infrastructure and surrounded by Kuala Lumpur's dynamic skyline, provides the perfect setting for the MIFB. The fair has established itself as an indispensable event for professionals in the food and beverage industry.

The " Asia Healthcare & Medical Cosmetology Expo ," part of BIO Asia, is held annually at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center in Taipei. This trade fair has established itself as a leading event in Asia for healthcare and medical cosmetology. Organized by Chan Chao International Co., Ltd., it provides a platform that showcases the latest innovations in aesthetic medicine, cosmetology, and nutraceuticals. The main themes of the expo include cosmetology, aesthetic medicine centers, beauty and skincare products, as well as related raw materials and packaging solutions. The health sector also features bio-raw materials, dietary supplements, and health-promoting foods. Thus, the expo offers a wide range of products and services and serves as a bridge between OEM/ODM providers and industry players. Taiwan, known for its advanced technology and innovations in the health and beauty industry, emphasizes the importance of the expo as a central meeting point for professionals in these fields. Highlights include special sections for start-ups and innovators, offering visitors unique insights and networking opportunities. Exhibitors and visitors come from various industries, including biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and healthy foods. The primary attendees are professionals and decision-makers seeking to discover new products, establish business relationships, and learn about current market trends. The modern facilities and excellent accessibility of the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center enhance the appeal of the expo as an international event. Its excellent public transport connections make it easy to visit the expo. In summary, the Asia Healthcare & Medical Cosmetology Expo is a pivotal event for industry experts who want to be at the forefront of medical and cosmetological innovation. It serves as a comprehensive platform for knowledge exchange, networking with industry leaders, and discovering new business opportunities in Asia and beyond.

The " Food Manufacturing Indonesia " is a leading annual trade fair specializing in the food and beverage manufacturing industry. It is organized by GEM INDONESIA and takes place at the prestigious Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo) in the heart of Jakarta, Indonesia. The fair provides a dynamic forum for key players and decision-makers in the industry to present and discover the latest technologies, products, and services. The main focus of the fair includes innovative processing technologies, advanced food packaging, high-quality ingredients, and efficient logistic solutions. Special emphasis is placed on automation systems, IT solutions, and eco-friendly packaging materials, all aimed at increasing production efficiency and promoting sustainability. The range of products exhibited offers impressive variety, from essential oils and emulsifiers to chocolate processing machines and cutting-edge spices, as well as water purification systems. Additionally, specialized equipment such as freezing and cooling devices, material identification systems, and innovative packaging solutions are represented, making Food Manufacturing Indonesia a comprehensive platform for business needs. The fair reflects the strong connection between Jakarta and the dynamic global food industry, highlighting the growing significance of the region in the international sector. Thanks to its strategic location, Jakarta provides ideal conditions for international business meetings and the exchange of expertise. Food Manufacturing Indonesia attracts a wide range of industry representatives, including food technologists, researchers, product developers, as well as wholesalers and distributors. It serves as an outstanding platform for networking, business collaboration, and the exchange of best practices. Finally, the Jakarta International Expo, with its excellent accessibility and first-class facilities, offers an efficient and enjoyable fair experience. Thus, Food Manufacturing Indonesia significantly contributes to the advancement of the global food and beverage industry.

개최장소(베뉴): São Paulo Expo Exhibition & Convention Center
축제소개: Fi South America (“Food Ingredients South America”) is the leading trade fair for food ingredients and innovative solutions in the food and beverage industry in Latin America. Since its inception in 1996, the event has evolved into a key industry meeting point and takes place annually at the modern São Paulo Expo in São Paulo. As part of the international Fi event series, organized by Informa Markets—a trading division of London-based Informa PLC—Fi South America stands for innovation, networking, and professional orientation in the field of food ingredients. With its clear focus on health-oriented, natural, and plant-based ingredients, Fi South America occupies a unique position in the South American market. Every year, it attracts both international and regional exhibitors and professionals, providing a specialized platform for companies to showcase their latest developments. The range of offerings extends from vitamins, minerals, and functional ingredients to plant-based proteins, clean label products, as well as gluten-free and allergen-free solutions. This portfolio is complemented by classic ingredients such as sweeteners, texturizers, natural flavors, colorants, and certified organic raw materials. The event sees itself as a driving force for innovation across the entire industry value chain. Elements such as guided innovation tours, trend-based tasting areas, the Plant-Based Experience for plant-based nutrition trends, and the Sustainability Experience for sustainable circular economy are integral parts of the concept and offer genuine added value. Exhibitors include leading ingredient manufacturers, food safety and quality experts, suppliers of new process technologies, as well as service and logistics providers. The main visitors are professionals and executives from procurement, development, production, and quality assurance within the food and beverage sector, as well as from related industries such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and dietary supplements. The São Paulo location adds extra significance to the event: The city is considered South America’s economic and innovation hub and has a major influence on both the regional and global food industry. The São Paulo Expo offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and is centrally located, with excellent connections to public transport and the international airport. Visitors benefit from the city’s vibrant culture and diverse culinary and leisure offerings, experiencing Fi South America as the most important meeting point for trends, networking, and business in the South American ingredients community.

Palmex Thailand is Asia’s leading trade exhibition dedicated entirely to the palm oil industry. The name “Palmex” – short for “Palm Oil Expo” – clearly reflects the event’s focus on technologies, products, and services across the entire palm oil value chain. The exhibition takes place at the CO-OP Exhibition Centre in Surat Thani, a key industrial hub in southern Thailand and a central location for the country’s palm oil sector. The venue offers modern infrastructure and is easily accessible for industry professionals from both domestic and international markets. The event is organized by Fireworks Trade Media Pte Ltd., a globally recognized trade fair organizer based in Singapore, renowned for its high-quality, industry-specific exhibitions. Held annually, Palmex Thailand has firmly established itself as a key meeting point for experts, researchers, manufacturers, and investors across the palm oil industry. The exhibition highlights technological innovations spanning the entire production process – from processing and packaging to storage, automation, and digital solutions. Among the showcased technologies are advanced EFB processing machines, decanter centrifuges, pump systems, biofuel production equipment, oilseed crushers, filtration systems, compressors, packaging machinery, and intelligent automation and control systems. The exhibition is further enriched by suppliers of electric motors, sensors, conveying systems, valves, and scientific institutions focused on sustainable nutrient management. A central feature of Palmex Thailand is its accompanying program of professional events, including seminars, conferences, and panel discussions that explore current trends, challenges, and opportunities within the industry. Business matchmaking sessions, technology presentations, and exclusive networking formats facilitate meaningful exchanges among participants. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors – including mechanical engineering, energy, automation, packaging, chemicals, and environmental technology – all with direct or indirect ties to the palm oil industry. The event primarily targets professionals from the palm oil sector: engineers, plant managers, manufacturers, investors, academics, and decision-makers from both the political and economic spheres, all of whom share an interest in sustainable development, increased efficiency, and international cooperation. Palmex Thailand is part of a broader series of international palm oil exhibitions held across other key Southeast Asian markets, each tailored to the specific needs of its region. Palmex Thailand is more than just a showcase for innovation and technology transfer; it is also a significant economic driver for Surat Thani and the surrounding region. With its modern infrastructure, spacious exhibition areas, and comprehensive services for both exhibitors and visitors, the CO-OP Exhibition Centre provides the ideal setting for this specialized event. Palmex Thailand offers the perfect platform for all those looking to actively shape the future of the palm oil industry.

F Istanbul – Food & Technology Exhibition is Turkey’s most comprehensive international trade fair dedicated to food, beverages, and the technologies involved in their processing and packaging. Held annually at the Istanbul Expo Center in the vibrant district of Yeşilköy, the fair was established in 2022 and is organized by So Fuar. It is exclusively open to trade professionals from the retail, industrial, and hospitality sectors. With a strong focus on innovative solutions for the food and beverage industry, the exhibition serves as a premier platform for networking, business development, and insights into current market trends. Its extensive range of topics includes fresh and frozen foods, meat, poultry, and seafood products, bakery items, snacks, confectionery, as well as alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. In addition, it showcases cutting-edge technologies for food processing and packaging. Particular emphasis is placed on forward-looking themes such as sustainable organic foods, eco-friendly packaging solutions, and advanced safety and quality control systems within the food industry. Specialized sectors including professional kitchen equipment, hospitality supplies, catering technology, as well as ingredients and additives—such as spices, flavorings, and functional components—are also thoroughly represented. A major highlight of the exhibition is the variety of product presentations and expert talks, which spotlight current developments and groundbreaking innovations. Alongside food and beverage manufacturers, exhibitors include companies from packaging design and technology, refrigeration and storage solutions, as well as shopfitting and retail design. The Istanbul Expo Center, a modern venue with excellent infrastructure, offers convenient access by both public transport and car. Adding to the appeal, Istanbul itself—an energetic metropolis steeped in history, culture, and culinary diversity—enhances the overall experience and makes attending F Istanbul a standout event in the international trade fair calendar.

The " Fi Food Ingredients Asia Thailand ," commonly known as Fi Asia Thailand , is a leading international trade fair specializing in food additives. It takes place at the QSNCC (Queen Sirikit National Convention Center) in Bangkok and is renowned for connecting buyers from regional and global markets with international providers of food and beverage additives. The fair is organized by Informa Markets, a trade division of Informa PLC and a leader in event organization. Informa Markets is celebrated for its ability to create interactive and innovative platforms across various industries, with Fi Asia Thailand recognized as a standout event in the food and beverage industry. A central focus of the fair is the introduction of the latest and most innovative products in the field of food additives. Exhibitors have the opportunity to present their products and services to a qualified audience of decision-makers, making Fi Asia Thailand a crucial hub for innovation and business development. The fair covers a wide range of topics, including natural ingredients, preservatives, flavors, enzymes, pet food, alternative proteins, sweeteners, sugar substitutes, health ingredients, and much more. The spectrum of products showcased at the fair ranges from food additives and ingredients to food processing technologies, packaging solutions, and much more. In addition to the exhibition, Fi Asia Thailand offers numerous networking opportunities, expert talks, and discussion panels where industry experts share their knowledge and insights. These interactive elements establish the fair as an indispensable platform for professionals involved in research and development, production, marketing, or distribution of food additives. Fi Asia Thailand is part of a global network of Fi fairs, which includes locations in Europe, America, and other parts of Asia. Finally, it is noteworthy that the QSNCC in Bangkok is equipped with modern facilities and is well-connected to public transport. Bangkok itself, as a vibrant metropolis and significant economic center, offers numerous attractions as well as a diverse range of dining and entertainment options, making a visit to the fair a truly special experience.

SEAFOOD LIMA is a specialized trade fair for fish and seafood products that has attracted international industry decision-makers to Peru every two years since its inception in 2019. As the most important business platform of its kind in South America, the event focuses on the presentation and marketing of fresh, frozen, dried, salted, and preserved fish and seafood products, as well as on innovative developments in this sector. Peru is recognized as a global leader in fishmeal exports, and the fair serves as a central hub for this industry on the international trade show calendar. The event takes place at the modern Centro de Exposiciones Jockey, located in the heart of Lima. This venue stands out for its excellent accessibility, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and comprehensive range of services, providing the ideal environment for successful business meetings. SEAFOOD LIMA is held in autumn every two years and is organized by the experienced Thais Corporation S.A.C., ensuring smooth operations and effective international networking. The fair’s range includes staple products such as tuna, salmon, tilapia, mackerel, and shrimp, as well as premium specialties including omega-3-rich oils, high-quality fishmeal for aquaculture, refined seafood snacks, and contemporary ready-to-eat items. The exhibition is further enhanced by participants from the fields of processing technology, refrigeration and logistics equipment, and innovative solutions for sustainable fisheries and aquaculture. In this way, SEAFOOD LIMA covers the entire value chain of the industry, from raw materials to processing and distribution. A distinctive feature of SEAFOOD LIMA is its strong emphasis on facilitating exchange between Latin American producers and international buyers. The event centers on business matchmaking, product launches, and expert discussions on current industry trends. Key target groups—including importers, wholesalers, supermarket chains, exporters, cruise lines, and specialized brokers—find an ideal platform here for gaining market insights and establishing targeted business contacts. Professionals from related sectors such as logistics, pharmaceuticals, and pet food also benefit from the diverse range of offerings. The Centro de Exposiciones Jockey provides optimal conditions for the fair: it is easily accessible from both the city center and the airport, and is located close to hotels, restaurants, and major business districts. SEAFOOD LIMA thus combines a high-quality trade fair experience with the urban flair and cosmopolitan atmosphere of Lima, making every visit a worthwhile investment in knowledge, networking, and business success.

Expo Pesca & AcuiPeru & Seafood Lima is regarded as the most important international trade fair for fisheries and aquaculture in Latin America. Since its debut in 2003, it has established itself as an indispensable industry event and takes place every two years, usually in autumn, at the modern Centro de Exposiciones Jockey in Lima. The name combines the Spanish word “Pesca” for fishing with “AcuiPeru”, referencing Peruvian aquaculture, and thus reflects the close connection to the host country. The event is organized by Thais Corporation S.A.C., an experienced company with in-depth expertise in the sector. The trade fair is distinguished by its targeted focus on all areas of the fishing, aquaculture, and seafood industries. It covers the entire value chain, ranging from advanced fishing technologies, aquaculture systems, and shipbuilding to communication and navigation technology, refrigeration and cooling systems, processing, packaging, distribution, and logistics. Furthermore, it serves as a central platform for trading seafood products of all kinds, including specialized products such as fishmeal and fish oil. Exhibitors showcase a comprehensive range of products and services, from boats and their components to net and fishing gear, machinery for filleting, sorting and preserving, as well as digital solutions for management and efficiency. In doing so, the fair sets new standards for innovation, efficiency, and sustainability in the sector. The thematic focus of Expo Pesca & AcuiPeru & Seafood Lima reflects Peru’s significant role in global fisheries and aquaculture. The event serves as a showcase for technological advancements, new business models, and sustainable approaches that are relevant both within Latin America and internationally. A particular highlight is the technical conference, where decision-makers and industry experts discuss current challenges and future trends—an essential forum for anyone seeking to shape the industry. The expo attracts exhibitors and visitors from a variety of fields, including shipbuilding and shipyard industries, mechanical engineering, logistics, aquaculture, and processing, as well as international seafood traders and service providers. Its primary audience consists of owners, managing directors, managers, technicians, and specialists from fishing companies, aquaculture facilities, and processing plants. The Centro de Exposiciones Jockey, with its modern infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and location in the economic and cultural heart of Lima, offers optimal conditions for the event. As a metropolis steeped in tradition and a historic center of the Peruvian fishing industry, Lima provides the ideal setting for this specialized industry gathering, which sets new standards in fisheries and aquaculture.

Food Matters Live Rotterdam is an international B2B event for the food, beverage and nutraceutical industries, open exclusively to trade professionals. Its central focus is on how emerging scientific insights, innovative ingredients and technologies, and changing consumer needs can be translated into commercially viable food and beverage products and nutrition concepts. The event is particularly aimed at professionals working directly in product development, formulation, nutrition and innovation. The two-day event takes place once a year, usually in September, at the Rotterdam Ahoy Convention Centre. It is organised by Food Matters Live Ltd. London is also part of the Food Matters Live event programme, with annual editions held in both the UK and the Netherlands, creating an international event series for Europe’s food and nutrition community. Food Matters Live focuses on the future of product development across the food and nutrition industries. Key themes include emerging food and consumer trends, positive nutrition and functional foods, metabolic health, the microbiome and gut health, women’s health, personalised nutrition, dietary fibre, and new and alternative protein sources. Other areas of focus include innovative flavour and colour solutions, clean label, sensory science, sustainable and functional ingredients, reformulation, upcycling, whole-food ingredients and emerging technologies such as precision fermentation. New product development (NPD) is another major theme, covering areas such as novel formulation approaches, sustainable ingredient solutions and AI-powered tools for product development. The programme addresses practical challenges faced by food manufacturers when developing new products, including balancing health and indulgence, reducing sugar, creating clean-label products, and improving taste, texture and nutritional value. The range of products and solutions presented at the event reflects this broad scope. Exhibits include functional and natural ingredients, proteins, dietary fibres, flavours and colours, sugar- and salt-reduction solutions, clean-label concepts, and ingredients for functional foods and dietary supplements. Ingredients and technologies for bakery products, beverages, dairy products, desserts, snacks and alternative-protein products are also showcased. The offering is complemented by analytical, product development and technology solutions, as well as services covering product development, quality, sensory science and innovation. One of the distinctive features of Food Matters Live is its emphasis on interactive formats. As part of “Tastes of Better”, international ingredient specialists showcase their solutions in one-hour sessions. These give trade visitors the opportunity not only to discover new ingredients but also to taste them in real product applications and discuss their properties and potential uses directly with technical experts. Exhibitors primarily include ingredient manufacturers and suppliers, food-tech and technology companies, specialists in flavours, colours, proteins and functional ingredients, and providers of product development, analytical and business services. Visitors mainly come from food and nutraceutical brands, food manufacturing, retail, quick-service restaurants and the wider foodservice sector. The event is particularly relevant to professionals and decision-makers working in research and development (R&D), new product development (NPD), nutrition, innovation, quality control, product and brand marketing, and ingredient procurement. Admission is restricted to industry professionals. The event is held at Rotterdam Ahoy, Ahoyweg 10, 3084 BA Rotterdam, south of the city centre. The venue is easily accessible both by car via the A15 motorway and by public transport. Rotterdam Ahoy is approximately a five-minute walk from Zuidplein metro and bus station, while the journey by metro from central Rotterdam or Rotterdam Centraal railway station takes around ten minutes.

개최장소(베뉴): MITEC Malaysia International Trade & Exhibition Centre
축제소개: Vitafoods Asia is a significant trade fair targeted at professionals in the functional food and beverage, nutraceutical, and dietary supplement industries. Since its inception in 2011, it has established itself as the leading platform in the Asia-Pacific region, focusing on innovations and trends within these rapidly growing sectors. Organized by Informa Markets, the event is held annually over three days, offering the most up-to-date and relevant content. The exhibition is divided into four main areas: Ingredients and Raw Materials, Contract Manufacturing and Private Label, Services and Equipment, and Branded Finished Products. International pavilions highlight country-specific features and reinforce the global character of the fair. The offering is further enriched by special exhibits and stage presentations that provide insights into specific industry aspects, fostering exchange and networking opportunities. In addition to product displays, Vitafoods Asia places great emphasis on consultancy services and knowledge transfer, making it an essential meeting point for industry decision-makers. Attractions such as tasting booths and award competitions offer additional incentives and inspiration for visitors. In summary, Vitafoods Asia is more than just a trade fair; it serves as a central information and business platform for professionals involved in the development and marketing of health-promoting products. By focusing on quality and innovation, it actively contributes to shaping the future of the food and health industries.

The Pharmacy Solutions Expo , an integral part of MEDICAL JAPAN Osaka, is held annually at the INTEX Osaka International Exhibition Center . This specialized B2B fair serves as a significant platform for players in the pharmacy sector, including manufacturers of pharmacy systems, providers of medication dispensing devices, and developers of IT solutions for the healthcare industry. The fair particularly highlights innovative products and services in the areas of health food, dietary supplements, and cosmetics. The organization of the fair is managed by RX Japan Ltd., a leading organizer that specializes in bridging current industry needs with future-oriented technologies. The expo opens unique doors to the Japanese market and offers excellent opportunities for business development and expansion for both international and local companies. The fair features a comprehensive exhibition, including systems for dispensing prescription medications, IT solutions for pharmacies, medical devices for home healthcare, and packaging machines. The range is complemented by dietary supplements and functional foods. Another significant aspect of the fair is its connection to Osaka and Japan, a country known for its leadership role in technology and healthcare. The fair supports the local and national economy by promoting innovations in the health sector. Highlights of the expo include conferences with industry experts, panel discussions, live product demonstrations, and networking events that facilitate knowledge exchange and business networking. It attracts professionals from various fields, including pharmacy managers, doctors, nurses, and representatives from trading companies. The Pharmacy Solutions Expo is a central event in the series of events organized by RX Japan Ltd. and is regularly held in various cities, with Osaka being a significant venue. The easily accessible INTEX Osaka, with its state-of-the-art infrastructure and capacity for large international gatherings, provides the ideal setting for this high-profile event, where exhibitors and visitors can experience and discuss the latest innovations and trends in the industry.

The "Wellness & Preventive Healthcare Expo" , Japan's leading health fair, takes place annually at the prestigious INTEX Osaka International Exhibition Center and is a significant component of MEDICAL JAPAN Osaka. It targets professionals and enthusiasts from the fields of medicine, wellness, and health technology. The fair is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a respected organizer known for providing platforms for the exchange of expertise and current trends. The fair is distinguished by its variety of topics, including health technology, physical activity, functional foods, and rehabilitation techniques. Innovative products and services are showcased, including apps and systems for health management, wearable sensors, activity trackers, IoT applications in healthcare, as well as advanced rehabilitation and fitness equipment. Dietary supplements and herbal medicines are also presented. A unique feature of the fair is its deep integration into the local culture and industry, making it a key event for the Asian health market. It offers a unique opportunity to explore the latest developments in medical and health care, closely linked to Japan's technological innovation. The fair attracts a wide range of visitors, including professionals from hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and rehabilitation centers. Highlights include conferences and seminars by industry experts, live demonstrations of new products, and special networking events for business matchmaking. Exhibitors represent various sectors such as pharmacy, biotechnology, sports equipment manufacturing, and nutritional science, highlighting the broad industry diversity present at the fair. The "Wellness & Preventive Healthcare Expo" is part of a series of health fairs held in various cities across Japan, playing a significant role in the regional and international health landscape. The INTEX Osaka International Exhibition Center is well-connected to public transport, facilitating access for both domestic and international visitors. In summary, the "Wellness & Preventive Healthcare Expo" Osaka is not only a showcase for health technologies and products but also an important platform for knowledge exchange and the advancement of the health industry.

The ANUGA in Cologne, the name of which is an abbreviation for the "General Food and Beverage Exhibition," is considered the leading global food trade fair catering to retail, gastronomy, and the out-of-home market. The fair is organized by the renowned Koelnmesse GmbH, recognized for its expertise in coordinating large international exhibitions. Since its inception in 1951, ANUGA has taken on a central role in the Food & Beverage industry. The exhibition takes place every two years in October on the impressive grounds of the Cologne Fair. With a specialized concept, ANUGA showcases ten main themes, including ANUGA Fine Food, ANUGA Drinks, ANUGA Chilled & Fresh Food, among others. It covers a broad range of products and services - from food and beverages to technology for the gastronomy sector, as well as services for food retailers and gastronomy. A highlight of the fair is the ANUGA trend topics, which highlight the current demands in the industry and the market's direction. Exhibitors primarily hail from the sectors of production, import, and wholesale of food and beverages, technology for gastronomy, and services for food retailers and gastronomy. The fair's international ambiance attracts visitors from almost every country in the world, facilitating cross-border business and networking. It's noteworthy that ANUGA Cologne serves as a model for various fairs worldwide, including ANUGA Select Brazil and ANUFOOD China, to name just a couple, which are also organized by Koelnmesse GmbH. In conclusion, the city of Cologne, with its central location and excellent transport links, especially to the exhibition grounds, is the perfect venue for this prestigious event. Whether by car, train, or plane, the Cologne Fair is easily accessible and offers a unique setting for business encounters and culinary discoveries.

개최장소(베뉴): Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: CAMFOOD in Phnom Penh is an annual international trade fair with a clear focus on Cambodia’s food and beverage industry. It is organized by AMB Tarsus Exhibitions (Cambodia) Pte Ltd in cooperation with Informa Markets, an internationally experienced organizer of trade fairs and conferences. CAMFOOD is recognized as the largest and most important B2B platform for the country’s hospitality and food & beverage sector. The name “CAMFOOD”, short for “Cambodian Food”, underlines its orientation towards the specific needs of the regional market. The fair usually takes place in the autumn at the Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center (DIECC) in Phnom Penh, a modern venue that is easily accessible by car and public transportation. It brings together national and international exhibitors with professional visitors, including manufacturers, distributors, importers, exporters, and decision-makers from the gastronomy, hotel, and catering industries (HORECA). The exhibition highlights current products, technologies, and industry trends across the entire food and beverage value chain. The product range spans ready meals, ingredients, fresh produce, frozen goods, confectionery, snacks, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Particularly dynamic is the segment of healthy and organic products, reflecting the growing trend towards conscious consumption and modern nutrition in the region. A distinctive feature of CAMFOOD is its close integration with its sister events CAMHOTEL, CAMCAFE, the Cambodia Franchise Show, and FOODTEC Cambodia. This combined structure creates a platform that fosters synergies between the hospitality, hotel, coffee, and franchise industries. It not only offers a comprehensive trade fair experience but also supports the internationalization and professionalization of Cambodia’s hospitality and food sector. Through product presentations, targeted networking events, and diverse business-matching opportunities, CAMFOOD serves as a strategically important meeting point for professionals seeking to stay informed about industry developments, discover innovative solutions, and establish or strengthen business relationships. More than just a trade fair, CAMFOOD is a driver of growth for Cambodia’s hospitality and food industries and for the wider region. It is relevant because it opens tangible market opportunities, unique because it combines local strengths with international expertise, and effective because it is tailored to the specific needs of professional decision-makers in the HORECA sector.

개최장소(베뉴): Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: FOODTEC Cambodia , an integral part of the prestigious CAMFOOD+HOTEL trade fair, is the leading platform for food technology in Cambodia. Held annually at the Diamond Island Exhibition and Convention Centre (DIECC) in Phnom Penh, the event is organized by AMB Tarsus Exhibitions (Cambodia) Pte Ltd in close cooperation with Informa Markets – two seasoned organizers of international trade shows across Southeast Asia. The exhibition offers a focused insight into the latest trends and advanced solutions in food processing, packaging technology, quality assurance, and hygiene. Emphasis is placed on sustainable systems and automated processes throughout the entire value chain. Visitors can explore state-of-the-art machinery, fully integrated production lines, and packaging technologies for a wide range of food categories. Complementing this are innovations in food safety and hygiene control – particularly relevant for producers, distributors, restaurateurs, and food retailers. A key feature of the event is the AGRITECT program, which promotes the integration of agriculture and food technology. Showcasing agricultural innovations, it supports the modern use of machinery, storage systems, and processing equipment in farming – a vital step in strengthening local value creation in Cambodia. Combining a specialized trade show, product innovations, and access to a rapidly growing market, FOODTEC Cambodia has become an essential meeting point for professionals in the food industry, mechanical engineering, packaging sector, and agriculture. The event attracts a broad spectrum of visitors, including food and beverage manufacturers, farmers, processors, retailers, logistics providers, and investors seeking modern solutions and new business opportunities. Located on Koh Pich Island in Phnom Penh, the DIECC offers a central, easily accessible venue with modern exhibition facilities that meet international standards – an ideal setting for innovation, networking, and business development in one of Southeast Asia’s most dynamic regions.

The North East Foodtech in Guwahati is a specialized trade fair focusing on the hospitality, bakery, confectionery, food, beverage, sweets, and snack industries. It places a special emphasis on food processing. First held in 2017, it has established itself as one of the leading fairs for the food and hotel industry in Eastern and Northeastern India. The versatility of the fair makes it an ideal platform for sourcing machinery, equipment, and products related to the food industry. It attracts exhibitors and visitors from various parts of the world looking for new business opportunities and partnerships in the region. Its location in the North East Region, a hub of Indian tourism, offers ideal conditions for investments in the hospitality sector. This multi-day event takes place at the Maniram Dewan Trade Centre, a modern and well-equipped exhibition and event venue tailored to the needs of its participants. The center provides ample space for extensive exhibitions and creates a pleasant atmosphere for networking events and business meetings. North East Foodtech also serves as a hub for knowledge exchange and innovation. The FoodTec Fair, a key event in the food industry, takes place biennially at Messukeskus, the Expo and Convention Centre in Helsinki. The Alimentaria in Barcelona, one of the world's largest trade fairs for food and beverages, serves as a central meeting point for leading manufacturers and suppliers in the industry. The SupplySide Connect New Jersey trade show serves as a leading platform in the health and nutrition industry. TUTTOFOOD , the international trade fair, is a key platform for innovation, quality, and diversity in the food and beverage industry. Since its debut in 2007, it has become a major meeting point for the global food sector and takes place every two years at the Fiera Milano exhibition center in Rho, near Milan. TUTTOFOOD is distinguished not only by the wide range of products on display – from fresh and frozen foods, delicacies, pasta, confectionery, dairy and meat products to beverages, functional foods, and plant-based alternatives – but also by the high quality of its exhibitors and its strong emphasis on fostering international exchange. In forums such as the Better Future Arena and the Cibus Link Arena, pressing issues related to food, supply chains, and consumer behavior are discussed in a practical, solution-oriented, and forward-thinking manner. Its excellent transport connections via highways, public transit, and Milan-Malpensa International Airport make it an ideal location for an event of this scale. TUTTOFOOD is more than just a trade fair – it is the international meeting point for all those who want to help shape the future of food.

Venditalia is the leading international trade fair for the vending industry and was established in 1998. The name "Venditalia" is derived from the Italian words for sale (Vendita) and Italy (Italia), emphasizing the event's central importance to the Italian vending sector. It is held biennially at Rimini Expo Centre, usually in the spring. Organized by Venditalia Servizi Srl, a company wholly dedicated to promoting the vending industry, the fair showcases a wide array of products and services from various sectors of the vending industry. These include food and non-food vending machines, payment systems, IT solutions, security technologies, packaging, personnel equipment, and logistics services. Additionally, fresh produce, ready meals, disposable items, water dispensers, and products and ingredients for hot and cold beverages and confectionery snacks are also presented. A key aspect of Venditalia is its role as a platform for innovation within the industry. Exhibitors and visitors from around the world introduce and discuss the latest products, technologies, and market trends. In conclusion, Venditalia is an indispensable event for all stakeholders in the vending sales industry, driving innovation and business developments forward.

IFFA – the International Trade Fair for the Meat Industry – is the world’s leading trade show for processing, packaging, and marketing of meat and alternative proteins. Held every three years at the Frankfurt exhibition grounds, it has evolved since its inception into the globally recognized flagship event for the sector. As an exclusive business platform, it is open solely to trade visitors and brings together top-tier exhibitors and decision-makers from across the entire meat processing value chain – from craft and industry to retail. The organizer of IFFA is Messe Frankfurt GmbH, one of the world’s largest trade fair companies, headquartered in the heart of Europe. The company is known for its global reach, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and decades of expertise in hosting specialized trade events. What sets IFFA apart is its distinct focus on the future of the meat and protein industry. At its core are key themes such as peak technological performance, data-driven value creation, practical sustainability, and product innovation. Visitors gain first-hand insights into the use of cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence, robotics, and sensor systems to automate and optimize production processes. At the same time, the show highlights sustainable packaging concepts, energy-efficient systems, and alternative protein sources – including plant-based solutions, fermentation, fungi, and cell cultures. These innovations address emerging dietary trends and open up new market opportunities. The exhibition is organized into five thematic zones, known as the “IFFA Worlds”. The World of Processing focuses on machinery and technology for efficient processing. The World of Packaging showcases innovative, often plastic-reduced packaging solutions. The World of Ingredients presents spices, additives, and auxiliary materials for product refinement. The World of New Proteins is dedicated entirely to alternative proteins, providing a platform for start-ups, research, and product development. In the World of Skills and Sales, craftsmanship, sales expertise, and culinary talent take center stage – enhanced by competitions and live demonstrations that make the visitor experience especially dynamic. Exhibitors primarily come from the fields of machinery and plant engineering, food technology, packaging, ingredients, logistics, and research and development. Visitors include professionals from the meat industry, food production, wholesale and retail sectors, as well as from start-ups and innovation departments. IFFA is more than just a trade fair – it is a reflection of a transforming industry, a catalyst for new business models, and a key venue where global trends are shaped. Its location in Frankfurt am Main provides access to a modern exhibition center with excellent connections to Frankfurt International Airport, the railway network, and major highways. For anyone looking to shape the future of the meat and protein industry, IFFA is the place to be.

ILDEX Vietnam is an international trade fair for livestock farming, dairy and meat processing, and aquaculture in Southeast Asia. Since its establishment in 2006, it has evolved into a key industry gathering, showcasing the latest technologies, products, and innovations in these essential sectors. Organized by VNU Exhibitions Asia Pacific Co., Ltd., the fair takes place biennially at the Saigon Exhibition and Convention Center (SECC) in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, attracting professionals and exhibitors from around the world. As a leading trade and innovation forum, ILDEX Vietnam brings together top companies, experts, and decision-makers from sectors such as animal breeding, animal health, feed production, husbandry technology, slaughter and processing technologies, packaging solutions, cold chain systems, aquaculture, wastewater treatment, as well as sustainability and environmental protection. The fair provides industry professionals with opportunities to stay informed about current trends, establish valuable business connections, and explore practical solutions to meet the industry's growing demands. A particular highlight of ILDEX Vietnam includes live demonstrations of cutting-edge technologies, expert lectures from renowned industry leaders, and high-level networking events that offer valuable insights and collaboration opportunities. ILDEX Vietnam is part of the international ILDEX trade fair series, which is also held in other Asian countries and is closely aligned with Vietnam’s economic and agricultural development goals. As one of the fastest-growing markets in the agricultural and food industries, Vietnam gives the fair both national and global significance. The event attracts professionals from agriculture, food production, trade, research, and government institutions. Companies seeking advanced technologies and solutions to enhance efficiency in food production will find an exclusive platform for direct exchange with international experts. The Saigon Exhibition and Convention Center (SECC) in Ho Chi Minh City offers a world-class infrastructure with state-of-the-art facilities and excellent connectivity to Tan Son Nhat International Airport. As Vietnam’s economic hub, Ho Chi Minh City combines a dynamic business environment with rich cultural heritage. With its strong focus on forward-looking solutions and the Asian market, ILDEX Vietnam is an essential platform for all stakeholders in the agricultural and food industries who want to stay at the forefront of the sector’s latest developments.

With around 50 exhibitors, the Rice & Grain Expo presents technical grain milling innovations and farm related products and each year attracts hundreds of visitors from around the country, but more specifically the region. At World Trade Center Bangalore the UpperCrust Food & Wine Show is held every year, an event offering a wide range of food and beverages including bar and kitchen equipment. The Nepal Food & Beverages Expo, organized by Futurex Trade Fair & Events Pvt. Since 2023, the Saudi Horeca, a prominent trade fair for the hotel, restaurant, and café industry, has been held annually at the Jeddah Superdome in Jeddah. The FOOD TECHNOLOGY trade fair is a symbol of technological progress in food processing and is recognized as the leading professional event for food technology, processing, and safety in the Republic of Moldova. The Salon de l’Agriculture Nouvelle-Aquitaine is the most important regional agricultural fair in western France. Held annually at the Parc des Expositions in Bordeaux, it is organized by BEAM – Bordeaux Events And More , in close collaboration with the network of Chambers of Agriculture of the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region. This fair is much more than a simple product exhibition: it offers a unique platform that showcases the diversity and innovative strength of regional agriculture — appealing to both industry professionals and the general public. Key themes include animal breeding, food, sustainable farming, the environment, and energy. Special emphasis is placed on educational programs and the promotion of young talent in the agricultural sector. On an exhibition area of over 10,000 m², visitors can experience the presentation of more than 400 cattle, 300 horses, and 100 sheep — including breeding competitions, sheep shearing demonstrations, and herding dog performances. The fair vividly combines agricultural practice with in-depth knowledge-sharing — for farmers, breeders, students, and anyone interested in the future of agriculture. A major attraction is the Marché des Producteurs, where local producers present their specialties. The culinary offerings range from cheese, cured meats, and duck products to oysters, honey, wines, and Armagnac. The tasting experience is enhanced by live cooking shows featuring renowned regional chefs and the Comptoir des Vins, which offers a curated selection of award-winning wines for sampling. This creates a flavorful link between agriculture and regional identity — deeply rooted in the culture of Nouvelle-Aquitaine. Special thematic areas such as Aquitanima (cattle breeding), the Journées Ovines (sheep farming), and Equitaine (horse breeding and equestrian sports) bring the expertise of each sector to life in an engaging and hands-on way. Alongside products and animals, these zones also focus on career paths and training opportunities — with the aim of inspiring young people to pursue a career in agriculture. The majority of exhibitors come from sectors including agriculture, food processing, viticulture, livestock breeding, environmental technology, and renewable energy. The audience is just as diverse: farmers, winemakers, gastronomy professionals, trainees, families, and tourists all find relevant content and engaging offerings. The venue — the modern Parc des Expositions — is conveniently located and easily accessible by car or public transport. Situated close to the city center, Bordeaux provides the perfect setting for a trade fair that combines agriculture with quality of life, innovation with tradition, and regional identity with international appeal.

The Naturally Good is Australia’s leading trade show for natural, organic, and health-focused products. Since its inception in 2015, it has been held annually at the renowned International Convention Centre (ICC) in Sydney. Exclusively open to trade professionals, the event targets retailers, wholesalers, hospitality businesses, healthcare providers, and industry experts seeking to explore the latest trends, developments, and innovations in one of the region’s fastest-growing markets. The expo is organized by Diversified Communications Australia, a company with extensive experience and expertise in producing trade shows and conferences. The Naturally Good features a diverse concept that spans a wide range of products and services—including organic food and beverages, nutritional supplements, natural cosmetics, personal care items, and sustainable household and lifestyle products. A key highlight of the event is its in-depth content. Through the “Pulse Stage” program, visitors gain valuable insights into forward-looking topics such as consumer trends, behavioral analysis, regenerative agriculture, the rising importance of specialty and gourmet foods, and the latest developments in vitamins and supplements. Experts also offer practical knowledge on premium products for everyday shopping and new standards in certified organic goods. One of the standout features is the “Pitch Fest,” where start-ups present their products and business ideas to an audience of industry professionals and potential investors—providing a crucial platform for new market entrants. Centrally located on the vibrant Darling Harbour waterfront, the ICC Sydney offers a modern, easily accessible venue with striking architecture—an ideal setting for this dynamic trade fair. In addition to product showcases and networking opportunities, the event includes expert talks, seminars, and awards, making the Naturally Good a pioneering platform for exchange, growth, and innovation in the natural and healthy products sector.

This fair takes place annually at the Cape Town International Convention Centre and is organized by Live Events Africa (Pty) Ltd. The "Free From Show" has established itself as a unique platform, demonstrating that dietary restrictions do not have to limit one's enjoyment of life. It emphasizes the variety and quality of products that meet these special needs. The main themes of the fair include allergen-free foods, gluten-free products, and general nutritional innovations that contribute to a healthy and sustainable lifestyle. The fair showcases numerous products specifically aimed at people with special dietary needs or food intolerances. These include products free from common allergens like nuts, soy, milk, eggs, and wheat, a wide range of gluten-free foods such as bread, pasta, snacks, and baked goods – suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten intolerance – as well as lactose-free and dairy-free alternatives. Additionally, vegan and vegetarian products, items made without artificial additives, pesticides, or genetically modified organisms, supplements and vitamins offering health benefits, and foods for special diets like Paleo, Keto, or Low-Carb are also featured. A special highlight of the fair is the testing area, where renowned international and local chefs present their creations. Visitors can participate in cooking demonstrations, taste sample portions, and learn simple methods for preparing healthy, tasty, and sustainable dishes. Moreover, the fair offers lectures and discussion rounds from experts in culinary arts, nutrition science, and sustainability, as well as interactive master classes and yoga sessions. The fair attracts exhibitors from various industries, including food and beverage manufacturers, health and wellness companies, and providers of environmentally friendly products. It serves as a meeting point for professionals from these fields as well as interested consumers. The "Free From Show" has a special connection to the city of Cape Town and to South Africa, highlighting the growing importance of health, sustainability, and allergen awareness in the region. As part of a series of fairs held globally, it represents a significant attraction in the world of fairs. In conclusion, it is important to emphasize that the CTICC-Cape Town International Convention Centre impresses not only with its modern architecture and excellent facilities but also with its central location and easy accessibility. It provides an ideal setting for a fair that promises an unforgettable experience for both visitors and exhibitors.

Exhibitors showcase fine delicacies, exquisite wines, craft beer, spirits, handmade chocolates, regional cheese specialties, international street food trends, and sustainably produced organic products. The fair is organized by DLG Benelux B.V., which presents a comprehensive range of agricultural machinery, cultivation tips, and new technologies. Key themes include sustainable cultivation, technological innovations in agricultural engineering, and optimization approaches in potato processing. "PotatoEurope" features advanced cultivation methods and state-of-the-art harvesting machines. It attracts professionals from fields such as agriculture, agricultural technology, food processing, and biotechnology.
