Highlights include the International Congress on Food Ingredients and Additives, the Congress on Hygiene and Disinfection, and the National Innovation Competition, which recognizes new technologies and ideas. The fair is of significant importance to Lima and Peru as it provides local businesses access to global markets and technologies. It offers a unique platform for B2B networking and fosters exchanges between large manufacturers and smaller, innovative companies. Participants of the fair come from various sectors of the food industry, including production, processing, distribution, and marketing. The event attracts both local and international professionals eager to discover the latest innovations and products. The Centro de Exposiciones Jockey, the venue for the event, is ideally suited for international events due to its central location and accessibility. Its modern infrastructure and proximity to major transport hubs make it an optimal place for presenting and discussing new ideas and technologies. In summary, the "Ingredients" Expo provides an excellent opportunity to stay informed about the latest developments in the food industry and is an indispensable event for professionals in this dynamic sector.

개최장소(베뉴): MCEC - Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: "Fine Food Australia" represents more than just a name—it's a commitment to quality and excellence. Embracing the "Fine Food" label, the emphasis is on select foods, drinks, and services within the hospitality sector. Established in 1984, this event has become a pivotal gathering for the Australian food and hospitality sectors. It's expertly organised by Diversified Communications Australia, specialists in hosting international fairs and events. Annually in September, "Fine Food Australia" alternates between two renowned venues: the International Convention Centre (ICC) in Sydney and the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre. It showcases the latest trends, products, and innovations that drive the industry. Key features include food specialties, catering, front-of-house equipment, beverages, coffee and tea, bakery tools, hotel and retail tech, dairy insights, and pioneering packaging solutions. A significant portion of exhibitors hail from retail, food service, and hospitality backgrounds. This event allows them to showcase their newest products and services to a vast industry audience. Primarily, it attracts buyers and key decision-makers from the aforementioned sectors, presenting them with an unparalleled opportunity to keep abreast of industry innovations and establish business connections. Concluding, it's worth noting the strategic locations of both venues: the ICC in Sydney and the Convention Centre in Melbourne. Their central positioning coupled with excellent transport links ensures ease of access. The annual city switch offers attendees a unique opportunity to witness the vibrant facets of the Australian food and hospitality industry. Explore "Fine Food Australia" and delve into a realm of culinary innovation and discovery!

Foodist Istanbul is one of Turkey’s leading international trade fairs for food, beverages and food processing technologies. It serves as a key business platform for companies operating across the entire food industry value chain. The event takes place at the Tüyap Fair Convention & Congress Center in Istanbul, one of Turkey’s largest and most modern exhibition and convention venues. Foodist Istanbul is organised by Reed Tüyap Fairs and Exhibition Organization Inc., one of the country’s foremost exhibition organisers. Combining the international exhibition expertise of Reed Exhibitions with the extensive market knowledge of the Tüyap Group, the organiser provides a professional platform for both domestic and international business development. Foodist Istanbul covers every segment of the food and beverage industry. The exhibition showcases a wide range of products, including staple foods, canned goods, pulses and bakery products, as well as frozen and convenience foods, soft drinks, speciality coffees and teas, chocolate, confectionery, nuts, and organic and health foods. Fresh fruit and vegetables, meat, poultry and seafood products, dairy products, eggs and related goods are also prominently featured. The offering is further complemented by spices, sauces, edible oils, food additives, ingredients and private-label solutions for the retail sector. Another key focus is on innovative technologies and services for the food industry. Visitors gain insights into advanced solutions for food safety, hygiene and quality control, cold-chain management, warehousing and logistics. As a result, the exhibition not only showcases new products but also presents practical solutions to current industry challenges, including sustainability, traceability, operational efficiency and the optimisation of international supply chains. Among the event’s highlights are innovative food concepts, product launches and emerging market trends, alongside a wide range of networking and business-matching opportunities. Expert presentations, conferences and specialist forums provide valuable insights into the latest developments in the food sector. Particular emphasis is placed on business development, knowledge sharing and international collaboration. Exhibitors represent virtually every area of the food industry. Participants include food and beverage manufacturers, suppliers of raw materials and ingredients, packaging and processing technology companies, providers of refrigeration and logistics solutions, and service companies specialising in quality management, certification and food safety. This broad representation gives visitors a comprehensive overview of the industry as a whole. The fair attracts buyers from major retail chains, importers and exporters, wholesalers, distributors and food retail professionals. It is also attended by representatives from the hospitality and foodservice sectors, catering companies, and decision-makers from production, logistics and food technology. In addition, investors, industry associations and trade media use the event as a platform for information exchange and professional networking. With its international profile, diverse product offering and strategically advantageous location, Foodist Istanbul ranks among the most important meeting places for the food industry in Eurasia. The Tüyap Fair Convention & Congress Center is located in Büyükçekmece, a district on the western side of Istanbul, and is easily accessible from Istanbul International Airport as well as via the city’s extensive road and public transport networks. These advantages provide ideal conditions for successful business networking and the development of international trade partnerships.

개최장소(베뉴): Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
축제소개: RBHK - Restaurant Bar Café is the leading trade fair for the gastronomy and hospitality industry in the Asia-Pacific region, standing out as a unique platform for innovation, exclusivity, and professional networking. Since its inception in 2003, RBHK has become an essential meeting point for gastronomy experts, culinary visionaries, and professionals from the food, beverage, and equipment sectors. Each year, the prestigious Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in the heart of the city opens its doors to this special event, which is expertly organized by the internationally recognized event organizer Informa Markets. With a clear focus on quality and current trends, RBHK showcases everything modern hospitality businesses need. The latest products and tailored services in wine, spirits, beer, food, natural products, meat, seafood, technology, design, bakery and confectionery specialties, coffee, tea, and packaging solutions are presented here. The trade fair not only sets standards for the local market but also highlights the international character of Hong Kong as a significant hub for culinary trends and business opportunities in the region. A distinctive feature of RBHK is its high-profile competitions and awards, such as the “Hong Kong Best Spirits Awards”, the “Barista Competition”, and the “Wine Luxe International Awards”. These events offer industry professionals from gastronomy, hospitality, and the food and beverage sector inspiration, further training, and exclusive networking opportunities through live cooking shows, wine tastings, and direct exchanges with industry leaders. Exhibitors range from food and beverage producers to suppliers and technology providers. The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre impresses with its central, convenient location, offering excellent connections to public transport and the city’s main traffic arteries. This ensures comfortable access for both local and international visitors and provides a unique trade fair experience that vividly reflects Hong Kong’s status as a vibrant metropolis and a hotspot for the Asian gastronomic scene.

Seafood Expo Asia is a well-established trade fair that has served as a key meeting point for the international seafood industry since its inception in 2009. Held annually at the Sands Expo & Convention Centre in Singapore—one of Asia’s most advanced exhibition venues, centrally located in the city’s vibrant business district—it attracts industry professionals from around the globe. The event is organized by Diversified Communications , an experienced international trade show organizer with a globally connected event portfolio, including Seafood Expo North America in Boston and Seafood Expo Global in Barcelona. Seafood Expo Asia stands out for its clear thematic focus on innovation, sustainability, and market access within the Asian seafood sector. Key topics include developments in aquaculture, sustainable food systems, modern feed technologies, digital traceability, as well as food safety, environmental standards, and fair labor practices throughout the supply chain. Up-to-date market data, consumer trends, and forecasts for Southeast Asia offer valuable insights into the dynamic Asian seafood market for trade visitors. Exhibitors from every segment of the value chain showcase their latest products and solutions—from fresh and frozen seafood to processed and packaged goods, as well as technologies for processing, packaging, refrigeration, logistics, and automation. Particularly innovative, sustainable, or outstandingly flavorful products are recognized through the Product Showcase and the Seafood Excellence Asia Awards. The expo brings together international stakeholders from aquaculture, processing, wholesale, mechanical engineering, and packaging technology. Key visitors include decision-makers from the hospitality industry, foodservice, retail, as well as importers and distributors actively seeking new products and business opportunities in the Asian market. Singapore, as the host city, plays a vital role in the event’s success. With its world-class infrastructure and global connectivity, the city offers ideal conditions for international business networking. The Sands Expo & Convention Centre is optimally accessible thanks to its central location, proximity to hotels and restaurants, and excellent transport connections—especially to Changi Airport. As such, Seafood Expo Asia is far more than just a trade fair. It serves as a central platform for exchange, innovation, and commerce, and is a major showcase for the future of the global seafood industry in one of the world’s most dynamic markets.

Agrokomplex is an international trade fair that has established itself as a showcase for innovations and trends in the agricultural and food industries. Its name stands for high-level expertise in the agricultural sector and also refers to its modern venue: the International Exhibition Center Agrokomplex in Nitra, a historic university town in western Slovakia. Every year, the fair attracts industry professionals from across Europe and beyond. The event is organized by Agrokomplex-Výstavníctvo, a renowned company specializing in professional trade fairs and exhibitions, with a strong focus on facilitating knowledge transfer between research, business, and practical application. Agrokomplex is characterized by its current and wide-ranging focus topics, which encompass innovative agricultural technology, precision and regenerative agriculture, seeds, fertilizers, crop protection, livestock management, food processing, and sustainable packaging solutions. The main emphasis is on solutions that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and at the same time promote climate and soil protection as well as animal welfare—a goal that is becoming increasingly important in light of growing EU regulations and societal expectations. International exhibitors present state-of-the-art technologies, including tractors, harvesting machines, drones, sensors, digital herd management systems, and scientific innovations. The fair stands out for its strong practical orientation and serves as a marketplace, innovation hub, and discussion platform all in one. Visitors gain valuable insights into the entire value chain of the agriculture and food industries—from regional direct marketing models and national livestock competitions to start-up presentations. The exhibitors reflect the diversity of the agricultural and food sector: in addition to agricultural machinery manufacturers and seed producers, there are providers of digital solutions, universities, start-ups, and political institutions. The main audience consists of decision-makers from agriculture, food processing, research, trade, and politics, all looking for innovative and practical solutions. The International Exhibition Center Agrokomplex is recognized as a modern, spacious exhibition venue, easily accessible by public transport, car, or on foot. The city of Nitra itself, with its rich historical heritage, cultural attractions, and welcoming atmosphere, invites visitors to combine their fair attendance with an exploration of the region—making Agrokomplex not only a professional trade fair but also a memorable experience for all participants.

The SIAL China , which has been a leading international trade fair for food and beverages since its launch in 2023, will now be held annually at the Poly World Trade Center Expo in Guangzhou following its relocation from Shenzhen. The name SIAL stands for “Salon International de l’Alimentation”, meaning “International Food Exhibition”. The event is organised by Comexposium, a global organiser of trade fairs and conferences. The exhibition covers a wide range of sectors, including baby food, organic and wellness products, dairy products, non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, meat, poultry, processed meats and sausages, seafood, as well as pulses and cereals. This diversity highlights its central role as a platform for innovation and emerging trends within the food industry. At SIAL China, food manufacturers, distributors, importers, wholesalers, retailers, and representatives from both institutional and commercial foodservice showcase their latest products and services. As such, the trade fair serves as an important gateway to the Chinese market and a key platform for international companies seeking to establish a presence in China’s dynamic business environment. Distinctive features of the event include numerous competitions and award ceremonies recognising outstanding innovation, such as the SIAL Innovation competition, the SIAL Chic and Tea Contest, and the SIAL Cup Barista Challenge. These events promote quality and innovation while providing valuable opportunities for exchange between industry professionals and companies. As part of a global series of SIAL exhibitions, SIAL China plays a pivotal role in the international food industry. Participants and exhibitors represent a broad spectrum of sectors, including food production, foodservice, and trade. The Poly World Trade Center Expo in Guangzhou offers modern facilities and excellent infrastructure, making it an ideal venue for events of this scale and significance. Its convenient accessibility further enhances the trade fair’s appeal for both local and international participants.

The Gourmet Show is Mexico’s leading trade fair for premium food, fine beverages, and culinary lifestyle. Held annually in the heart of Mexico City – at the modern World Trade Center (WTC) – the event attracts culinary professionals, gourmet enthusiasts, and key decision-makers from across the food industry. Organized by Tradex Exposiciones, a seasoned exhibition company with decades of experience, the show has established itself as a benchmark in the sector. Each September, the Gourmet Show provides an exclusive platform for networking, presentation, and culinary exploration. Its clearly defined thematic structure, divided into dedicated exhibition zones known as Pabellones , offers visitors a well-organized experience while spotlighting industry trends and innovations. The Wine Room showcases international wines and premium spirits, while the Agave Fest is dedicated to traditional Mexican agave-based distillates such as tequila and mezcal. With Veganautas , the show also highlights the growing plant-based and vegan movement, reinforcing its commitment to culinary diversity and forward-thinking concepts. The product range is extensive – from artisanal breads, fine cheeses, and charcuterie to fresh seafood, gourmet chocolates, preserves, organic products, and creative culinary ingredients. The offering is further enriched by high-quality oils, vinegars, and international delicacies. Exhibitors include both small-scale producers and established brands from the fine food, gastronomy, hospitality, retail, wholesale, and catering sectors. Beyond business, the Gourmet Show embraces a cultural mission: to promote Mexico’s culinary heritage while bridging tradition and innovation. Through a diverse program of workshops, tastings, and networking events, it creates a vibrant meeting point for chefs, sommeliers, food professionals, and culinary enthusiasts. As Mexico’s premier culinary showcase, the event highlights the country’s rich diversity of products and producers – and in doing so, enhances its international reputation as a destination for gourmet excellence. The centrally located Pepsi Center also provides ideal infrastructure. Its proximity to the WTC, excellent public transport connections, and nearby hotel options make the Gourmet Show not only a culinary highlight but also a logistical success.

The " Inter Food EXPO ", held annually at the Karen Demirchyan-Komplex in Yerevan, Armenia, is an international trade fair for the food industry. Organized by the Logos Expo Center, it has established itself as an indispensable platform for industry leaders and representatives from both wholesale and retail sectors. Armenia's geographical position, increasingly important in global food production and distribution, adds significant relevance to the fair. The aim of the Inter Food EXPO is to showcase a wide range of products and services. These include meat and dairy products, non-alcoholic beverages, mineral water, spirits, tobacco products, confectioneries, and ice cream. The fair also presents the latest technologies in food production and packaging, making it an essential gathering for professionals in the field. The fair not only offers insights into innovations and new products but also serves as an educational platform. Seminars and round-table discussions on current issues and future perspectives of the food industry are held, emphasizing its role as a place for learning and professional exchange. Annually, the fair attracts a diverse array of industry representatives, including manufacturers, suppliers, wholesalers, and retailers. It is also a magnet for restaurateurs and governmental regulatory bodies, highlighting the variety of participants and the broad interest it generates. The Karen Demirchyan-Komplex, with its modern facilities and convenient access, is an ideal venue. Moreover, Yerevan's rich cultural and historical context provides additional incentives for international visitors to attend the fair and take the opportunity to explore Armenia.

The 'Rohvolution' fair in Speyer stands as a beacon for the raw food nutritional revolution. The name melds the word "Roh", denoting the core essence of the showcased diet, with "Revolution", indicating a transformative shift in nutritional perspectives. Hosted in the scenic city of Speyer, specifically within the town hall, Rohvolution began its journey in 2017. It has since become an annual magnet for raw food aficionados. The fair is orchestrated by RohKöstlich GmbH, esteemed for their event management prowess and deep understanding of raw food nutrition. Central to the fair is the exploration of raw food nutrition. Attendees can delve into a myriad of related products and services. Offerings span from raw food preparation tools like juicers to taste-test opportunities provided by organic producers and fruit vendors. Here, one can relish smoothies, fresh juices, and other raw food delights. What particularly stands out at the Rohvolution are the enlightening lectures and workshops, shedding light on the art of raw food preparation. Exhibitors, ranging from organic farmers to kitchen equipment manufacturers, spotlight their offerings. Among the visitors, one finds nutrition enthusiasts, health-aware individuals, and professionals spanning the spheres of nutrition, gastronomy, and farming. In summary, Speyer's town hall is more than just a venue; it's a nexus point, both accessible by public transport and car. Set against the historic allure of Speyer, the fair is more than an event – it's an odyssey into the realm of mindful and healthful eating." Note: The 'Rohvolution' fair in Speyer is a central event in the raw food revolution, offering attendees a chance to immerse themselves in raw food nutrition, sample delightful products, and learn from experts. Held at a strategic location, it promises not just knowledge but also a unique cultural experience.

개최장소(베뉴): Grand Tikal Futura Hotel & Convention Center
축제소개: Alimentaria in Guatemala City is more than a traditional trade fair. It serves as a central meeting point for culinary innovations, trends, and sustainable developments within the food and beverage industry of Central America. The name "Alimentaria", derived from the Spanish word for food, captures the essence of the event: the focus is on current products, modern technologies, and new culinary experiences from the world of food and drink. Each year, the Grand Tikal Futura Hotel & Convention Center transforms into an important hub for the industry. Alimentaria is organized by CorpoEventos, an experienced local event organizer, and attracts both industry professionals and enthusiasts from across Central America. Here, visitors gain a concise and practical overview of the latest developments in the food and gastronomy sectors: from innovative technologies and automation to digital business models and data analytics, as well as sustainable kitchen concepts, resource-efficient production, and zero-waste initiatives. The event combines professional depth with cultural identity. International congresses and events such as "Nan Pa’ach – The Maize Ceremony" highlight Guatemala’s culinary heritage and bring traditions to life. In addition, Alimentaria offers hands-on training, barista masterclasses, the Junior Chef Contest, as well as exclusive B2B networking events and matchmaking formats for HORECA professionals. Exhibitors represent the entire value chain: producers, importers, wholesalers and retailers, suppliers for hotels and restaurants, as well as start-ups, showcase innovative foods, beverages, technologies, services, and equipment solutions. Live demonstrations, the Tenedor de Oro awards, and inspiring workshops underline Alimentaria’s role as an innovation platform, marketplace, and cultural forum—firmly rooted in the region and internationally oriented. Trade visitors such as buyers, chefs, F&B managers, retailers, logistics specialists, export experts, and industry media find targeted inspiration, valuable contacts, and up-to-date expertise. For the wider public, Alimentaria remains an exciting event full of new discoveries. The modern Grand Tikal Futura Hotel & Convention Center impresses with first-class infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and state-of-the-art facilities. It reflects the forward-looking spirit of the Guatemalan capital. Thanks to its central location and optimal transport links, a visit to the fair becomes a pleasant and inspiring experience—right in the heart of one of Central America’s most dynamic metropolises.

전시회명: Marca China Private Label Fair (Marca China)
축제소개: The Marca - China International Private Label Fair, held annually, is a leading trade fair dedicated to the wholesale and private label sector . Organized by BolognaFiere China Ltd., one of the leading trade fair organizers, it serves as a central platform for manufacturers from various industries to present their products and services to a broad audience and strengthen their presence in both the Chinese and international markets. The fair focuses on key topics such as food, non-food items, packaging, services, beauty and personal care products, and pet products, with special emphasis on quality, sustainability, and innovation. The range of exhibits is diverse and includes fresh and preserved foods, organic products, beverages, health and hygiene products, household and leisure items, pet food, and much more. A highlight is the focus on "Made in China" products, known for their high quality and authenticity. A highlight of the fair is the "International Private Label Selection (IPLS) Award", which recognizes outstanding new products and innovative ideas in the private label sector. Additionally, there is a special "New Consumer Products Zone" dedicated to the latest trends in private label goods from both domestic and international markets. The "E-Marca" section allows top e-commerce platforms to participate in e-commerce live streams and product selection events to explore new solutions for e-commerce marketing. Another highlight is the professional forum, where experts, retailers, and brand owners discuss the latest trends and current topics. Exhibitors from various sectors, including food production, packaging industry, logistics, and service sector, present themselves here. The main visitors include retailers, importers, as well as national and international buyers. Thanks to its strategically advantageous location and good accessibility by various means of transport, the fair location in Shenzhen is an ideal meeting point for professionals from all over the world. The Marca China Fair reflects the growth of the private label market and emphasizes the important role of China in the international trade and industrial landscape.

AGRIFOOD TAIWAN is a key part of Taiwan Smart Agriweek and is recognized as the leading trade fair for modern food production, processing, and technology in Taiwan. The name “AGRIFOOD” highlights the connection between agriculture and food. The exhibition spans this entire spectrum, from fresh raw materials to innovative finished and functional foods, showcasing the full range of current industry developments. Each autumn, the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center (TaiNEX) in Taipei becomes the meeting point for experts, innovators, and decision-makers from the international agriculture and food sectors. The event is organized by MY Exhibition Co., Ltd., renowned for its professional management and high-quality conference program. AGRIFOOD TAIWAN positions itself as a platform representing the entire value chain of the industry. The focus is on topics such as “From Farm to Table,” “Food Innovations,” “Functional Food & Nutrition,” and “Food-Tech Manufacturing.” Leading providers present premium fruit and vegetable products, high-quality grains, fish and meat products, as well as modern ready-to-eat and plant-based alternatives. The exhibition is complemented by innovative processing and packaging technologies, food safety solutions, cold chain logistics, and industry-specific automation. A particular emphasis is placed on functional ingredients, enriched foods, and nutritional concepts tailored to specific needs, such as those of seniors. The fair addresses current global trends like plant-based products and clean labels, while also setting regional accents with Chinese herbal tonics, innovative aquaculture products, and modern processing technologies. In doing so, AGRIFOOD TAIWAN underscores the country’s role as a hub of innovation. Exhibiting companies represent the fields of agriculture, food production, processing technology, packaging, logistics, and quality assurance. Trade visitors come from sectors such as retail, gastronomy, large-scale catering, healthcare, as well as research and development. They all share a keen interest in the latest trends and developments in the industry. The TaiNEX, as a modern exhibition venue, is conveniently located and offers a comfortable environment for both local and international guests. Taipei itself impresses with its blend of tradition and cutting-edge technology and serves as a vibrant meeting place for all those who wish to actively shape the future of the food industry.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Glee Birmingham is an annual trade fair specializing in the garden, pet, and leisure sectors and is considered one of the most important industry gatherings in the United Kingdom. Since its launch in 1974 – originally under the name Garden, Leisure, Equipment Exhibition – it has evolved into a key platform for buyers, retailers, and service providers in the gardening and retail industries. The event is exclusively aimed at trade visitors and represents the entire value chain, from manufacturers to retailers. After its scheduling shift from June to September, it now regularly takes place at the NEC Birmingham – one of the largest and best-connected exhibition centers in the UK, easily accessible by both car and public transport. Organized by the Hyve Group, an internationally active company with a portfolio of over 120 trade fairs and conferences, Glee benefits from this global expertise. Every year, it attracts thousands of trade professionals and leading brands from around the world who present their latest products and services in a professional setting. The event places particular emphasis on innovation, sustainability, and the connection between nature and quality of life. It covers a wide range of topics reflecting the diversity of the modern gardening and leisure market. The plants and horticulture section remains at the core of the show, showcasing new plant varieties, innovative cultivation technologies, substrates, and solutions for professional greenhouse construction. At the same time, the Garden Living segment is gaining significance, highlighting the garden as an extension of the living space – featuring premium furniture, decorations, lighting concepts, and outdoor kitchen systems. The garden care and maintenance sector also plays a central role, covering everything from traditional tools to advanced irrigation systems. Particular focus is placed on the trend toward sustainable and nature-friendly gardening, which has become a cornerstone of the industry. Products such as peat-free soils, recycled materials, biodiversity protection solutions, and water-saving technologies underscore the importance of environmental responsibility. Another key area is the pet supplies segment, as many garden centers also serve as outlets for pet products. Offerings range from pet food and accessories to grooming products for various animal species. This is further complemented by the gifts & stationery and floristry sections, featuring seasonal items, accessories, and professional supplies for florists. Glee Birmingham impresses not only with its thematic diversity but above all with its consistent focus on the needs of the specialist trade. By combining product innovations, retail trends, and forward-looking themes such as outdoor living, biodiversity, and sustainability, it offers a dedicated platform that meets both commercial and content-driven demands. For professionals in the garden industry, participation in Glee is virtually indispensable.

Riga Food is a leading trade fair for the food industry, held annually at the International Exhibition Centre Kipsala in Riga, Latvia. It serves as a central meeting point for industry experts from all over Europe and the world, providing a platform to showcase new products and exchange information about the latest developments in food and beverage production, processing, packaging, as well as catering, gastronomy, and hospitality. The fair is organized by the Exhibition Company BT 1, known for providing professional conditions that enable business professionals to expand their networks and present innovative solutions and services. The fair covers a wide range of topics, including advanced technologies in production and packaging, as well as services for hotels and public catering establishments. A distinctive feature of "Riga Food" is its close connection to Riga and the Baltic region. Through competitions like the Baltic Taste Award, high-quality regional foods are honored and made known internationally. Additionally, the fair offers a stage for spectacular events such as cooking and bartender competitions, attracting both professional visitors and interested guests. Exhibitors come from various sectors of the food industry, including manufacturing, processing, and services. The main target audience of the fair are professionals interested in the latest industry trends and looking to expand their business activities. The venue, the International Exhibition Centre Kipsala, is easily accessible and offers modern facilities, making it an ideal location for this large-scale event. In conclusion, "Riga Food" is not just a trade fair, but also a cultural event that showcases the culinary diversity and innovation of the food industry in a dynamic and interactive environment.

Festi’Valériane is Belgium’s largest and most established organic fair – an annual highlight that, since 1976, has served as a showcase for sustainable agriculture, ecological innovation, and conscious consumption. The name Valériane represents far more than just an event; it embodies the values of biodynamics, environmental responsibility, and a resource-conscious lifestyle that define the spirit of the fair. Every late summer, Foire de Libramont in the heart of the Walloon city of Libramont welcomes around 300 exhibitors and approximately 20,000 visitors, offering them an immersive experience of the diversity and importance of the organic sector. Organised by Nature & Progrès Belgique , an organisation passionately committed to promoting organic farming for over four decades, the fair’s programme spans agriculture and food, housing and energy, horticulture, health, society and the environment, and also includes a dedicated B2B programme. Organic producers, winemakers, manufacturers of eco-friendly building materials, providers of sustainable mobility solutions, producers of organic clothing and natural textiles, natural cosmetics companies, as well as environmental and social organisations, present their products and services. For professionals – including farmers, retailers, and manufacturers – the fair is an essential platform to discover emerging trends, forge business connections, and explore innovations first-hand. For the wider public, it offers inspiration for a sustainable lifestyle, from organic catering and hands-on workshops to lectures and panel discussions with experts. Festi’Valériane owes its unique atmosphere not only to its diverse range of exhibitors, but also to its location in a region renowned for its gastronomy, culture, and natural beauty. With its historic old town, imposing citadel, and welcoming cafés, Namur provides the perfect setting to combine a trade fair visit with a cultural getaway. Thanks to its central location, Namur Expo is easily accessible by car, train, or bus – an ideal destination for anyone interested in ecological future topics while enjoying Belgian hospitality at its best.

Since its establishment in 2005, " Food Technology Asia " has been an international trade fair and has become a central meeting place for experts from the food and nutrition sectors. Known by the acronym FTA, it takes place annually and attracts leading suppliers from international and regional markets. The fair is organized by Ecommerce Gateway Pakistan PVT Ltd. It provides a comprehensive platform for showcasing the latest products and services. Key focus areas include food ingredients and additives, food processing and packaging, machinery and equipment, as well as innovative fields such as Agtech, Agritech, supply chain and logistics, biotechnology, and functional foods. Notably, the fair features special zones for startups, culinary innovations, and technologies focused on forward-looking solutions. It also includes an extensive program of conferences, seminars, and networking events that offer deep insights into current trends, challenges, and opportunities in the industry. The range of products and services displayed extends from processed foods and beverages to groundbreaking culinary solutions, covering topics like food safety, quality assurance, and certifications. Additionally, E-commerce platforms for food technology, smart kitchen technologies, strategies for reducing and recycling food waste, and food software and data analysis are presented. The fair emphasizes the economic importance of food technology for Pakistan and contributes to the development of the local industry. Exhibitors represent various sectors, including food production, agricultural technology, and biotechnology. The main attendees are professionals from these and related industries, interested in the latest technological developments and market trends. In summary, Food Technology Asia annually provides a dynamic platform for the exchange of knowledge, technology, and business opportunities, promoting the latest advancements and trends in the food technology sector.

Histoire Zen is far more than a traditional trade fair – it offers a holistic experience that nourishes body, mind, and soul. Its name symbolizes the core mission of the event: Histoire as the story of well-being, and Zen as a representation of inner peace, balance, and mindfulness. Every year, it attracts a diverse audience interested in natural healing methods, personal development, spiritual practices, and sustainable lifestyles. The upcoming edition will take place at the modern ARENA du Pays d’Aix in Aix-en-Provence – a centrally located venue offering excellent comfort and superb transport connections. Organized by the eponymous event company, Histoire Zen is regarded as France’s leading public fair for alternative medicine, natural health practices, and spiritual growth. The event goes well beyond the scope of a conventional health fair: it brings together traditional naturopathy, gentle therapeutic methods, and contemporary trends in organic cosmetics, detox culture, and life coaching – all within an inspiring and thoughtfully designed setting. Key topics include well-being and personal growth, such as life and relationship coaching, school orientation guidance, and massage techniques like Kobido. Gentle medicine also plays a major role, with offerings from naturopathy, Traditional Chinese Medicine, hypnosis, Reiki, Laochi, sophrology, and more. A dedicated space for spiritual healing and divinatory arts invites visitors to explore tarot reading, palmistry, astrology, and related disciplines. The program is further enriched by lithotherapy featuring healing stones and fossils. A distinctive feature of the fair is its strong support for regional artisans and organic producers, with a focus on handmade products “Made in France”, organic food, and natural cosmetics. Expert talks and interactive workshops enhance the visitor experience by providing valuable insights and inspiration – prioritizing genuine engagement and knowledge-sharing over simple product promotion. Exhibitors represent a wide range of fields, including naturopathy, body therapy, yoga, meditation, organic product development, spiritual counseling, and coaching. Visitors include professionals – such as naturopaths, therapists, and coaches – as well as individuals seeking a more conscious, healthy, and fulfilling lifestyle. Histoire Zen is part of a nationwide series of events held annually at various locations across France. It has become a key platform for holistic living. The edition in Aix-en-Provence particularly benefits from the region’s natural beauty, cultural richness, and the venue’s exceptional accessibility. The ARENA du Pays d’Aix offers a modern, uplifting environment that perfectly reflects the spirit of the fair. Whether you’re a professional visitor, exhibitor, or private individual, Histoire Zen in Aix-en-Provence invites you to discover new perspectives on living a healthy, mindful, and meaningful life.

HORECA Oman is an annual trade fair held at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre in Muscat. The name "Horeca" represents Hotels, Restaurants, and Cafés, reflecting the main themes of the fair. The event is organized by Hospitality Services s.a.r.l, a well-known organization in the region. The fair has become a central meeting point for the hotel, gastronomy, and beverage industries in the kingdom and beyond. It showcases a wide range of products and services, including food and frozen goods, meat, poultry, seafood, beverages, packaging, kitchen technology and equipment, furniture and decor for restaurants and cafés, uniforms, and hospitality services. A distinctive feature of HORECA Oman is its connection to local culture and economy. It provides a platform for local and international exhibitors to network with professionals from various sectors. Additionally, it reflects the culinary trends and innovations of the region. The fair is characterized by a variety of highlights, such as live cooking sessions with renowned chefs, tastings, and competitions like the Oriental Cuisine Competition, the Oman Cuisine Competition, the International Cuisine Competition, Barista Competition, and the Cocktail Zero Competition. These events are complemented by conferences and live talks with experts. HORECA Oman is part of the Horeca Exhibitions Series, which also takes place in other Middle Eastern countries. This series is among the largest of its kind in the region. The fair is held annually in Muscat and primarily attracts visitors from the hotel, restaurant, and café sectors. The Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre, a modern and well-equipped venue, is easily accessible and provides an ideal setting for this important industry event. In conclusion, HORECA Oman is not only an outstanding platform for business relationships and knowledge exchange in the hotel, gastronomy, and beverage industries but also a vibrant showcase of Oman's rich culture and culinary diversity. It offers a unique opportunity to network with industry leaders, discover the latest trends, and experience the pulsating heart of hospitality in the Middle East.

Food Syria is the country’s premier international trade fair for food, beverages and food technology, serving as a key meeting point for industry professionals from across the region. The event is organised by IFP Group (International Fairs & Promotions, Lebanon), a well-established exhibition organiser with decades of experience delivering B2B platforms throughout the Middle East. It takes place at the Damascus Fairgrounds, Syria’s most prominent exhibition venue, equipped with modern facilities. The fair showcases innovations, products and services spanning the entire food industry value chain – from primary production and processing to packaging and distribution. Core product categories include high-quality dairy and meat products, poultry, confectionery, snacks, beverages, oils, spices, frozen and ready-made foods, organic goods and staple foods. This offering is complemented by a dedicated technology section covering food processing, packaging machinery, automation, robotics, traceability, food safety and logistics solutions. In addition, the fair features a wide range of raw materials, additives, flavourings and technical services – all vital to Syria’s growing food processing sector. Food Syria is specifically geared towards trade visitors, including manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, restaurateurs, investors and franchise operators. Exhibitors represent a diverse spectrum of industries – from agriculture and food production to machinery, packaging, transport and cold chain logistics. More than just a marketplace, the fair also serves as a hub for knowledge exchange, business development and professional networking. As part of IFP Group’s wider portfolio of trade fairs across the Middle East, Food Syria plays an important role in strengthening Syria’s economic presence in the region. Centrally located and easily accessible, the Damascus Fairgrounds offer state-of-the-art infrastructure, spacious exhibition areas and ideal conditions for both domestic and international participants. Food Syria is not only a standout event for the sector – it is also a key driver of Syria’s economic future.

Launched in 1994, the Feria de Ejea takes place in Ejea de los Caballeros, serving as a central showcase for innovations and trends in agriculture, commerce, services, the food industry, and crafts. The fair, organized by SOFEJEA in close collaboration with the City Council and the local Trade Association, is held at the Recinto Ferial de Ejea and is notable for its irregular frequency. In addition to agricultural machinery and equipment, the Feria de Ejea provides a platform for local and regional businesses from various sectors to present their products and services to a wide audience. Visitors and professionals from commerce, the food industry, and services find new contacts and innovative solutions here. It serves as an important hub for exchanges between urban and rural areas, reflecting the economic diversity of the region. A highlight of the fair includes a variety of events such as technical conferences, show cooking, children’s entertainment, and live music, which offer both entertaining and informative experiences. The program is complemented by activities at the nearby Aquagraria Museum, which is accessible with a fair ticket. The fair features a wide variety of exhibitors, from local artisans to international agricultural machinery manufacturers, making it a key meeting point for industry professionals from around the world. This diversity makes the Feria de Ejea a significant event for industry insiders and the general public alike. In conclusion, the Feria de Ejea in the charming town of Ejea de los Caballeros offers not only a fair experience but also an invitation to explore regional culture and hospitality. With its specific focus and diverse offerings, the fair provides a valuable platform for exchange, growth, and innovation.

The event is hosted at BITEC – Bangkok International Trade & Exhibition Center, a leading trade fair center known for its top-notch infrastructure and accessibility. It is organized biennially by VNU Exhibitions Asia Pacific Co., Ltd., a prominent name in the trade fair industry. The focus of "Health and Nutrition Asia" includes advanced animal health technologies, genetics, feed additives, bioenergy, and biomass pellet technology. The fair provides a platform for showcasing products and services ranging from new feed probiotics to innovative pig genetics programs. The fair is of significant local and national importance, highlighting the latest trends and services for the development of livestock, poultry, and aquaculture. It attracts exhibitors and visitors from various sectors, including CEOs, feed formulators, factory managers, nutritionists, veterinarians, and many others. A highlight of the fair are the accompanying conferences that cover a wide range of current industry topics. These conferences not only provide information but also offer networking opportunities and promote knowledge exchange. Health and Nutrition Asia is part of a series of fairs held at various locations worldwide, thus emphasizing the global networking and importance of the industry. In summary, the fair location BITEC in Bangkok impresses not only with its modern facilities and accessibility but also functions as an important hub for international business relations in the Asian region.

The TecnoCarnicos Andina is an international trade fair in South America that specifically focuses on the meat industry. This event connects producers with consumers and provides a platform for presenting the latest technologies and innovations in these sectors. It takes place biennially at the Sheraton Hotel in Bogotá and attracts professionals from the entire industry. The name "TecnoCarnicos Andina" indicates a focus on technology (Tecno) and meat products (Carnicos), while "Andina" symbolizes the Andean region, particularly Colombia. The event is organized by Sofex Americas LTDA, an experienced player in the trade fair industry. The main themes of the TecnoCarnicos Andina include new production methods, innovative meat and sausage products, and advanced technologies in meat processing and production. The fair presents a variety of products and services, including meat processing equipment, packaging solutions, and quality assurance systems. The fair plays a crucial role for the city and the country as it serves as a meeting point for national and international experts, thereby strengthening the local economy. Special highlights include numerous conferences and seminars where experts share their knowledge. Additionally, practical workshops on meat product manufacturing, product demonstrations, and business matchmaking activities are offered, which are essential for networking and business development. The exhibitors mainly come from the meat industry, but related sectors such as packaging and logistics are also represented. The main visitor group consists of professionals from these industries as well as decision-makers from the food industry. The venue, the Sheraton Hotel in Bogotá, is ideally suited for an international fair of this size due to its modern facilities. Its central location in Colombia's capital not only facilitates access for international visitors but also offers the opportunity to explore the city's cultural and historical sights.

The " Cheese and Dairy Product Show " ( Salon du Fromage et des Produits Laitiers ) is an international trade fair in Paris that showcases and promotes high-quality cheeses and other dairy products. This event occurs biennially at the prestigious Paris Porte de Versailles exhibition center and attracts industry professionals from around the world. Hosted by Comexposium, one of the leading trade fair organizers globally, the Salon du Fromage et des Produits Laitiers offers a platform for innovation, artisanal skill, and the exchange of expertise. The venue in Paris, the gastronomic heart of France, emphasizes the significance of the fair and provides a cultural setting ideally suited to its theme. The event's main focus includes products such as butter, eggs, and a wide range of cheeses, including both French (AOP, IGP) and international varieties. Additionally, materials, equipment, and services crucial to the industry are showcased. A special emphasis of the fair is on innovation and authenticity. Exhibitors from various sectors of the industry present their latest products and services, making the salon an essential event for producers, traders, and experts. The fair serves as a platform for exchanging ideas and further education in current trends and techniques in the food industry and gastronomy. Noteworthy are the diverse events such as workshops, tastings, and discussion rounds, where visitors can discover unusual cheese combinations (like cheese with alcohol or olives) and advance their skills in new techniques. Highlights include the grilled cheese competition and the prestigious Lyre d'Or competition, which focuses on the most creative cheese platter. The fair also provides insights into sustainable production methods and introduces the latest flavor trends, underscoring its relevance and commitment to the industry's future. The "Salon du Fromage et des Produits Laitiers" is more than just a trade fair: it is an experience that celebrates the cultural and economic value of cheese and dairy products and strengthens the connection between producers and consumers. Located in the heart of Paris, this event offers unique networking, learning, and discovery opportunities for all those active in the cheese and dairy product industry.

The Alimentec in Bogota is considered one of the most important trade fairs for the food industry in Colombia and all of Latin America. It provides an ideal platform for networking with industry peers and establishing valuable business contacts. This fair is held every two years in even-numbered years and is organized by Corferias in collaboration with Koelnmesse. The thematic range of Alimentec covers all major areas of the food industry: gourmet foods, chilled and frozen products, meat, poultry, fish, seafood, dairy products and eggs, baked goods, beverages, as well as fruits, vegetables, and organic foods. Confectionery, snacks, and sweets are also well represented. A highlight of the fair is the opportunity to network with international experts from the fields of food and beverages, agriculture, packaging, technology, and related services. The event takes place at the International Exhibition Center Corferias, one of the most modern exhibition grounds in Bogota. The top-notch infrastructure and modern facilities make Corferias the ideal meeting point for exhibitors and visitors from around the world. Due to its high level of internationality and the wide range of products and services offered, Alimentec is an indispensable event for professionals in the food industry and for anyone interested in the latest trends and technologies. The next edition of the fair promises to be an outstanding event once again, meeting all expectations.

축제소개: Foodpro is one of the most important and longest-established trade exhibitions for the food and beverage industry in the Asia-Pacific region. Since its inception in 1967, it has brought together manufacturers, processors, technology providers and decision-makers from across the entire food production value chain. Held every three years, the exhibition alternates between the Australian cities of Sydney and Melbourne. The event takes place at the Sydney Convention and Exhibition Centre and the Melbourne Convention & Exhibition Centre respectively. Traditionally staged in the middle of the year, Foodpro is recognised as a key meeting place for industry professionals from Australia, New Zealand and the wider Asia-Pacific region. The exhibition is organised by Diversified Communications Australia, a leading organiser of international trade shows, conferences and industry events. Drawing on decades of experience, the company provides a platform for showcasing innovations, market trends and cutting-edge technologies for the food and beverage sector. Foodpro covers every aspect of industrial food production. Key focus areas include food processing, packaging technologies, ingredients and additives, food science and technology, smart and digital manufacturing, factory infrastructure, logistics and material flow, as well as advanced processing and packaging equipment. The exhibition also features solutions for automation, quality management, sustainability and operational efficiency throughout the production chain. The event serves a broad range of industry sectors, including meat and poultry processing, seafood, dairy products, fruit and vegetable processing, packaged foods, beverage manufacturing, bakery and snack products, frozen and convenience foods, ingredients and additives, and pet food. Visitors gain a comprehensive insight into current industry developments, ranging from innovative formulations and functional ingredients to state-of-the-art production and packaging lines. Products and services on display include beverage production equipment, food processing machinery, packaging solutions, factory infrastructure, logistics and material handling systems, digital manufacturing platforms, quality control technologies, and a wide range of ingredients and additives. As such, Foodpro provides a comprehensive overview of the latest technologies and solutions for food and beverage production. One of the exhibition’s distinguishing features is its extensive programme of product presentations, live demonstrations and technical seminars, where industry experts present and discuss current developments and emerging trends shaping the future of the sector. Exhibitors primarily represent the fields of food processing, packaging technology, machinery and plant engineering, automation, food technology, ingredient manufacturing, logistics and business services. Trade visitors include food and beverage manufacturers, processors, packaging companies, distributors, production managers, engineers, quality managers, purchasing professionals, and specialists from the fields of food science and research. The modern exhibition centres in Sydney and Melbourne offer first-class exhibition facilities, advanced technical infrastructure and excellent transport links. Supported by international airports, efficient public transport networks and a wide range of accommodation and leisure options, both venues are easily accessible and provide ideal conditions for a productive and successful exhibition experience.
